package spotify

// ddsonic composed stage (M3b2, plan v9 §12 step 2): the rows I1-I5, L1-L5
// and L6 (§5, §6, §8), on the real ddsonic Session and provider over the
// real SDK constructor, player and key provider, with only the remote
// services and the access point replaced by loopback fixtures (§2). Overlaid
// as external/spotify/zz_ddsonic_composed_cases_test.go, which sorts before
// the controls file, so ZZNoLateUse stays last; go test ./... never compiles
// it.

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	librespot "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot"
	"github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/ap"
	"github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/audio"
	metadatapb "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/proto/spotify/metadata"

	"github.com/bjarneo/cliamp/playlist"
)

// composedWaitGen waits up to d for b's access point generation to reach want.
func composedWaitGen(b *playback, want uint64, d time.Duration) uint64 {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(d)
	for {
		g := composedGeneration(b)
		if g >= want || time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return g
		}
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// I1 and its M10 negative (plan v9 §5).

// TestDDSonicComposedI1: servicing answers a Ping and reconnects after an
// idle peer close, before any key; then a full first play on c2.
// DDSONIC_I1_VARIANT=M10 is the M10 mutant's run: A1-svc and A1-idle are its
// named reds, and its play is recorded only (§5).
func TestDDSonicComposedI1(t *testing.T) {
	m10 := os.Getenv("DDSONIC_I1_VARIANT") == "M10"
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 21)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		_, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("I1 precondition: no bundle or no first connection after P0")
		}
		// A1-svc: a Ping on c1 is answered with a Pong within 2 s.
		if err := c1.C.Send(ap.PacketTypePing, []byte{0, 0, 0, 1}); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I1 precondition: sending a Ping: %v", err)
		}
		if _, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypePong, 2*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Error("I1 A1-svc: a Ping on c1 is answered with a Pong within 2 s")
		} else {
			t.Log("I1-A1-SVC-OK")
		}
		// A1-idle: the peer closes c1 before any key; the idle reconnect
		// follows within 10 s, with no play. ONE absolute 10 s deadline,
		// declared before the peer close (R105-2): c2's publication and the
		// generation observation get only what remains of it, and the facts
		// are accepted only if all were observed before it. composedWaitGen
		// samples before its own timeout, so a late success is refused here.
		gen1 := composedGeneration(a)
		idleBy := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I1 precondition: peer close: %v", err)
		}
		c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, time.Until(idleBy))
		gen2 := composedWaitGen(a, gen1+1, time.Until(idleBy))
		logins := h.ap.Logins()
		inTime := time.Now().Before(idleBy)
		if c2 == nil || gen2 != gen1+1 || logins != 2 || !inTime {
			t.Errorf("I1 A1-idle: the idle reconnect follows within 10 s with no play: second connection %t, generation %d -> %d, logins %d, observed before the deadline %t", c2 != nil, gen1, gen2, logins, inTime)
		} else {
			t.Logf("I1-A1-IDLE-OK generation %d -> %d", gen1, gen2)
		}
		// A1-play (E-outer).
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		h.Phase("P1")
		res, ok := composedWithin(composedOpenAsync(h, "I1-play", p, tr.URI()), 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I1: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if m10 {
			t.Logf("I1-M10-PLAY-OBSERVED err=%v setups=%d recoveries=%d rebuilds=%v key writes c1=%d c2=%d", res.err, d3, h.Decisions("begin"), d4, composedKeyWrites(h, 0), composedKeyWrites(h, 1))
			return
		}
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I1 A1-play: NewStreamer: %v", res.err)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("I1 A1-play: the decoded samples are silent")
		}
		_, b := h.Bundle(p)
		if d3 != 1 || composedKeyWrites(h, 0) != 0 || composedKeyWrites(h, 1) != 1 || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || len(d4) != 0 || b != a {
			t.Errorf("I1 A1-play: 1 setup, 1 key write on c2 and 0 on c1, 0 recoveries, 0 rebuilds, the same bundle: setups %d, key writes c1=%d c2=%d, recoveries %d, rebuilds %v, same bundle %t", d3, composedKeyWrites(h, 0), composedKeyWrites(h, 1), h.Decisions("begin"), d4, b == a)
		}
		// 0 browser in P1 (R105-1(a); plan v9 §8 I1): D5's counter, which P0
		// asserted 0, is still 0 after the play and its decode. D5's stand-in
		// refuses every call; a refused call is still a browser sign-in here.
		if _, _, _, d5, _, _ := h.Counts(); d5 != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I1 A1-play: 0 browser sign-ins (D5) in P1, after P0's 0: %d", d5)
		}
		t.Log("I1-PLAY-OK")
	})
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// I2-I4.

// TestDDSonicComposedI2: the key request on c1 is withheld; the peer closes
// c1; the real reconnect completes; the SDK's ConnectionReplacedError{1,2}
// gives one same-session reopen through a full Player.NewStream.
func TestDDSonicComposedI2(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 22)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("I2 precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
		}
		// R105-1(b): D2's returned observation, a pass-through that holds
		// nothing, installed before the play.
		gen := s.generation()
		rec := composedRecordD2(h)
		_, d2Before, _, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I2-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I2 precondition: the key request was not observed on c1")
		}
		gen1 := composedGeneration(a)
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I2 precondition: peer close: %v", err)
		}
		c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
		if c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, gen1+1, 15*time.Second) != gen1+1 {
			t.Fatal("I2 precondition: the reconnect did not complete")
		}
		// The reopen's key request, on c2, answered.
		pkt, ok := c2.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 30*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I2: no reopen key request on c2")
		}
		// The first attempt's own result, as D2 returned it (R105-1(b)):
		// the reopen's request follows attempt 1's return, so it is recorded.
		// errors.As through its original wrapping to the accepted
		// ConnectionReplacedError{1,2}, an originError on A's build that is
		// not beforeWork, and no stream. Not injected; not the final result.
		if !composedReplacedOn(rec, d2Before+1, a, gen) {
			ev, recorded := rec.Returned(d2Before + 1)
			t.Errorf("I2: D2 attempt 1 returned the accepted ConnectionReplacedError{1,2} on A's build, not beforeWork, with no stream: recorded %t, stream %t, err %v", recorded, ev.Stream, ev.Err)
		}
		if err := c2.C.AnswerKey(pkt, tr.Key); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I2: answer: %v", err)
		}
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I2: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I2: the stream was not returned: %v", res.err)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("I2: the decoded samples are silent")
		}
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		_, b := h.Bundle(p)
		if b != a || a.ctx.Err() != nil || d3 != 2 || composedKeyWrites(h, 0) != 1 || composedKeyWrites(h, 1) != 1 || h.Decisions("begin") != 1 || len(d4) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I2: the original bundle retained (same pointer, live ctx), 2 setups, key writes c1=1 c2=1, 1 recovery, 0 rebuilds: same %t, ctx %v, setups %d, key writes c1=%d c2=%d, recoveries %d, rebuilds %v", b == a, a.ctx.Err(), d3, composedKeyWrites(h, 0), composedKeyWrites(h, 1), h.Decisions("begin"), d4)
		}
		t.Log("I2-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI3: extended-metadata is held after its receipt while
// the caller is live; the reconnect completes before the release; then one
// key write, on c2.
func TestDDSonicComposedI3(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 23)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		_, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("I3 precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
		}
		arrived, release := h.fx.Hold("metadata")
		h.OnRelease(release)
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I3-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(arrived, 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I3 precondition: extended-metadata was not received")
		}
		gen1 := composedGeneration(a)
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I3 precondition: peer close: %v", err)
		}
		c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
		if c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, gen1+1, 15*time.Second) != gen1+1 {
			t.Fatal("I3 precondition: the reconnect did not complete before the release")
		}
		if k1, k2 := composedKeyWrites(h, 0), composedKeyWrites(h, 1); k1 != 0 || k2 != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("I3 precondition: 0 key packets before the release: c1=%d c2=%d", k1, k2)
		}
		release()
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I3: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I3: NewStreamer: %v", res.err)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("I3: the decoded samples are silent")
		}
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		_, b := h.Bundle(p)
		if composedKeyWrites(h, 0) != 0 || composedKeyWrites(h, 1) != 1 || d3 != 1 || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || len(d4) != 0 || b != a {
			t.Errorf("I3: 1 key write on c2 (stamp 2), 0 on c1, 1 setup, 0 recoveries, 0 retirements: c1=%d c2=%d, setups %d, recoveries %d, rebuilds %v, same bundle %t", composedKeyWrites(h, 0), composedKeyWrites(h, 1), d3, h.Decisions("begin"), d4, b == a)
		}
		t.Log("I3-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI4: after a real answered key on c1, (a) storage-resolve
// or (b) chunk 0 is held; the reconnect completes; release. Controls:
// storage-resolve 500, and chunk 0 403 four times, are final.
func TestDDSonicComposedI4(t *testing.T) {
	held := func(t *testing.T, n byte, holdKey func(tr *composedTrack) string) {
		tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
		withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
			h.fx.Add(tr)
			p := h.Provider()
			p0(t, h, p)
			h.Phase("P1")
			_, a := h.Bundle(p)
			c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
			if a == nil || c1 == nil {
				t.Fatal("I4 precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
			}
			arrived, release := h.fx.Hold(holdKey(tr))
			h.OnRelease(release)
			answerKeys(h, tr)
			out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I4-play", p, tr.URI())
			if _, ok := composedWithin(arrived, 15*time.Second); !ok {
				t.Fatal("I4 precondition: the held request was not received")
			}
			if composedKeyWrites(h, 0) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("I4 precondition: a real answered key on c1 before the hold: key writes on c1 %d", composedKeyWrites(h, 0))
			}
			gen1 := composedGeneration(a)
			if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("I4 precondition: peer close: %v", err)
			}
			if c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second); c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, gen1+1, 15*time.Second) != gen1+1 {
				t.Fatal("I4 precondition: the reconnect did not complete")
			}
			release()
			res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
			if !ok {
				t.Fatal("I4: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
			}
			if res.s != nil {
				h.KeepCloser(res.s)
			}
			if res.err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("I4: the stream was not returned: %v", res.err)
			}
			if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
				t.Error("I4: the decoded samples are silent")
			}
			_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
			_, b := h.Bundle(p)
			if d3 != 1 || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || len(d4) != 0 || b != a {
				t.Errorf("I4: 1 setup, 0 recoveries, 0 retirements: setups %d, recoveries %d, rebuilds %v, same bundle %t", d3, h.Decisions("begin"), d4, b == a)
			}
			t.Log("I4-OK")
		})
	}
	final := func(t *testing.T, n byte, arm func(h *composedHarness, tr *composedTrack), check func(h *composedHarness, tr *composedTrack) error) {
		tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
		withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
			h.fx.Add(tr)
			answerKeys(h, tr)
			p := h.Provider()
			p0(t, h, p)
			h.Phase("P1")
			arm(h, tr)
			res, ok := composedWithin(composedOpenAsync(h, "I4-control", p, tr.URI()), 45*time.Second)
			if !ok {
				t.Fatal("I4 control: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
			}
			if res.s != nil {
				h.KeepCloser(res.s)
			}
			if res.err == nil || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 {
				t.Errorf("I4 control: final, with 0 recoveries: err %v, recoveries %d", res.err, h.Decisions("begin"))
			}
			if err := check(h, tr); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
			t.Logf("I4-CONTROL-FINAL %v (storage-resolve requests %d, CDN chunk-0 requests %d)", res.err, h.router.Count("P1", "A5"), len(h.fx.CDN()))
		})
	}
	t.Run("storage-held", func(t *testing.T) { held(t, 41, func(*composedTrack) string { return "storage" }) })
	t.Run("cdn-held", func(t *testing.T) {
		held(t, 42, func(tr *composedTrack) string { return fmt.Sprintf("cdn/%s/0", tr.FileHex()) })
	})
	t.Run("storage-500", func(t *testing.T) {
		final(t, 43, func(h *composedHarness, _ *composedTrack) { h.fx.SetStorageStatus(500) },
			func(*composedHarness, *composedTrack) error { return nil })
	})
	t.Run("cdn-403", func(t *testing.T) {
		final(t, 44, func(h *composedHarness, tr *composedTrack) { h.fx.SetCDNStatus(tr.FileHex(), 403) },
			func(h *composedHarness, tr *composedTrack) error {
				n := 0
				for _, rec := range h.fx.CDN() {
					if rec.File == tr.FileHex() && rec.Chunk == 0 && rec.Status == 403 {
						n++
					}
				}
				if n != 4 {
					return fmt.Errorf("I4 control: chunk 0 answered 403 four times (the SDK's retries), got %d", n)
				}
				return nil
			})
	})
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// I5-D and I5-O (plan v9 §6.1).

// TestDDSonicComposedI5Direct is I5-D's W/C/R/N/L sequence (E-direct).
func TestDDSonicComposedI5Direct(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 25)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("I5-D precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
		}
		d1Before, _, _, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		// W: the open runs on A; its key request is received on c1.
		ctx, cancel := h.Context()
		type direct struct {
			err error
		}
		out := make(chan direct, 1)
		h.Go("I5D-open", func() {
			st, sc, err := s.NewStream(ctx, tr.ID, 320)
			if err == nil {
				sc()
				releaseDecoder(st.Source)
			}
			out <- direct{err}
		})
		pkt, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I5-D W: the key request was not received on c1")
		}
		if recs, q, _ := composedKeyState(a); recs != 1 || q != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("I5-D W: D7 on A: 1 record, an empty writer queue: records %d, queue %d", recs, q)
		}
		// C: the test cancels its context.
		cancel()
		r, ok := composedWithin(out, 5*time.Second)
		if !ok || !errors.Is(r.err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Fatalf("I5-D C: NewStream returns context.Canceled: returned %t, err %v", ok, r.err)
		}
		// The worker's two positive facts (R59-1), under ONE deadline, the
		// declared 1 s worker budget: D3's join first (its Done precedes the
		// worker's deferred openHook), then a bounded poll, checked at least
		// once, for the recorded openHook("worker-before-publish"). Nothing
		// orders either before the caller's result; neither wait is reset.
		//
		// R72-1, the owners' limited oracle timing revision of v9 §6.1's C:
		// the outer return may precede record removal; removal is asserted
		// once the setup worker has returned. NewStream's cancellation does
		// not join its pending worker, and the SDK request's record leaves
		// the table when that request returns, inside the worker, before D3's
		// Done and the worker's openHook. So the D7 snapshot is taken only
		// after both worker facts, still before R. This is NOT the original
		// immediate guarantee: a record may be live between the outer return
		// and the worker's return, and nothing here says otherwise.
		workerBy := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
		joined := waitGroupWithin(&h.d3wg, time.Until(workerBy))
		event := h.EventSeq("open:worker-before-publish") > 0
		for !event && time.Now().Before(workerBy) {
			time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
			event = h.EventSeq("open:worker-before-publish") > 0
		}
		// R106-1: both facts are accepted only if both were observed before the
		// same workerBy, checked once after both observations. A fact first
		// observed after it fails here: a late observation, not proof that the
		// worker returned late. The first event sample is still taken when no
		// time is left; the deadline is neither reset nor widened.
		onTime := time.Now().Before(workerBy)
		workerReturned := joined && event && onTime
		recs, q, _ := composedKeyState(a)
		if recs != 0 || q != 0 || !workerReturned {
			t.Errorf("I5-D C (limited oracle timing revision R72-1: outer return may precede record removal; removal asserted once the setup worker has returned): the worker has returned within the one 1 s (D3 joined %t, worker-before-publish recorded %t, both observed before the 1 s deadline %t, worker returned %t), and then A's record table and writer queue are empty: records %d, queue %d", joined, event, onTime, workerReturned, recs, q)
		}
		keysAtC := composedKeyWrites(h, 0)
		// R: the peer closes c1; c2 and login 2 follow; no answer is sent.
		gen1 := composedGeneration(a)
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I5-D R: peer close: %v", err)
		}
		c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
		if c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, gen1+1, 15*time.Second) != gen1+1 {
			t.Fatal("I5-D R: the reconnect did not complete")
		}
		// N: 3 s with no play, no answer and no harness action (§6.1).
		time.Sleep(3 * time.Second)
		recs, q, u0 := composedKeyState(a)
		_, b := h.Bundle(p)
		d1, _, _, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if recs != 0 || q != 0 || b != a || a.ctx.Err() != nil || composedAPDoneOf(a) || len(d4) != 0 || d1 != d1Before ||
			h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || h.Decisions("before-wait") != 0 || h.Detaches("publish") != 0 || h.Detaches("close") != 0 ||
			composedKeyWrites(h, 0) != keysAtC || composedKeyWrites(h, 1) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I5-D N: A healthy and no future play: records %d, queue %d, same bundle %t, ctx %v, AP done %t, D4 %v, D1 %d->%d, decisions %d, detaches %d, key packets since C c1 %d c2 %d",
				recs, q, b == a, a.ctx.Err(), composedAPDoneOf(a), d4, d1Before, d1, h.Decisions("begin"), h.Detaches("publish")+h.Detaches("close"), composedKeyWrites(h, 0)-keysAtC, composedKeyWrites(h, 1))
		}
		// N, continued (R51-1): A's users are 0. The cancelled open's actual
		// reference on A (b.users, released when its whole setup worker
		// exits, S/playback_ddsonic.go:319) is joined here, bounded, while A
		// is still current and healthy and before any late answer or next
		// play. No new user is admitted meanwhile: no open is started, which
		// D2 and D3 confirm. This is separate from C's D3 completion.
		_, d2N, d3N, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		usersJoined := waitGroupWithin(&a.users, composedJoin)
		_, d2U, d3U, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		_, bU := h.Bundle(p)
		t.Logf("I5D-USERS expected A.users joined (0) with D2+0 D3+0, A current and live; observed joined %t, D2+%d, D3+%d, A current %t, A ctx %v", usersJoined, d2U-d2N, d3U-d3N, bU == a, a.ctx.Err())
		if !usersJoined || d2U != d2N || d3U != d3N || bU != a || a.ctx.Err() != nil || composedAPDoneOf(a) {
			t.Errorf("I5-D N: A's users are 0 while A is current and healthy, with no new user admitted: joined %t, D2 +%d, D3 +%d, A current %t, A ctx %v, A AP done %t", usersJoined, d2U-d2N, d3U-d3N, bU == a, a.ctx.Err(), composedAPDoneOf(a))
		}
		t.Log("I5D-N-OK")
		// L-late: F-AP answers the cancelled sequence on c2.
		if err := c2.C.AnswerKey(pkt, tr.Key); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I5-D L-late: answer: %v", err)
		}
		var u uint64
		for end := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second); time.Now().Before(end); time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond) {
			if recs, _, u = composedKeyState(a); u == u0+1 {
				break
			}
		}
		if u != u0+1 || recs != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I5-D L-late: A's unknown-answer count +1, the table unchanged: unknown %d -> %d, records %d", u0, u, recs)
		}
		// L-next: a new E-direct open on A, with its own sequence and answer
		// (R105-1(c)): F-AP answers only a request naming the track's file.
		seq0, okSeq0 := composedKeySeq(pkt)
		composedAnswerKeysFor(h, tr)
		_, _, d3Before, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		ctx2, _ := h.Context()
		st, sc, err := s.NewStream(ctx2, tr.ID, 320)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I5-D L-next: %v", err)
		}
		next := newSpotifyStreamer(st, sc)
		h.KeepCloser(next)
		// The actual next request, received on c2: the track's file and gid,
		// a sequence other than the cancelled one, the only key request on
		// c2; its answer matched its own record, so A's unknown-answer count
		// is still L-late's u0+1 and the table is empty again.
		pkt2, ok2 := c2.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 5*time.Second)
		seq2, okSeq2 := composedKeySeq(pkt2)
		gidOK := len(pkt2.Payload) >= 36 && bytes.Equal(pkt2.Payload[20:36], tr.ID.Id())
		recs, _, u = composedKeyState(a)
		if !ok2 || !okSeq0 || !okSeq2 || seq2 == seq0 || !composedKeyFor(pkt2, tr) || !gidOK || composedKeyWrites(h, 1) != 1 || u != u0+1 || recs != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I5-D L-next: the next open's own key request on c2, for the track's file and gid, with a sequence other than the cancelled one, the only key request on c2, its answer matched to its own record: received %t, file %t, gid %t, cancelled sequence %d (%t), next %d (%t), key requests on c2 %d, unknown %d -> %d, records %d", ok2, composedKeyFor(pkt2, tr), gidOK, seq0, okSeq0, seq2, okSeq2, composedKeyWrites(h, 1), u0, u, recs)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, next, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("I5-D L-next: the decoded samples are silent")
		}
		if _, _, d3, _, _, _ := h.Counts(); d3 != d3Before+1 {
			t.Errorf("I5-D L-next: 1 setup, got %d", d3-d3Before)
		}
		t.Log("I5D-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI5Retired is I5-O's W/H/C-O/T/N-B/L-B sequence
// (E-outer, the retired origin).
func TestDDSonicComposedI5Retired(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 26)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("I5-O precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
		}
		// W: a provider play on A; its key request is received on c1.
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I5O-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I5-O W: the key request was not received on c1")
		}
		if recs, _, _ := composedKeyState(a); recs != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("I5-O W: D7 on A: 1 record, got %d", recs)
		}
		// H: a real build B, published through the real publish, held at
		// detachHook("publish"), then released.
		atDetach, releaseDetach := make(chan *playback, 1), make(chan struct{})
		h.OnDetach(func(point string) {
			if point != "publish" {
				return
			}
			_, b := h.Bundle(p)
			atDetach <- b
			<-releaseDetach
		})
		h.OnRelease(func() {
			select {
			case <-releaseDetach:
			default:
				close(releaseDetach)
			}
		})
		h.Phase("P-H")
		// R51-2: B's constructor interval, the one serialized P-H build,
		// from here to its successful return below.
		scH0 := composedSCNow(h, "P-H")
		d1H0 := len(h.D1Calls())
		bctx, _ := h.Context()
		built := make(chan error, 1)
		h.Go("I5O-build", func() { built <- s.reconnectPlayback(bctx, s.generation()) })
		b, ok := composedWithin(atDetach, 30*time.Second)
		if !ok || b == nil || b == a {
			t.Fatalf("I5-O H: a real build B was not published (at detach: %t, B differs from A: %t)", ok, b != a)
		}
		close(releaseDetach)
		h.OnDetach(nil)
		if err, ok := composedWithin(built, 30*time.Second); !ok || err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I5-O H: the build: returned %t, %v", ok, err)
		}
		var callB *composedD1Call
		if calls := h.D1Calls(); len(calls) == d1H0+1 {
			callB = calls[d1H0]
		}
		// R60-1: B's after-SC snapshot is read only after D10 has published
		// the authenticated connection of B's OWN access point (F-AP counts
		// the login after its welcome, so the build can return first). A
		// constructor that did not return a session is left to
		// composedCheckSC's assertion.
		if callB != nil && callB.Returned() && callB.Sess != nil && composedConnOf(h, callB.Sess.Accesspoint(), 5*time.Second) == nil {
			t.Fatal("I5-O H: no D10 connection correlated with B's access point within 5 s")
		}
		composedCheckSC(t, "I5O-SC", scH0, composedSCNow(h, "P-H"), callB)
		d1H, _, _, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		// C-O: the play is fenced on retired A, final, with no recovery.
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 30*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I5-O C-O: NewStreamer did not return within 30 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		_, _, _, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if !errors.Is(res.err, errSessionChanged) || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || len(d4) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I5-O C-O: NewStreamer returns errSessionChanged, final, with 0 decisionHook(\"begin\") and 0 D4: err %v, begin %d, D4 %v", res.err, h.Decisions("begin"), d4)
		}
		// T: A torn down.
		emptied := false
		for end := time.Now().Add(20 * time.Second); !emptied && time.Now().Before(end); time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond) {
			recs, q, _ := composedKeyState(a)
			emptied = recs == 0 && q == 0 && composedAPDoneOf(a)
		}
		ended, byClient, _ := c1.Ended()
		if !c1.WaitEnded(20 * time.Second) {
			ended = false
		} else {
			ended, byClient, _ = c1.Ended()
		}
		tailsJoined := waitGroupWithin(&tails, 20*time.Second)
		if !emptied || !ended || !byClient || !tailsJoined || !h.ClosedLibrespot(a.sess) {
			t.Errorf("I5-O T: A's table and queue empty and its AP Done, its connection closed by the client, its tail joined, the real closeLibrespot ran for A: %t, %t, %t, %t, %t", emptied, ended, byClient, tailsJoined, h.ClosedLibrespot(a.sess))
		}
		// N-B: 3 s with no play or answer; the Session is on B.
		time.Sleep(3 * time.Second)
		_, cur := h.Bundle(p)
		recs, q, _ := composedKeyState(b)
		d1, _, _, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if cur != b || b.ctx.Err() != nil || composedAPDoneOf(b) || recs != 0 || q != 0 || len(d4) != 0 || d1 != d1H {
			t.Errorf("I5-O N-B: B preserved: on B %t, ctx %v, AP done %t, records %d, queue %d, D4 %v, D1 since H %d", cur == b, b.ctx.Err(), composedAPDoneOf(b), recs, q, d4, d1-d1H)
		}
		// L-B: a new provider play plays on B.
		h.Phase("P1")
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		_, _, d3Before, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		cb := h.ap.Conn(1, 5*time.Second)
		if cb == nil {
			t.Fatal("I5-O L-B: no connection for B")
		}
		lb, ok := composedWithin(composedOpenAsync(h, "I5O-next", p, tr.URI()), 45*time.Second)
		if !ok || lb.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I5-O L-B: the play on B: returned %t, %v", ok, lb.err)
		}
		h.KeepCloser(lb.s)
		if last := readSamples(t, lb.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("I5-O L-B: the decoded samples are silent")
		}
		if _, _, d3, _, _, _ := h.Counts(); d3 != d3Before+1 || cb.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 1 {
			t.Errorf("I5-O L-B: 1 setup on B, a key on B's connection: setups %d, key writes on B %d", d3-d3Before, cb.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey))
		}
		t.Log("I5O-OK")
	})
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// L1a-L5: real accepted-stream I/O and disposal, prefetch-aware (plan v9
// §6.2).

// composedMP3Timing is the 6.5-chunk MP3 fixture's ID3 tag length and byte
// rate, from its first frame header, so a chunk's byte offset maps to a
// decode position.
func composedMP3Timing(plain []byte) (tag, bytesPerSec int) {
	tag = 10 + (int(plain[6])<<21 | int(plain[7])<<14 | int(plain[8])<<7 | int(plain[9]))
	bitrates := map[uint32]int{1: 32, 2: 40, 3: 48, 4: 56, 5: 64, 6: 80, 7: 96, 8: 112, 9: 128, 10: 160, 11: 192, 12: 224, 13: 256, 14: 320}
	h := uint32(plain[tag])<<24 | uint32(plain[tag+1])<<16 | uint32(plain[tag+2])<<8 | uint32(plain[tag+3])
	return tag, bitrates[(h>>12)&0xf] * 125
}

// composedChunkStart is the decode position, in samples, at which chunk k's
// first byte is decoded.
func composedChunkStart(tr *composedTrack, k int) int {
	tag, rate := composedMP3Timing(tr.Plain)
	return (k*composedChunk - tag) * 44100 / rate
}

// composedCDNRec is the first CDN record of file's chunk, if any.
func composedCDNRec(h *composedHarness, file string, chunk int) *composedCDNRecord {
	for _, rec := range h.fx.CDN() {
		if rec.File == file && rec.Chunk == chunk {
			rec := rec
			return &rec
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// composedWaitReceipt waits up to d for the receipt waiting at the hold on
// key, and returns its ledger position.
func composedWaitReceipt(h *composedHarness, key string, d time.Duration) (int, bool) {
	for end := time.Now().Add(d); ; time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond) {
		if pos, ok := h.fx.WaitingReceipt(key); ok {
			return pos, true
		}
		if time.Now().After(end) {
			return -1, false
		}
	}
}

// composedL1aOpen is L1a's chronology: chunk 1's prefetch, started during
// setup, is held when it arrives, and the open is held at
// openHook("caller-before-accept") until that arrival is positively
// observed. It returns the accepted stream, chunk 1's hold key and its
// release.
func composedL1aOpen(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, p *SpotifyProvider, tr *composedTrack) (composedOpen, string, func()) {
	t.Helper()
	key := fmt.Sprintf("cdn/%s/1", tr.FileHex())
	arrived, release := h.fx.Hold(key)
	h.OnRelease(release)
	var arrivedBeforeAccept bool
	h.OnOpen(func(point string) {
		if point != "caller-before-accept" {
			return
		}
		select {
		case <-arrived:
			arrivedBeforeAccept = true
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		}
	})
	res, ok := composedWithin(composedOpenAsync(h, "L1-open", p, tr.URI()), 45*time.Second)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("L1: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
	}
	if res.err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("L1: NewStreamer: %v", res.err)
	}
	h.KeepCloser(res.s)
	h.OnOpen(nil)
	select {
	case <-arrived:
	default:
		t.Fatal("L1a precondition: chunk 1's request had not arrived when NewStreamer returned (a failure, never a pass)")
	}
	if !arrivedBeforeAccept {
		t.Fatal("L1a precondition: chunk 1's request had not arrived while the open was held before acceptance (a failure, never a pass)")
	}
	return res, key, release
}

// composedL1aCheck is L1a's required observation, after the release: chunk
// 1's held request completed 206 on its live context, and samples decoded
// beyond chunk 0's byte span are non-silent.
func composedL1aCheck(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, res composedOpen, tr *composedTrack, key string, release func()) {
	t.Helper()
	time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond) // §6.2 L1a: 500 ms after the setup ended
	if at, ended := h.fx.HoldCtxEnded(key, 0); ended {
		t.Fatalf("L1a: the held chunk-1 request's context ended at %v, after setup", at)
	}
	release()
	last := readSamples(t, res.s, composedChunkStart(tr, 1)+5*44100-res.s.Position())
	if !nonSilent(last) {
		t.Error("L1a: the samples decoded beyond chunk 0 are silent")
	}
	c1 := composedCDNRec(h, tr.FileHex(), 1)
	if c1 == nil || c1.Status != 206 || c1.Completed.IsZero() || !c1.CtxEnded.IsZero() {
		t.Errorf("L1a: chunk 1's held request did not complete 206 on its live context: %+v", c1)
	}
}

// TestDDSonicComposedL1a: a held in-flight request across setup
// cancellation.
func TestDDSonicComposedL1a(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 51)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		res, key, release := composedL1aOpen(t, h, p, tr)
		composedL1aCheck(t, h, res, tr, key, release)
		t.Log("L1A-OK")
	})
}

// composedL1b is L1b's chronology after L1a's open: chunk 4 not requested
// when NewStreamer returned (asserted); release chunk 1; read on; chunk 4's
// request arrives after NewStreamer returned, answered 206 on the live
// context, and decoding proceeds into chunk 4.
func composedL1b(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, res composedOpen, tr *composedTrack, key string, release func()) {
	t.Helper()
	var at4 []time.Time
	for _, rec := range h.fx.CDN() {
		if rec.File == tr.FileHex() && rec.Chunk == 4 && !rec.Arrived.After(res.at) {
			at4 = append(at4, rec.Arrived)
		}
	}
	if len(at4) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("L1b precondition: chunk 4 was requested before NewStreamer returned (STOP 9): %v", at4)
	}
	requested := map[int]bool{}
	for _, rec := range h.fx.CDN() {
		if rec.File == tr.FileHex() {
			requested[rec.Chunk] = true
		}
	}
	t.Logf("L1B-PRE-OK chunks requested during setup %v", requested)
	release()
	if last := readSamples(t, res.s, composedChunkStart(tr, 4)+44100-res.s.Position()); !nonSilent(last) {
		t.Error("L1b: the samples decoded into chunk 4 are silent")
	}
	c4 := composedCDNRec(h, tr.FileHex(), 4)
	if c4 == nil || !c4.Arrived.After(res.at) || c4.Status != 206 || c4.Completed.IsZero() || !c4.CtxEnded.IsZero() {
		t.Errorf("L1b: chunk 4's request arrived after NewStreamer returned and was answered 206 on the stream's live context: %+v (returned %v)", c4, res.at)
	}
	if pos := res.s.Position(); pos < composedChunkStart(tr, 4) {
		t.Errorf("L1b: decoding proceeds into chunk 4: position %d, chunk 4 starts at %d", pos, composedChunkStart(tr, 4))
	}
}

// TestDDSonicComposedL1b: a new request after setup cancellation.
func TestDDSonicComposedL1b(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 52)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		res, key, release := composedL1aOpen(t, h, p, tr)
		composedL1b(t, h, res, tr, key, release)
		t.Log("L1B-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedL2: after L1b, chunk 5's request is held; the checked
// cut; Close. The held request's context ends; zero CDN receipts for the
// file after the cut through T5r (W2); a next open, on a distinct track,
// plays on the same bundle.
func TestDDSonicComposedL2(t *testing.T) {
	tr, next := composedMP3Track(t, 53), composedMP3Track(t, 54)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		h.fx.Add(next)
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		_, a := h.Bundle(p)
		key5 := fmt.Sprintf("cdn/%s/5", tr.FileHex())
		_, release5 := h.fx.Hold(key5)
		h.OnRelease(release5)
		res, key, release := composedL1aOpen(t, h, p, tr)
		composedL1b(t, h, res, tr, key, release)
		// After L1b: chunk 5's request is held (a receipt).
		pos5, ok := composedWaitReceipt(h, key5, 10*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("L2 precondition: chunk 5's request is not held (STOP 9)")
		}
		// The subject: the checked cut, then Close.
		cut, err := h.Cut(tr.FileHex(), pos5, 5*time.Second)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("L2 precondition: the checked cut (STOP 9): %v", err)
		}
		t.Log("L2-CUT-OK")
		_ = res.s.Close()
		h.Watch(cut)
		// W3, before this row returns: the held request's context ends.
		if !h.fx.AwaitCtxEnded(pos5, 5*time.Second) {
			t.Fatal("L2: the held chunk-5 request's server-side context did not end within 5 s of Close")
		}
		t.Log("L2-HELD-ENDED")
		closes := int32(-1)
		if decs := h.Decoders(); len(decs) == 1 {
			closes = decs[0].Closes()
		}
		// The Session and bundle are unaffected: a next open, on a distinct
		// fixture track, plays.
		answerKeys(h, next)
		nr, ok := composedWithin(composedOpenAsync(h, "L2-next", p, next.URI()), 45*time.Second)
		if !ok || nr.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("L2: the next open: returned %t, %v", ok, nr.err)
		}
		h.KeepCloser(nr.s)
		if last := readSamples(t, nr.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("L2: the next open's samples are silent")
		}
		if _, b := h.Bundle(p); b != a || a.ctx.Err() != nil || composedAPDoneOf(a) {
			t.Errorf("L2: the Session and bundle are unaffected: same bundle %t, ctx %v, AP done %t", b == a, a.ctx.Err(), composedAPDoneOf(a))
		}
		t.Logf("L2-DECODER-CLOSES-RECORDED %d (accepted-stream Close does not close the decoder: the disclosed contract, recorded)", closes)
	})
}

// composedReadyHold holds an E-direct open at openHook("caller-before-accept")
// with its real ready result, until proceed is called; reached is closed
// when it gets there. proceed is idempotent, and T1 calls it too.
func composedReadyHold(h *composedHarness) (reached chan struct{}, proceed func()) {
	reached, release := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	var once, pOnce sync.Once
	h.OnOpen(func(point string) {
		if point != "caller-before-accept" {
			return
		}
		once.Do(func() { close(reached) })
		<-release
	})
	proceed = func() { pOnce.Do(func() { close(release) }) }
	h.OnRelease(proceed)
	return reached, proceed
}

// composedDisposal is L3 and L4: an E-direct open reaches
// openHook("caller-before-accept") with a real ready MP3 stream while its
// chunk-1 prefetch is held; the checked cut; then subject (the caller's
// cancellation, or a real owner change); release. want is the open's error.
func composedDisposal(t *testing.T, n byte, want error, subject func(h *composedHarness, s *Session, cancel context.CancelFunc)) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		s, _ := h.Bundle(p)
		key1 := fmt.Sprintf("cdn/%s/1", tr.FileHex())
		_, release1 := h.fx.Hold(key1)
		h.OnRelease(release1)
		reached, proceed := composedReadyHold(h)
		ctx, cancel := h.Context()
		out := make(chan error, 1)
		h.Go("L-disposal-open", func() {
			st, sc, err := s.NewStream(ctx, tr.ID, 320)
			if err == nil { // not expected; never leaked
				sc()
				releaseDecoder(st.Source)
				err = errors.New("a stream was returned")
			}
			out <- err
		})
		if _, ok := composedWithin(reached, 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("L3/L4 precondition: the open did not reach caller-before-accept with a ready result (STOP 9)")
		}
		pos1, ok := composedWaitReceipt(h, key1, 5*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("L3/L4 precondition: the stream's chunk-1 prefetch is not held at the CDN (STOP 9)")
		}
		decs := h.Decoders()
		if len(decs) != 1 || decs[0].Format != "mp3" || decs[0].Closes() != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("L3/L4 precondition: D3 holds one counted real MP3 decoder, not closed: %d decoders", len(decs))
		}
		select {
		case err := <-out:
			t.Fatalf("L3/L4 precondition: a result before the release: %v", err)
		default:
		}
		cut, err := h.Cut(tr.FileHex(), pos1, 5*time.Second)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("L3/L4 precondition: the checked cut (STOP 9): %v", err)
		}
		t.Log("L-DISPOSAL-PRE-OK")
		subject(h, s, cancel)
		proceed()
		err, ok = composedWithin(out, 10*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("L3/L4: NewStream did not return within 10 s of the release")
		}
		h.Watch(cut)
		if !h.fx.AwaitCtxEnded(pos1, 5*time.Second) {
			t.Error("L3/L4: the held chunk-1 request's server-side context did not end within 5 s")
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, want) || decs[0].Closes() != 1 {
			t.Errorf("L3/L4: NewStream = %v and D3's counted real decoder Close = exactly 1, no stream returned: err %v, closes %d", want, err, decs[0].Closes())
		}
		t.Log("L-DISPOSAL-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedL3: a ready stream rejected by the caller context.
func TestDDSonicComposedL3(t *testing.T) {
	composedDisposal(t, 55, context.Canceled, func(_ *composedHarness, _ *Session, cancel context.CancelFunc) { cancel() })
}

// TestDDSonicComposedL4: a ready stream rejected by an owner change: a real
// B is published (P-H) at the hook.
func TestDDSonicComposedL4(t *testing.T) {
	composedDisposal(t, 56, errSessionChanged, func(h *composedHarness, s *Session, _ context.CancelFunc) {
		h.Phase("P-H")
		bctx, _ := h.Context()
		if err := s.reconnectPlayback(bctx, s.generation()); err != nil {
			h.t.Fatalf("L4: the real build B: %v", err)
		}
		h.Phase("P1")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedL5: cancelled pre-header and body requests (E-direct).
func TestDDSonicComposedL5(t *testing.T) {
	run := func(t *testing.T, n byte, holdKey func(tr *composedTrack) string, cutFile bool) {
		tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
		withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
			h.fx.Add(tr)
			answerKeys(h, tr)
			p := h.Provider()
			p0(t, h, p)
			h.Phase("P1")
			s, a := h.Bundle(p)
			key := holdKey(tr)
			_, release := h.fx.Hold(key)
			h.OnRelease(release)
			ctx, cancel := h.Context()
			out := make(chan error, 1)
			h.Go("L5-open", func() {
				st, sc, err := s.NewStream(ctx, tr.ID, 320)
				if err == nil {
					sc()
					releaseDecoder(st.Source)
					err = errors.New("a stream was returned")
				}
				out <- err
			})
			pos, ok := composedWaitReceipt(h, key, 15*time.Second)
			if !ok {
				t.Fatal("L5 precondition: the held request was not received")
			}
			var cut composedCut
			if cutFile {
				c, err := h.Cut(tr.FileHex(), pos, 5*time.Second)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("L5 (b) precondition: the checked cut (STOP 9): %v", err)
				}
				cut = c
			}
			cancel()
			err, ok := composedWithin(out, 10*time.Second)
			if !ok {
				t.Fatal("L5: NewStream did not return within 10 s of the cancellation")
			}
			if cutFile {
				h.Watch(cut)
			}
			handlerReturned := false
			for end := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second); !handlerReturned && time.Now().Before(end); time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond) {
				led := h.fx.Ledger()
				handlerReturned = !led[pos].Running
			}
			ctxEnded := h.fx.AwaitCtxEnded(pos, 5*time.Second)
			recs, q, _ := composedKeyState(a)
			if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || !ctxEnded || !handlerReturned || !h.router.waitIdle(5*time.Second) || recs != 0 || q != 0 {
				t.Errorf("L5: the held request sees its context end and its handler returns; the router join completes; NewStream = the context's error; the record table is empty: err %v, ctx ended %t, handler returned %t, records %d, queue %d", err, ctxEnded, handlerReturned, recs, q)
			}
			t.Log("L5-OK")
		})
	}
	t.Run("pre-header", func(t *testing.T) { run(t, 57, func(*composedTrack) string { return "metadata" }, false) })
	t.Run("body", func(t *testing.T) {
		run(t, 58, func(tr *composedTrack) string { return fmt.Sprintf("cdnbody/%s/0", tr.FileHex()) }, true)
	})
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// L6: teardown after real setup workers (plan v9 §6.2, the L6 table; the
// §3.2 counts; the §6.3 boundary). Each case names the object ddsonic owns
// and observes its real teardown. A server-side close, a missing goroutine
// or finalization is never credited as client teardown, and nothing is
// claimed about the SDK's unreturned partial constructor (§6.3). No case
// holds an HTTP request.

// composedPlayOnce is a completed real play on the current bundle: tr opened
// through the provider (E-outer), 5 s decoded and non-silent, then the
// accepted stream closed.
func composedPlayOnce(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, p *SpotifyProvider, tr *composedTrack, name string) {
	t.Helper()
	answerKeys(h, tr)
	res, ok := composedWithin(composedOpenAsync(h, name, p, tr.URI()), 45*time.Second)
	if !ok || res.err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: the play: returned %t, %v", name, ok, res.err)
	}
	h.KeepCloser(res.s)
	if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
		t.Errorf("%s: the decoded samples are silent", name)
	}
	_ = res.s.Close()
}

// composedConnOf is the D10 connection a dialled: the one whose server-side
// remote address is a's current local address (plan v9 §2.7, D10 (c)),
// waited for up to d; nil when there is none.
func composedConnOf(h *composedHarness, a *ap.Accesspoint, d time.Duration) *ap.DDSonicComposedConn {
	la := ap.DDSonicComposedLocalAddr(a)
	if la == "" {
		return nil
	}
	for end := time.Now().Add(d); ; time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond) {
		for _, c := range h.ap.Conns() {
			if c.Remote == la {
				return c
			}
		}
		if time.Now().After(end) {
			return nil
		}
	}
}

// composedClientClosed waits up to d for c's server-side read to end, and
// reports whether it ended and whether the client closed it while F-AP was
// open (D10 (c)).
func composedClientClosed(c *ap.DDSonicComposedConn, d time.Duration) (ended, byClient bool) {
	if c == nil || !c.WaitEnded(d) {
		return false, false
	}
	ended, byClient, _ = c.Ended()
	return ended, byClient
}

// composedSC is one constructor interval's observable counts (plan v9
// §3.2): the router's per-phase A1, A2, A3, A7 and A8, F-AP's accepted
// connections and logins, D1 and D5.
type composedSC struct{ A1, A2, A3, A7, A8, Accepted, Logins, D1, D5 int }

func (c composedSC) String() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("A1=%d A2=%d A3=%d A7=%d A8=%d accepted=%d logins=%d D1=%d D5=%d", c.A1, c.A2, c.A3, c.A7, c.A8, c.Accepted, c.Logins, c.D1, c.D5)
}

// composedSCNow reads the counts of composedSC now, in phase.
func composedSCNow(h *composedHarness, phase string) composedSC {
	r := h.router
	d1, _, _, d5, _, _ := h.Counts()
	return composedSC{r.Count(phase, "A1"), r.Count(phase, "A2"), r.Count(phase, "A3"), r.Count(phase, "A7"), r.Count(phase, "A8"), h.ap.Accepted(), h.ap.Logins(), d1, d5}
}

// composedSCWant is v9 §3.2's SC, a successful first-try constructor, with
// a silent build's character: no OAuth (A7), Web API (A8) or browser (D5).
var composedSCWant = composedSC{A1: 1, A2: 3, A3: 1, Accepted: 1, Logins: 1, D1: 1}

// composedCheckSC asserts one serialized constructor interval, from before
// to after, against the SC, with the interval's single D1 call returned
// with a session and no error. It logs the expected and observed values
// under marker first (R49-2).
func composedCheckSC(t *testing.T, marker string, before, after composedSC, call *composedD1Call) {
	t.Helper()
	composedCheckSCWant(t, marker, composedSCWant, before, after, call)
}

// composedSCStoredWant is v9 §3.2's stored startup (NewSessionSilent,
// newSessionFromStored; P0's profile): one SC with its intended silent token
// refresh, A7 ×1; no Web API (A8) or browser (D5). I22's newer build (G4).
var composedSCStoredWant = composedSC{A1: 1, A2: 3, A3: 1, A7: 1, Accepted: 1, Logins: 1, D1: 1}

// composedCheckSCWant is composedCheckSC against want.
func composedCheckSCWant(t *testing.T, marker string, want, before, after composedSC, call *composedD1Call) {
	t.Helper()
	got := composedSC{after.A1 - before.A1, after.A2 - before.A2, after.A3 - before.A3, after.A7 - before.A7, after.A8 - before.A8, after.Accepted - before.Accepted, after.Logins - before.Logins, after.D1 - before.D1, after.D5 - before.D5}
	returned := call != nil && call.Returned()
	withSess := returned && call.Sess != nil
	noErr := returned && call.Err == nil
	t.Logf("%s expected %s returned=true session=true error=nil; observed %s returned=%t session=%t error-nil=%t", marker, want, got, returned, withSess, noErr)
	if got != want || !returned || !withSess || !noErr {
		t.Errorf("%s: the constructor interval is one SC (plan v9 §3.2): expected %s, observed %s; D1 returned %t, with a session %t, no error %t", marker, want, got, returned, withSess, noErr)
	}
}

// composedWithinTrue polls cond every 10 ms for up to d.
func composedWithinTrue(d time.Duration, cond func() bool) bool {
	for end := time.Now().Add(d); ; time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond) {
		if cond() {
			return true
		}
		if time.Now().After(end) {
			return false
		}
	}
}

// TestDDSonicComposedL6Rebuild: a successful rebuild after a terminal
// origin (the I7 path), where the old bundle had a completed real worker.
// ddsonic owns the old, replaced bundle: the real closeLibrespot ran for it,
// D10 records its connection closed by the client while F-AP is open, its
// access point is Done and its tail joined; the new bundle is one SC.
func TestDDSonicComposedL6Rebuild(t *testing.T) {
	tr, tr2 := composedMP3Track(t, 61), composedMP3Track(t, 62)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		h.fx.Add(tr2)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("L6-Rebuild precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
		}
		// The old bundle has a completed real worker.
		composedPlayOnce(t, h, p, tr, "L6R-first")
		gen := s.generation()
		// A real terminal origin: A's next reconnect cannot succeed, its
		// connection is peer-closed, and new logins are refused until A's
		// access point is Done.
		h.Phase("P-H")
		undo := h.ap.F.Refuse()
		h.OnRelease(undo)
		ap.DDSonicContractForgetWelcome(a.sess.Accesspoint())
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("L6-Rebuild: the peer close: %v", err)
		}
		if !composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return composedAPDoneOf(a) }) {
			t.Fatal("L6-Rebuild precondition: the origin's access point did not become Done (STOP 9)")
		}
		undo()
		acc0, logins0 := h.ap.Accepted(), h.ap.Logins()
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		// The play: the real recovery rebuilds the origin's build and opens
		// the track once more.
		h.Phase("P2")
		answerKeys(h, tr2)
		res, ok := composedWithin(composedOpenAsync(h, "L6R-play", p, tr2.URI()), 45*time.Second)
		if !ok || res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("L6-Rebuild: the play after the terminal origin: returned %t, %v", ok, res.err)
		}
		h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("L6-Rebuild: the reopened play's samples are silent")
		}
		_ = res.s.Close()
		_, b := h.Bundle(p)
		d1n := len(h.D1Calls()) - d1Before
		_, _, _, d5, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		r := h.router
		counts := fmt.Sprintf("A1=%d A2=%d A3=%d A7=%d A8=%d", r.Count("P2", "A1"), r.Count("P2", "A2"), r.Count("P2", "A3"), r.Count("P2", "A7"), r.Count("P2", "A8"))
		accN, loginsN := h.ap.Accepted()-acc0, h.ap.Logins()-logins0
		var bErr error
		if b != nil {
			bErr = b.ctx.Err()
		}
		if b == nil || b == a || bErr != nil || len(d4) != 1 || d4[0] != gen || d1n != 1 || counts != "A1=1 A2=3 A3=1 A7=0 A8=0" || accN != 1 || loginsN != 1 || d5 != 0 {
			t.Errorf("L6-Rebuild: one rebuild with the origin's generation, one SC (§3.2): new bundle %t, its ctx %v, D4 %v (origin %d), D1 +%d, P2 %s, accepted +%d, logins +%d, D5 %d", b != nil && b != a, bErr, d4, gen, d1n, counts, accN, loginsN, d5)
		}
		// The old, replaced bundle is torn down.
		closed := composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return h.ClosedLibrespot(a.sess) })
		ended, byClient := composedClientClosed(c1, 20*time.Second)
		tailsJoined := waitGroupWithin(&tails, 20*time.Second)
		if !closed || !ended || !byClient || !composedAPDoneOf(a) || !tailsJoined {
			t.Errorf("L6-Rebuild: the replaced bundle torn down: closeLibrespot ran %t, its connection ended %t and closed by the client %t, its AP Done %t, its tail joined %t", closed, ended, byClient, composedAPDoneOf(a), tailsJoined)
		}
		_, _, at := c1.Ended()
		t.Logf("L6R-OBSERVED old connection ended at %s; P2 %s; D4 %v", at.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), counts, d4)
		t.Log("L6R-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedL6FailedAttempt: the current bundle A is healthy and
// has completed a play; a real sessionReconnect for A's generation while
// F-AP refuses new logins. ddsonic owns nothing new: the SDK constructor
// returned nil and an error. (i) A survives the failed attempt; (iii) the FR
// stage prefix of §3.2, observables only, with no client teardown of the
// unreturned partial object claimed (§6.3).
func TestDDSonicComposedL6FailedAttempt(t *testing.T) {
	tr, tr2 := composedMP3Track(t, 63), composedMP3Track(t, 64)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		h.fx.Add(tr2)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		if a == nil {
			t.Fatal("L6-FailedAttempt precondition: no bundle")
		}
		composedPlayOnce(t, h, p, tr, "L6F-first")
		acc0, logins0 := h.ap.Accepted(), h.ap.Logins()
		rl0, tk0 := composedAPGoroutines()
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		_, _, _, _, _, d4Before := h.Counts()
		h.Phase("P-H")
		undo := h.ap.F.Refuse()
		h.OnRelease(undo)
		ctx, _ := h.Context()
		gen := s.generation()
		err := sessionReconnect(s, ctx, gen)
		undo()
		rl1, tk1 := composedAPGoroutines()
		r := h.router
		prefix := fmt.Sprintf("A1=%d A2=%d A3=%d", r.Count("P-H", "A1"), r.Count("P-H", "A2"), r.Count("P-H", "A3"))
		calls := h.D1Calls()
		_, _, _, d5, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		_, cur := h.Bundle(p)
		// (i) no healthy-bundle drop after a failed attempt.
		if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "stored auth") || d5 != 0 || r.Count("P-H", "A7") != 0 || r.Count("P-H", "A8") != 0 || cur != a || a.ctx.Err() != nil || composedAPDoneOf(a) || len(d4) != len(d4Before)+1 {
			t.Errorf("L6-FailedAttempt (i): the reconnect returns the wrapped stored-auth error, 0 browser, 0 A7/A8, the Session still on A with A live and its AP not Done: err %v, D5 %d, A7 %d, A8 %d, on A %t, A ctx %v, A AP done %t, D4 %v", err, d5, r.Count("P-H", "A7"), r.Count("P-H", "A8"), cur == a, a.ctx.Err(), composedAPDoneOf(a), d4)
		}
		// (iii) the FR stage prefix: observables only.
		accN, loginsN := h.ap.Accepted()-acc0, h.ap.Logins()-logins0
		var sessNil, errSet, returned bool
		if len(calls) == d1Before+1 {
			c := calls[d1Before]
			returned, sessNil, errSet = c.Returned(), c.Sess == nil, c.Err != nil
		}
		if len(calls) != d1Before+1 || !returned || !sessNil || !errSet || prefix != "A1=1 A2=1 A3=0" || accN != 6 || loginsN != 0 || rl1 != rl0 || tk1 != tk0 {
			t.Errorf("L6-FailedAttempt (iii): the FR prefix (§3.2): D1 +%d (returned %t, no session %t, an error %t), %s, accepted +%d (want 6), logins +%d (want 0), recvLoop %d -> %d, pongAckTicker %d -> %d", len(calls)-d1Before, returned, sessNil, errSet, prefix, accN, loginsN, rl0, rl1, tk0, tk1)
		}
		// (i), continued: a next open on A plays.
		h.Phase("P1")
		_, _, d3Before, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		composedPlayOnce(t, h, p, tr2, "L6F-next")
		_, _, d3, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		if _, cur := h.Bundle(p); cur != a || d3 != d3Before+1 {
			t.Errorf("L6-FailedAttempt (i): the next open plays on A: on A %t, setups +%d", cur == a, d3-d3Before)
		}
		t.Logf("L6F-OBSERVED err %v; %s accepted +%d logins +%d", err, prefix, accN, loginsN)
		t.Log("L6F-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedL6RejectedBuild: a real silent rebuild for generation
// g completes its SDK session (an SC) and is held at beforeAccept (its first
// call); a second real build is published, so the Session is at g+1; on
// release, publish takes silent && s.gen != from and calls fresh.Close().
// ddsonic owns the completed, never-published fresh Session and its bundle.
func TestDDSonicComposedL6RejectedBuild(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 65)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		if a == nil {
			t.Fatal("L6-RejectedBuild precondition: no bundle")
		}
		composedPlayOnce(t, h, p, tr, "L6J-first")
		rl0, tk0 := composedAPGoroutines()
		g := s.generation()
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		// The fresh build is held at beforeAccept, its first call only.
		reached, release := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
		var once, relOnce sync.Once
		h.OnAccept(func(int) {
			first := false
			once.Do(func() {
				first = true
				close(reached)
			})
			if first {
				<-release
			}
		})
		proceed := func() { relOnce.Do(func() { close(release) }) }
		h.OnRelease(proceed)
		h.Phase("P-H")
		// R49-2: the fresh build's constructor interval runs alone, from
		// here to its beforeAccept hold.
		sc0 := composedSCNow(h, "P-H")
		ctx1, _ := h.Context()
		fresh := make(chan error, 1)
		h.Go("L6J-fresh", func() { fresh <- s.reconnectPlayback(ctx1, g) })
		if _, ok := composedWithin(reached, 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("L6-RejectedBuild precondition: the fresh build did not reach beforeAccept (STOP 9)")
		}
		calls := h.D1Calls()
		if len(calls) != d1Before+1 || !calls[d1Before].Returned() || calls[d1Before].Sess == nil {
			t.Fatal("L6-RejectedBuild precondition: the fresh build's SDK session did not complete (STOP 9)")
		}
		// R60-1: the fresh build's own D10 publication (the existing 5 s
		// observation, moved here) is observed before its SC1 snapshot, while
		// it is still held at beforeAccept and before build 2 is admitted.
		freshSess := calls[d1Before].Sess
		freshAP := freshSess.Accesspoint()
		fc := composedConnOf(h, freshAP, 5*time.Second)
		if fc == nil {
			t.Fatal("L6-RejectedBuild precondition: no D10 connection correlated with the fresh build's access point")
		}
		sc1 := composedSCNow(h, "P-H")
		composedCheckSC(t, "L6J-SC1", sc0, sc1, calls[d1Before])
		// A second real build is published: the Session moves to g+1. Its
		// constructor interval runs while the fresh build stays held at
		// beforeAccept (R49-2).
		ctx2, _ := h.Context()
		if err := s.reconnectPlayback(ctx2, g); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("L6-RejectedBuild precondition: the second build: %v", err)
		}
		var call2 *composedD1Call
		if calls := h.D1Calls(); len(calls) == d1Before+2 {
			call2 = calls[d1Before+1]
		}
		// R60-1: the second constructor's OWN D10 publication before its SC2
		// snapshot (the reconnect's result alone does not order the fixture's
		// login count). A constructor without a session is left to
		// composedCheckSC's assertion.
		if call2 != nil && call2.Returned() && call2.Sess != nil && composedConnOf(h, call2.Sess.Accesspoint(), 5*time.Second) == nil {
			t.Fatal("L6-RejectedBuild precondition: no D10 connection correlated with the second build's access point within 5 s")
		}
		sc2 := composedSCNow(h, "P-H")
		composedCheckSC(t, "L6J-SC2", sc1, sc2, call2)
		_, b2 := h.Bundle(p)
		if b2 == nil || b2 == a || s.generation() != g+1 {
			t.Fatalf("L6-RejectedBuild precondition: the second build was not published at g+1: new bundle %t, generation %d (g %d)", b2 != nil && b2 != a, s.generation(), g)
		}
		// Release the fresh build: publish rejects it, stale and silent.
		proceed()
		err, ok := composedWithin(fresh, 30*time.Second)
		closed := composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return h.ClosedLibrespot(freshSess) })
		ended, byClient := composedClientClosed(fc, 20*time.Second)
		freshDone := composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return ap.DDSonicComposedAPDone(freshAP) })
		tailsJoined := waitGroupWithin(&tails, 20*time.Second)
		// Its own goroutines, against the accounted baseline (one pair per
		// live AP), not global Q: the second build is deliberately live.
		var rl, tk int
		settled := composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool {
			rl, tk = composedAPGoroutines()
			return rl == rl0 && tk == tk0
		})
		_, cur := h.Bundle(p)
		if !ok || err != nil || cur != b2 || s.generation() != g+1 {
			t.Errorf("L6-RejectedBuild: the reconnect returns nil with nothing published, the Session on the second build: returned %t, %v, on the second build %t, generation %d", ok, err, cur == b2, s.generation())
		}
		if !closed || !ended || !byClient || !freshDone || !tailsJoined || !settled {
			t.Errorf("L6-RejectedBuild: the fresh build closed: closeLibrespot ran %t, its connection ended %t and closed by the client %t, its AP Done %t, tails joined %t, recvLoop/pongAckTicker back to %d/%d: %t (%d/%d)", closed, ended, byClient, freshDone, tailsJoined, rl0, tk0, settled, rl, tk)
		}
		h.OnAccept(nil)
		t.Log("L6J-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedL6AbandonedBuild: a real silent rebuild under a 2 s
// context; its SDK constructor completes (an SC, P-H) and the build is held
// at D11, which does not watch the context; runBuild returns the context
// error and marks it abandoned; on D11's release the worker's CAS fails and
// it calls closeBuilt. ddsonic owns the completed, abandoned build.
func TestDDSonicComposedL6AbandonedBuild(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 66)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		if a == nil {
			t.Fatal("L6-AbandonedBuild precondition: no bundle")
		}
		composedPlayOnce(t, h, p, tr, "L6A-first")
		g := s.generation()
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		_, _, _, _, d11Before, _ := h.Counts()
		hold := make(chan struct{})
		h.mu.Lock()
		h.d11hold = hold
		h.mu.Unlock()
		releaseD11 := func() {
			h.mu.Lock()
			if h.d11hold == hold {
				close(hold)
				h.d11hold = nil
			}
			h.mu.Unlock()
		}
		h.Phase("P-H")
		// R49-2: the build's constructor interval runs alone, from here to
		// its D11 hold.
		sc0 := composedSCNow(h, "P-H")
		hctx, _ := h.Context()
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(hctx, 2*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		start := time.Now()
		out := make(chan error, 1)
		h.Go("L6A-build", func() { out <- s.reconnectPlayback(ctx, g) })
		// R49-1: the completed constructor, held at the still-armed D11,
		// observed WHILE the 2 s context is live and the reconnect has not
		// returned. D11's counter and hold are read in one snapshot under
		// h.mu, where the seam counts its entry; the context and the result
		// are read after that snapshot, so a live context then means D11 was
		// entered before the deadline. An observation at or after expiry
		// fails this precondition; it never passes.
		var atD11, armed bool
		for end := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second); !atD11 && time.Now().Before(end); time.Sleep(time.Millisecond) {
			h.mu.Lock()
			atD11, armed = h.d11 == d11Before+1, h.d11hold == hold
			h.mu.Unlock()
		}
		ctxErr := ctx.Err()
		returned := len(out) != 0
		elapsed := time.Since(start)
		calls := h.D1Calls()
		if !atD11 || !armed || ctxErr != nil || returned || len(calls) != d1Before+1 || !calls[d1Before].Returned() || calls[d1Before].Sess == nil {
			t.Fatalf("L6-AbandonedBuild precondition (R49-1): the completed SDK constructor held at the armed D11 while the 2 s context is live and the reconnect has not returned: at D11 %t, armed %t, context %v, returned %t, D1 +%d, observed %v after the context began", atD11, armed, ctxErr, returned, len(calls)-d1Before, elapsed)
		}
		t.Logf("L6AB-HELD-LIVE context=live result=pending D1=+1 D11=+1 armed=true observed %v after the context began", elapsed)
		// R60-1: the late build's own D10 publication (the existing 5 s
		// observation, moved here) is observed before its SC snapshot. It
		// comes after the R49-1 live-and-held observation above, which it
		// neither replaces nor repeats; the hold stays armed and the 2 s
		// context is not restarted.
		lateSess := calls[d1Before].Sess
		lateAP := lateSess.Accesspoint()
		lc := composedConnOf(h, lateAP, 5*time.Second)
		if lc == nil {
			t.Fatal("L6-AbandonedBuild precondition: no D10 connection correlated with the late build's access point")
		}
		sc1 := composedSCNow(h, "P-H")
		composedCheckSC(t, "L6AB-SC", sc0, sc1, calls[d1Before])
		// The 2 s pass while the SAME hold stays armed: runBuild returns the
		// context error; nothing published; the late session not yet closed.
		err, ok := composedWithin(out, 10*time.Second)
		h.mu.Lock()
		stillArmed, d11Same := h.d11hold == hold, h.d11 == d11Before+1
		h.mu.Unlock()
		closedEarly := h.ClosedLibrespot(lateSess)
		if _, cur := h.Bundle(p); !ok || err == nil || !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "did not finish in time") || !errors.Is(ctx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded) || cur != a || s.generation() != g || !stillArmed || !d11Same || closedEarly {
			t.Errorf("L6-AbandonedBuild: the reconnect's error wraps DeadlineExceeded (\"did not finish in time\") while the same D11 hold stays armed, nothing published, the late session not closed before release: returned %t, %v, context %v, still on A %t, generation %d (g %d), armed %t, D11 +1 only %t, closed before release %t", ok, err, ctx.Err(), cur == a, s.generation(), g, stillArmed, d11Same, closedEarly)
		}
		t.Logf("L6AB-DEADLINE-WHILE-HELD error %q; armed %t; closed before release %t", fmt.Sprint(err), stillArmed, closedEarly)
		// Release D11: newPlaybackSession returns, the CAS fails, closeBuilt.
		releaseD11()
		closed := composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return h.ClosedLibrespot(lateSess) })
		ended, byClient := composedClientClosed(lc, 20*time.Second)
		lateDone := composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return ap.DDSonicComposedAPDone(lateAP) })
		buildsJoined := waitGroupWithin(&builds, 20*time.Second)
		tailsJoined := waitGroupWithin(&tails, 20*time.Second)
		if !closed || !ended || !byClient || !lateDone || !buildsJoined || !tailsJoined {
			t.Errorf("L6-AbandonedBuild: the late build closed: closeLibrespot ran %t, its connection ended %t and closed by the client %t, its AP Done %t, builds joined %t, tails joined %t", closed, ended, byClient, lateDone, buildsJoined, tailsJoined)
		}
		t.Log("L6AB-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedL6Close: Session.Close after real plays. ddsonic owns
// every bundle: every F-AP connection of every bundle is closed by the
// client before T6, and every tail joins.
func TestDDSonicComposedL6Close(t *testing.T) {
	tr, tr2 := composedMP3Track(t, 67), composedMP3Track(t, 68)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		h.fx.Add(tr2)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		if a == nil {
			t.Fatal("L6-Close precondition: no bundle")
		}
		composedPlayOnce(t, h, p, tr, "L6C-first")
		composedPlayOnce(t, h, p, tr2, "L6C-second")
		conns := h.ap.Conns()
		if len(conns) == 0 {
			t.Fatal("L6-Close precondition: no F-AP connection")
		}
		h.Phase("P-H")
		s.Close()
		closed := composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return h.ClosedLibrespot(a.sess) })
		allByClient := true
		for _, c := range conns {
			if ended, byClient := composedClientClosed(c, 20*time.Second); !ended || !byClient {
				allByClient = false
				t.Logf("L6-Close: connection %d: ended %t, closed by the client %t", c.Index, ended, byClient)
			}
		}
		tailsJoined := waitGroupWithin(&tails, 20*time.Second)
		if !closed || !allByClient || !composedAPDoneOf(a) || !tailsJoined || !s.viewNow().closed {
			t.Errorf("L6-Close: closeLibrespot ran %t, every connection (%d) closed by the client %t, the AP Done %t, tails joined %t, the Session closed %t", closed, len(conns), allByClient, composedAPDoneOf(a), tailsJoined, s.viewNow().closed)
		}
		t.Log("L6C-OK")
	})
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// v9 step 4 (M3B2-S4; plan v9 §8, §3.4, §12 step 4): I6-I10 (D, OD, OW) and
// I13-I19b, on the real Session, provider, SDK constructor, player and key
// provider. The fixture bundle's capabilities are used where a row needs
// them: RB-1's reconnect gate (I13/I14 lower, I8 replaced-reopen-send),
// RB-2's metadata controls (I18 restricted, relink, metadata 500), RB-3's
// D2 records (I7, I19b), and D7's per-provider hooks (A-2) for a key
// write's stamp and send result. Every one is off unless the row sets it.

// errComposedGateFail is the one error H/'s write gate fails a write with in
// these rows, so a failed send is attributed to the gate by errors.Is (A-3).
var errComposedGateFail = errors.New("composed: the gated key write failed")

// composedSetRecoveryTimeout sets the recovery step's bound (I6b, I16). It is
// a row body's first action (A-1): no provider exists yet, so nothing that
// can read recoveryTimeout (recoverStream only, inside a provider's
// NewStreamer) is running; the fixture workers install started do not read
// it; withComposed's pre-install Q check is unchanged. The active adapter's
// saved value is restored at T10.
func composedSetRecoveryTimeout(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, d time.Duration) {
	t.Helper()
	h.mu.Lock()
	providers, decisions := len(h.providers), len(h.decisions)
	h.mu.Unlock()
	d1, d2, d3, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
	if providers != 0 || decisions != 0 || d1 != 0 || d2 != 0 || d3 != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("composed: recoveryTimeout may be set only as a row's first action (providers %d, decision points %d, D1 %d, D2 %d, D3 %d)", providers, decisions, d1, d2, d3)
	}
	recoveryTimeout = d
}

// composedBundleSetup is what composedOnService put on one serviced bundle,
// before its receive loop started and before its key provider's first
// request.
type composedBundleSetup struct {
	B  *playback
	AP *ap.Accesspoint
	// Gate is H/'s write gate on the bundle's generation-1 connection, or
	// nil.
	Gate *ap.DDSonicWriteGate
	// Hooks are D7's hooks on the bundle's key provider, or nil.
	Hooks *audio.DDSonicComposedKeyHooks
	Err   error
}

// composedServiceOpts selects what composedOnService puts on each bundle.
// fail names, by service order (1: the first serviced bundle), the bundles
// whose gate fails every write from the start with errComposedGateFail.
// holds and expireOnDemand are D7's step-5 options (G1; they need hooks).
type composedServiceOpts struct {
	gate, hooks, neverExpire bool
	holds, expireOnDemand    bool
	fail                     map[int]bool
}

// composedOnService puts, on every bundle serviced from now on, H/'s write
// gate on its generation-1 connection (the one point H/ allows: before its
// receive loop starts; released at T1) and D7's hooks on its key provider
// (before its first request), and sends each bundle's setup on the returned
// channel (a row services at most a few bundles; the buffer holds 16).
// h.OnService(nil) stops it.
func composedOnService(h *composedHarness, o composedServiceOpts) <-chan composedBundleSetup {
	ch := make(chan composedBundleSetup, 16)
	var mu sync.Mutex
	n := 0
	h.OnService(func(b *playback) {
		mu.Lock()
		n++
		i := n
		mu.Unlock()
		bs := composedBundleSetup{B: b}
		if b.sess == nil {
			bs.Err = errors.New("the serviced bundle has no session")
		} else {
			bs.AP = b.sess.Accesspoint()
			if o.gate {
				bs.Gate = ap.DDSonicContractGateWrites(bs.AP)
				h.OnRelease(bs.Gate.Release)
				if o.fail[i] {
					bs.Gate.Fail(errComposedGateFail)
				}
			}
			if o.hooks {
				bs.Hooks, bs.Err = audio.DDSonicComposedInstallKeyHooksWith(b.sess.AudioKey(), audio.DDSonicComposedKeyOptions{NeverExpire: o.neverExpire, ExpireOnDemand: o.expireOnDemand, Holds: o.holds})
			}
		}
		select {
		case ch <- bs:
		default:
		}
	})
	return ch
}

// composedSetupOf is the next serviced bundle's setup, waited for up to d;
// a missing or failed setup is the row's precondition failure.
func composedSetupOf(t *testing.T, ch <-chan composedBundleSetup, d time.Duration, row string) composedBundleSetup {
	t.Helper()
	bs, ok := composedWithin(ch, d)
	if !ok || bs.Err != nil || bs.AP == nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the serviced bundle's gate and hooks: received %t, error %v", row, ok, bs.Err)
	}
	return bs
}

// composedKeySeq is a key request's sequence: its last six bytes are the
// sequence and a zero word (H/'s AnswerKey).
func composedKeySeq(req ap.Packet) (uint32, bool) {
	n := len(req.Payload)
	if req.Type != ap.PacketTypeRequestKey || n < 6 {
		return 0, false
	}
	return binary.BigEndian.Uint32(req.Payload[n-6 : n-2]), true
}

// composedAnswerKeyError answers a key request with the SDK's AesKeyError
// packet: the sequence, then the error code (audio/provider.go :519-522).
func composedAnswerKeyError(c *ap.DDSonicComposedConn, req ap.Packet, code uint16) error {
	n := len(req.Payload)
	if req.Type != ap.PacketTypeRequestKey || n < 6 {
		return errors.New("composed: not a key request")
	}
	payload := append(append([]byte{}, req.Payload[n-6:n-2]...), byte(code>>8), byte(code))
	return c.C.Send(ap.PacketTypeAesKeyError, payload)
}

// composedAnswerMalformed answers a key request with an AesKey packet whose
// key is 8 bytes, not 16 (audio/provider.go :512-516).
func composedAnswerMalformed(c *ap.DDSonicComposedConn, req ap.Packet) error {
	n := len(req.Payload)
	if req.Type != ap.PacketTypeRequestKey || n < 6 {
		return errors.New("composed: not a key request")
	}
	return c.C.Send(ap.PacketTypeAesKey, append(append([]byte{}, req.Payload[n-6:n-2]...), make([]byte, 8)...))
}

// composedBarrier holds one decision or detach point: every arrival waits for
// its release; the first is signalled, with its time. T1 releases it.
type composedBarrier struct {
	reached chan struct{}
	release chan struct{}
	once    sync.Once
	relOnce sync.Once
	at      time.Time
}

func newComposedBarrier(h *composedHarness) *composedBarrier {
	b := &composedBarrier{reached: make(chan struct{}), release: make(chan struct{})}
	h.OnRelease(b.Release)
	return b
}

func (b *composedBarrier) arrive() {
	b.once.Do(func() {
		b.at = time.Now()
		close(b.reached)
	})
	<-b.release
}

// Reached is closed at the first arrival.
func (b *composedBarrier) Reached() <-chan struct{} {
	return b.reached
}

// At is the first arrival's time; it waits for that arrival.
func (b *composedBarrier) At() time.Time {
	<-b.reached
	return b.at
}

// Release lets every arrival through, once and for all.
func (b *composedBarrier) Release() {
	b.relOnce.Do(func() { close(b.release) })
}

// composedOnDecisions holds the recovery at each named decisionHook point
// (D6), in place of the test's decision barrier.
func composedOnDecisions(h *composedHarness, points ...string) map[string]*composedBarrier {
	m := map[string]*composedBarrier{}
	for _, p := range points {
		m[p] = newComposedBarrier(h)
	}
	h.OnDecision(func(point string) {
		if b := m[point]; b != nil {
			b.arrive()
		}
	})
	return m
}

// composedOnDetaches holds each named detachHook point (D6), in place of the
// test's detach barrier.
func composedOnDetaches(h *composedHarness, points ...string) map[string]*composedBarrier {
	m := map[string]*composedBarrier{}
	for _, p := range points {
		m[p] = newComposedBarrier(h)
	}
	h.OnDetach(func(point string) {
		if b := m[point]; b != nil {
			b.arrive()
		}
	})
	return m
}

// composedMakeTerminal makes a's access point close for good, as L6-Rebuild
// does: its next reconnect cannot succeed (ForgetWelcome), new logins are
// refused, and its connection c is peer-closed. undo ends the refusal; T1
// calls it too.
func composedMakeTerminal(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, a *ap.Accesspoint, c *ap.DDSonicComposedConn) (undo func()) {
	t.Helper()
	undo = h.ap.F.Refuse()
	h.OnRelease(undo)
	ap.DDSonicContractForgetWelcome(a)
	if err := c.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("composed: the peer close: %v", err)
	}
	return undo
}

// composedRebuildSC checks one serialized rebuild constructor interval (plan
// v9 §3.2): the d1Before-th D1 call, once it returned, and only after D10
// has published its OWN access point's authenticated connection (R60-1),
// against the SC with its silent counts; before was read before the
// constructor could start. It returns the call.
func composedRebuildSC(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, marker, phase string, d1Before int, before composedSC) *composedD1Call {
	t.Helper()
	// ONE declared allowance, 30 s from here, for the constructor's start
	// AND its return (R65-4): the return is given only what remains. The
	// 5 s OWN-AP D10 publication below is a separate, declared observation.
	by := time.Now().Add(30 * time.Second)
	var call *composedD1Call
	started := composedWithinTrue(time.Until(by), func() bool {
		if calls := h.D1Calls(); len(calls) > d1Before {
			call = calls[d1Before]
			return true
		}
		return false
	})
	if !started || call == nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: the rebuild's constructor did not start within 30 s", marker)
	}
	if !call.Returned() && !call.WaitReturned(time.Until(by)) {
		t.Fatalf("%s: the rebuild's constructor did not return within the same 30 s", marker)
	}
	if call.Sess != nil && composedConnOf(h, call.Sess.Accesspoint(), 5*time.Second) == nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: no D10 connection correlated with the rebuilt access point within 5 s", marker)
	}
	composedCheckSC(t, marker, before, composedSCNow(h, phase), call)
	if call.Sess == nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: the rebuild returned no session", marker)
	}
	return call
}

// composedSetupCtx is the setup context D3 recorded for its i-th real
// Player.NewStream, or nil.
func composedSetupCtx(h *composedHarness, i int) context.Context {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if i < len(h.d3ctx) {
		return h.d3ctx[i]
	}
	return nil
}

// composedEventsSince counts the harness events whose name starts with
// prefix, recorded after the event numbered seq.
func composedEventsSince(h *composedHarness, prefix string, seq int64) int {
	n := 0
	for _, e := range h.Events() {
		num, name, _ := strings.Cut(e, ":")
		if v, _ := strconv.ParseInt(num, 10, 64); v > seq && strings.HasPrefix(name, prefix) {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

// composedWorkerReturned awaits, under ONE deadline d, both of a setup
// worker's facts after the event numbered since: D3's in-flight count
// joined, then openHook("worker-before-publish") recorded (the event follows
// D3's Done, so it uses the rest of the same budget, and is checked at least
// once) (R58-1, R59-1). onTime reports whether both were observed before
// that same deadline, checked once after both observations (R106-1): the
// caller accepts the facts only when it is true. A late observation is not
// proof that the worker returned late; the deadline is never reset.
func composedWorkerReturned(h *composedHarness, since int64, d time.Duration) (joined, event, onTime bool) {
	by := time.Now().Add(d)
	joined = waitGroupWithin(&h.d3wg, time.Until(by))
	event = composedEventsSince(h, "open:worker-before-publish", since) > 0
	for !event && time.Now().Before(by) {
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
		event = composedEventsSince(h, "open:worker-before-publish", since) > 0
	}
	onTime = time.Now().Before(by)
	return joined, event, onTime
}

// composedAPGen is a's connection generation.
func composedAPGen(a *ap.Accesspoint) uint64 {
	g, _ := a.Generation()
	return g
}

// composedWaitAPGen waits up to d for a's generation to reach want.
func composedWaitAPGen(a *ap.Accesspoint, want uint64, d time.Duration) uint64 {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(d)
	for {
		g := composedAPGen(a)
		if g >= want || time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return g
		}
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// composedD2Rec records D2's before-hold and returned events (the bundle's
// RB-3 call-through observation) in order. It holds nothing.
type composedD2Rec struct {
	mu  sync.Mutex
	evs []composedD2Event
}

func composedRecordD2(h *composedHarness) *composedD2Rec {
	r := &composedD2Rec{}
	h.OnNewStream(func(ev composedD2Event) {
		r.mu.Lock()
		r.evs = append(r.evs, ev)
		r.mu.Unlock()
	})
	return r
}

// Returned is D2 attempt n's returned event (n is D2's own counter), if it
// has been recorded.
func (r *composedD2Rec) Returned(n int) (composedD2Event, bool) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	for _, ev := range r.evs {
		if ev.Point == "returned" && ev.Attempt == n {
			return ev, true
		}
	}
	return composedD2Event{}, false
}

// composedArmRegate arms the bundle's RB-1 reconnect gate on a for its
// generation gen, failing every write from the start (errComposedGateFail);
// its Disarm and its Release are registered for T1 before anything drives
// it. One arming per access point at a time.
func composedArmRegate(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, a *ap.Accesspoint, gen uint64, row string) *ap.DDSonicComposedRegate {
	t.Helper()
	rg, err := ap.DDSonicComposedGateGeneration(a, gen)
	if err != nil {
