		t.Fatalf("%s precondition: arming the reconnect gate: %v", row, err)
	}
	h.OnRelease(rg.Disarm)
	h.OnRelease(rg.Gate.Release)
	rg.Gate.Fail(errComposedGateFail)
	return rg
}

// composedKeysReceived is how many key requests the fixture received, on
// every connection.
func composedKeysReceived(h *composedHarness) int {
	n := 0
	for _, c := range h.ap.Conns() {
		n += c.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey)
	}
	return n
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// S4a: I6, I6b, I7, I8, I9, I10-D, I10-OD, I10-OW.

// TestDDSonicComposedI6: the key write on c1, the connection selected for
// it, fails at H/'s write gate: the SDK's real KeySendError on generation 1.
// The recovery waits; at decisionHook("before-wait") A is on generation 1
// with Done open. A real advance (the peer closes c1; c2, login 2) wakes it,
// and one reopen on the same bundle plays. The write attempts (D7: the one
// stamped for generation 1, whose send returned the gate's error with Done
// open, then one stamped for generation 2 that was sent) are kept apart from
// the packets received (0 on c1, 1 on c2); 2 setups; 1 recovery; 0
// rebuilds.
func TestDDSonicComposedI6(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 71)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: true, hooks: true, fail: map[int]bool{1: true}})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, "I6")
		_, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bs.B != a {
			t.Fatal("I6 precondition: the bundle, its first connection and its gated access point")
		}
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "before-wait")
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		h.Phase("P1")
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I6-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["before-wait"].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I6 precondition: the recovery did not reach decisionHook(\"before-wait\") within 15 s")
		}
		gen, done := composedGeneration(a), composedAPDoneOf(a)
		atts := bs.Hooks.Attempts()
		failed := len(atts) == 1 && atts[0].Stamped && atts[0].Gen == 1 && atts[0].Returned && errors.Is(atts[0].Err, errComposedGateFail) && !atts[0].APDone
		if gen != 1 || done || !failed || c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 0 || h.Decisions("begin") != 1 {
			t.Errorf("I6 at before-wait: generation 1 and Done open; one write stamped for generation 1 whose send returned the gate's error with Done open; 0 key packets received on c1; 1 recovery: generation %d, Done %t, attempts %+v, received on c1 %d, recoveries %d", gen, done, atts, c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey), h.Decisions("begin"))
		}
		bar["before-wait"].Release()
		// The real advance; the wake follows it.
		advance := h.Event("I6-advance")
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I6: peer close: %v", err)
		}
		c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
		if c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, 2, 15*time.Second) != 2 {
			t.Fatal("I6: the advance (c2, generation 2) did not complete")
		}
		resultBy := time.Now().Add(45 * time.Second)
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, time.Until(resultBy))
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I6: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I6: the reopen did not play: %v", res.err)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("I6: the decoded samples are silent")
		}
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		_, b := h.Bundle(p)
		// R65-2: the second send's own return is awaited (its afterSend can
		// follow the answer and the decode), within what remains of the 45 s
		// result allowance; it is never inferred from a received packet.
		composedWithinTrue(time.Until(resultBy), func() bool {
			atts = bs.Hooks.Attempts()
			return len(atts) >= 2 && atts[1].Returned
		})
		sent := len(atts) == 2 && atts[1].Stamped && atts[1].Gen == 2 && atts[1].Returned && atts[1].Err == nil
		woke := composedEventsSince(h, "decision:decided", advance) == 1 && h.Decisions("decided") == 1
		if !woke || h.Decisions("before-wait") != 1 || b != a || a.ctx.Err() != nil || d3 != 2 || len(d4) != 0 || !sent || c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 0 || c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 1 {
			t.Errorf("I6: woken after the advance, one wait, one reopen on the same live bundle, 2 setups, 0 rebuilds, the second write stamped for generation 2 and sent, packets received c1=0 c2=1: woken %t, waits %d, same bundle %t, ctx %v, setups %d, rebuilds %v, attempts %+v, received c1=%d c2=%d", woke, h.Decisions("before-wait"), b == a, a.ctx.Err(), d3, d4, atts, c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey), c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey))
		}
		t.Log("I6-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI6b: as I6, with recoveryTimeout 2 s and no advance:
// the recovery step expires during the wait; the play is final with the
// step's error; 1 setup; 0 rebuilds; the bundle retained and live.
func TestDDSonicComposedI6b(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 72)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		composedSetRecoveryTimeout(t, h, 2*time.Second)
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: true, hooks: true, fail: map[int]bool{1: true}})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, "I6b")
		_, a := h.Bundle(p)
		if a == nil || bs.B != a {
			t.Fatal("I6b precondition: the bundle and its gated access point")
		}
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		h.Phase("P1")
		// R65-3: the clock origin is taken BEFORE the play starts. The step's
		// 2 s context is made inside recoverStream, after the first open
		// failed, so its deadline is at least 2 s after this origin and the
		// step's DeadlineExceeded cannot be returned earlier. No upper bound
		// is asserted (none is contracted); the time is recorded.
		start := time.Now()
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I6b-play", p, tr.URI())
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 30*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I6b: NewStreamer did not return within 30 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		elapsed := res.at.Sub(start)
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		_, b := h.Bundle(p)
		atts := bs.Hooks.Attempts()
		failed := len(atts) == 1 && atts[0].Gen == 1 && errors.Is(atts[0].Err, errComposedGateFail) && !atts[0].APDone
		if !errors.Is(res.err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || h.Decisions("begin") != 1 || h.Decisions("before-wait") != 1 || elapsed < 2*time.Second ||
			d3 != 1 || len(d4) != 0 || b != a || a.ctx.Err() != nil || composedAPDoneOf(a) || composedGeneration(a) != 1 || !failed {
			t.Errorf("I6b: final with the step's error after the wait, at least the 2 s step after the play's start, 1 setup, 0 rebuilds, the bundle retained: err %v, recoveries %d, waits %d, from the play's start %s, setups %d, rebuilds %v, same %t, ctx %v, AP done %t, generation %d, attempts %+v", res.err, h.Decisions("begin"), h.Decisions("before-wait"), elapsed, d3, d4, b == a, a.ctx.Err(), composedAPDoneOf(a), composedGeneration(a), atts)
		}
		t.Logf("I6B-OBSERVED final after %s from the play's start: %v", elapsed, res.err)
		t.Log("I6B-OK")
	})
}

// composedI7 is I7: a real terminal access-point failure under the play's
// in-flight key request (ForgetWelcome, Refuse, PeerClose: A closes for
// good). The accepted first error is asserted from D2's attempt-1 returned
// record (the bundle's RB-3): the SDK's ErrAccesspointClosed, on A's own
// origin and build, after real work (not beforeWork). Refuse is undone once
// A is Done; the recovery rebuilds A's build (one SC, with the origin
// already Done) and the reopen plays; the old bundle is torn down as in
// L6-Rebuild. twice: the reopen on the rebuilt bundle meets a terminal
// access point too: final, no third build.
func composedI7(t *testing.T, n byte, twice bool) {
	row := "I7 rebuild"
	if twice {
		row = "I7 terminal-twice"
	}
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: no bundle or no first connection", row)
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		rec := composedRecordD2(h)
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "decided")
		h.Phase("P2")
		_, d2Before, d3Before, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I7-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: A's key request received on c1 (real work on A)", row)
		}
		undo := composedMakeTerminal(t, h, a.sess.Accesspoint(), c1)
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["decided"].Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the recovery did not decide within 30 s", row)
		}
		// The accepted first error, exactly as D2's attempt 1 returned it.
		first, recorded := rec.Returned(d2Before + 1)
		var oe *originError
		cause := recorded && !first.Stream && errors.Is(first.Err, ap.ErrAccesspointClosed) && errors.As(first.Err, &oe) && oe.origin == a && oe.gen == gen && !oe.beforeWork
		_, _, d3D, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		if !cause || d3D-d3Before != 1 || composedGeneration(a) != 1 || !composedAPDoneOf(a) || c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 1 || h.Decisions("before-wait") != 0 || h.Decisions("terminal-at-acquisition") != 0 {
			t.Errorf("%s at the decision: D2 attempt 1 returned the accepted ErrAccesspointClosed on A's origin and build after real work (not beforeWork), with one real setup and A's key request on c1, no replacement (generation 1), A Done, no wait: recorded %t, err %v, origin A %t, beforeWork %t, setups %d, generation %d, AP done %t, key packets on c1 %d, waits %d, terminal-at-acquisition %d",
				row, recorded, first.Err, oe != nil && oe.origin == a, oe != nil && oe.beforeWork, d3D-d3Before, composedGeneration(a), composedAPDoneOf(a), c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey), h.Decisions("before-wait"), h.Decisions("terminal-at-acquisition"))
		}
		undo()
		if !twice {
			answerKeys(h, tr)
		}
		sc0 := composedSCNow(h, "P2")
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		bar["decided"].Release()
		call := composedRebuildSC(t, h, "I7-SC", "P2", d1Before, sc0)
		if twice {
			x := composedConnOf(h, call.Sess.Accesspoint(), 5*time.Second)
			if x == nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: no connection for the rebuilt bundle", row)
			}
			if _, ok := x.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 30*time.Second); !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the reopen's key request on the rebuilt bundle", row)
			}
			composedMakeTerminal(t, h, call.Sess.Accesspoint(), x)
		}
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s", row)
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		_, d2, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if twice {
			second, recorded2 := rec.Returned(d2Before + 2)
			if !errors.Is(res.err, ap.ErrAccesspointClosed) || !recorded2 || !errors.Is(second.Err, ap.ErrAccesspointClosed) || len(d4) != 1 || d4[0] != gen ||
				len(h.D1Calls()) != d1Before+1 || h.Decisions("begin") != 1 || d2-d2Before != 2 || d3-d3Before != 2 {
				t.Errorf("%s: the reopen on the rebuilt bundle meets a terminal access point: final, no third build: err %v, D2 attempt 2 recorded %t (%v), rebuilds %v (origin %d), D1 +%d, recoveries %d, opens %d, setups %d",
					row, res.err, recorded2, second.Err, d4, gen, len(h.D1Calls())-d1Before, h.Decisions("begin"), d2-d2Before, d3-d3Before)
			}
			t.Log("I7-TWICE-OK")
			return
		}
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the reopen did not play: %v", row, res.err)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Errorf("%s: the reopened play's samples are silent", row)
		}
		_, b := h.Bundle(p)
		if len(d4) != 1 || d4[0] != gen || b == nil || b == a || b.sess != call.Sess || d3-d3Before != 2 || d2-d2Before != 2 || h.Decisions("begin") != 1 {
			t.Errorf("%s: 1 rebuild with the origin's generation, the reopen on the rebuilt bundle, 2 opens and 2 setups, 1 recovery: rebuilds %v (origin %d), new bundle %t, opens %d, setups %d, recoveries %d", row, d4, gen, b != nil && b != a && b.sess == call.Sess, d2-d2Before, d3-d3Before, h.Decisions("begin"))
		}
		// The old, replaced bundle is torn down (as L6-Rebuild).
		closed := composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return h.ClosedLibrespot(a.sess) })
		ended, byClient := composedClientClosed(c1, 20*time.Second)
		tailsJoined := waitGroupWithin(&tails, 20*time.Second)
		if !closed || !ended || !byClient || !composedAPDoneOf(a) || !tailsJoined {
			t.Errorf("%s: the replaced bundle torn down: closeLibrespot ran %t, c1 ended %t and closed by the client %t, AP Done %t, tail joined %t", row, closed, ended, byClient, composedAPDoneOf(a), tailsJoined)
		}
		t.Log("I7-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI7: a real terminal access-point failure: the
// rebuild-and-reopen, and the variant whose reopen meets a terminal access
// point too.
func TestDDSonicComposedI7(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("rebuild", func(t *testing.T) { composedI7(t, 73, false) })
	t.Run("terminal-twice", func(t *testing.T) { composedI7(t, 74, true) })
}

// composedI8Order is one of I8's orders (sdk design v2 :292): a first
// failure, met by the real recovery (a reopen on the same bundle after a
// replacement; otherwise a rebuild and a reopen on the new bundle), then a
// second failure of that reopen, which must be final. Failures: "replaced"
// (the request's connection is peer-closed under it and the reconnect
// completes), "auth" (an AesKeyError answer), "done" (the access point
// closes for good), "send" (the write fails at H/'s gate).
type composedI8Order struct {
	first, second string
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI8: the request-wide cap in every listed order: at most
// 1 recovery, 2 setups, 2 key writes and 1 rebuild per play, every second
// failure final, 0 token and 0 browser in P2; and a beforeWork refusal is
// not an SDK setup. replaced -> reopen -> send error fails the reopen's real
// write on A's generation-2 connection through the bundle's RB-1 gate.
func TestDDSonicComposedI8(t *testing.T) {
	type order struct {
		n byte
		o composedI8Order
	}
	for _, c := range []order{
		{81, composedI8Order{"replaced", "replaced"}},
		{82, composedI8Order{"replaced", "auth"}},
		{83, composedI8Order{"replaced", "done"}},
		{97, composedI8Order{"replaced", "send"}},
		{84, composedI8Order{"auth", "replaced"}},
		{85, composedI8Order{"auth", "done"}},
		{86, composedI8Order{"done", "replaced"}},
		{87, composedI8Order{"done", "auth"}},
		{88, composedI8Order{"send", "replaced"}},
		{89, composedI8Order{"send", "auth"}},
		{90, composedI8Order{"send", "done"}},
		{91, composedI8Order{"send", "send"}},
	} {
		t.Run(c.o.first+"-then-"+c.o.second, func(t *testing.T) { composedI8(t, c.n, c.o) })
	}
	t.Run("beforework-is-not-a-setup", func(t *testing.T) { composedI8BeforeWork(t, 92) })
}

func composedI8(t *testing.T, n byte, o composedI8Order) { composedI8With(t, n, o, false) }

// composedI8With is composedI8; budget records the play in the I27 ledger
// (I27′'s mixed orders only: I8's own twelve orders are not I27 entries).
func composedI8With(t *testing.T, n byte, o composedI8Order, budget bool) {
	name := "I8 " + o.first + "-then-" + o.second
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		fail := map[int]bool{}
		if o.first == "send" {
			fail[1] = true
		}
		if o.second == "send" { // the rebuilt bundle, serviced second
			fail[2] = true
		}
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: true, hooks: true, fail: fail})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		bsA := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, name)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bsA.B != a {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the bundle, its first connection and its setup", name)
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		// replaced -> send (RB-1): A's generation-2 connection, the one the
		// replacement publishes, fails every write from the start; the
		// arming is in place before anything drives the reconnect.
		var rg *ap.DDSonicComposedRegate
		if o.first == "replaced" && o.second == "send" {
			rg = composedArmRegate(t, h, a.sess.Accesspoint(), 2, name)
		}
		points := []string{"decided"}
		if o.first == "send" {
			points = append(points, "before-wait")
		}
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, points...)
		h.Phase("P2")
		_, _, d3Before, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		base := composedBudgetStart(h, bsA.Hooks)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I8-play", p, tr.URI())
		// The first failure.
		var undo func()
		switch o.first {
		case "replaced":
			if _, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second); !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the key request on c1", name)
			}
			if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: peer close: %v", name, err)
			}
		case "auth":
			pkt, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second)
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the key request on c1", name)
			}
			if err := composedAnswerKeyError(c1, pkt, 1); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: the AesKeyError answer: %v", name, err)
			}
		case "done":
			if _, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second); !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the key request on c1", name)
			}
			undo = composedMakeTerminal(t, h, a.sess.Accesspoint(), c1)
		case "send":
			if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["before-wait"].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the recovery did not reach before-wait within 15 s", name)
			}
			undo = composedMakeTerminal(t, h, a.sess.Accesspoint(), c1)
			bar["before-wait"].Release()
		}
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["decided"].Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the recovery did not decide within 30 s", name)
		}
		rebuild := o.first != "replaced"
		if (o.first == "done" || o.first == "send") && !composedAPDoneOf(a) {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the origin's access point is Done at the decision", name)
		}
		if undo != nil {
			undo() // logins accepted again, before the rebuild dials
		}
		sc0 := composedSCNow(h, "P2")
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		bar["decided"].Release()
		// The reopen's connection.
		var x *ap.DDSonicComposedConn
		var xAP *ap.Accesspoint
		var bsB composedBundleSetup
		if rebuild {
			call := composedRebuildSC(t, h, "I8-SC", "P2", d1Before, sc0)
			xAP = call.Sess.Accesspoint()
			x = composedConnOf(h, xAP, 5*time.Second)
			bsB = composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, name+" rebuilt bundle")
		} else {
			xAP = a.sess.Accesspoint()
			x = h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
			if rg != nil {
				if _, ok := composedWithin(rg.Applied(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
					t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the reconnect gate was not applied at A's generation 2", name)
				}
			}
		}
		if x == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: no connection for the reopen", name)
		}
		// The second failure.
		switch o.second {
		case "replaced":
			if _, ok := x.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 30*time.Second); !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the reopen's key request", name)
			}
			if err := x.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: peer close: %v", name, err)
			}
		case "auth":
			pkt, ok := x.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 30*time.Second)
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the reopen's key request", name)
			}
			if err := composedAnswerKeyError(x, pkt, 1); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: the AesKeyError answer: %v", name, err)
			}
		case "done":
			if _, ok := x.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 30*time.Second); !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the reopen's key request", name)
			}
			composedMakeTerminal(t, h, xAP, x)
		case "send":
			// The reopen's connection fails its writes from the start: the
			// rebuilt bundle's generation-1 gate, or, after a replacement,
			// A's generation-2 reconnect gate.
		}
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 60*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: NewStreamer did not return within 60 s", name)
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		if budget {
			composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base, bsB.Hooks)
		}
		var replaced *audio.ConnectionReplacedError
		var sendFail *audio.KeySendError
		final := false
		switch o.second {
		case "replaced":
			final = errors.As(res.err, &replaced)
		case "auth":
			final = errors.Is(res.err, playlist.ErrNeedsAuth) && s.signInRefused()
		case "done":
			final = errors.Is(res.err, ap.ErrAccesspointClosed)
		case "send":
			wantGen := uint64(1)
			if rg != nil {
				wantGen = 2
			}
			final = errors.As(res.err, &sendFail) && sendFail.Gen == wantGen && errors.Is(res.err, errComposedGateFail) && x.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) == 0
		}
		_, _, d3, d5, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		stamped := 0
		for _, k := range []*audio.DDSonicComposedKeyHooks{bsA.Hooks, bsB.Hooks} {
			if k == nil {
				continue
			}
			for _, at := range k.Attempts() {
				if at.Stamped {
					stamped++
				}
			}
		}
		wantRebuilds := 0
		if rebuild {
			wantRebuilds = 1
		}
		r := h.router
		if !final || h.Decisions("begin") != 1 || d3-d3Before != 2 || len(d4) != wantRebuilds || (rebuild && d4[0] != gen) || composedKeysReceived(h) > 2 || stamped > 2 ||
			r.Count("P2", "A7") != 0 || r.Count("P2", "A8") != 0 || d5 != 0 {
			t.Errorf("%s: the second failure final as itself; 1 recovery; 2 setups; at most 2 key writes; %d rebuild(s) of the origin's generation; 0 token, 0 Web API and 0 browser in P2: err %v, final %t, recoveries %d, setups %d, rebuilds %v (origin %d), keys received %d, writes stamped %d, A7 %d, A8 %d, D5 %d",
				name, wantRebuilds, res.err, final, h.Decisions("begin"), d3-d3Before, d4, gen, composedKeysReceived(h), stamped, r.Count("P2", "A7"), r.Count("P2", "A8"), d5)
		}
		t.Logf("I8-ORDER-OK %s-then-%s: %v", o.first, o.second, res.err)
	})
}

// composedI8BeforeWork: the origin's access point is Done before the play
// takes it: the open fails before any librespot work (beforeWork; D2 +1, D3
// +0), the recovery rebuilds (one SC) and the reopen plays (D3 +1). The
// beforeWork attempt is not an SDK setup.
func composedI8BeforeWork(t *testing.T, n byte) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("I8 beforework precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		h.Phase("P-H")
		undo := composedMakeTerminal(t, h, a.sess.Accesspoint(), c1)
		if !composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return composedAPDoneOf(a) }) {
			t.Fatal("I8 beforework precondition: the access point did not become Done (STOP 9)")
		}
		undo()
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "decided")
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		h.Phase("P2")
		_, d2Before, d3Before, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I8BW-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["decided"].Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I8 beforework: the recovery did not decide within 30 s")
		}
		_, d2D, d3D, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		sc0 := composedSCNow(h, "P2")
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		bar["decided"].Release()
		composedRebuildSC(t, h, "I8BW-SC", "P2", d1Before, sc0)
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok || res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I8 beforework: the reopen: returned %t, %v", ok, res.err)
		}
		h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		_, d2, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if d2D-d2Before != 1 || d3D-d3Before != 0 || d2-d2Before != 2 || d3-d3Before != 1 || len(d4) != 1 || d4[0] != gen || h.Decisions("begin") != 1 {
			t.Errorf("I8 beforework: the first open made no SDK setup (D2 +1, D3 +0 at the decision), then one rebuild of the origin's generation and one setup: at the decision D2 +%d D3 +%d; in all D2 +%d D3 +%d; rebuilds %v (origin %d); recoveries %d", d2D-d2Before, d3D-d3Before, d2-d2Before, d3-d3Before, d4, gen, h.Decisions("begin"))
		}
		t.Log("I8-BEFOREWORK-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI9: after I5-D's phase N (W, C, R, N and the A.users
// join, here positive preconditions), the answer to the cancelled sequence
// on c2 is an unknown answer: the unknown count +1, the record table
// unchanged. Then the next E-direct open has its own sequence and its own
// answer, and plays.
func TestDDSonicComposedI9(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 93)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("I9 precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
		}
		// W.
		ctx, cancel := h.Context()
		out := make(chan error, 1)
		h.Go("I9-open", func() {
			st, sc, err := s.NewStream(ctx, tr.ID, 320)
			if err == nil {
				sc()
				releaseDecoder(st.Source)
			}
			out <- err
		})
		pkt, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second)
		seq0, okSeq := composedKeySeq(pkt)
		if !ok || !okSeq {
			t.Fatal("I9 precondition (W): the key request was not received on c1")
		}
		if recs, q, _ := composedKeyState(a); recs != 1 || q != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("I9 precondition (W): 1 record, an empty writer queue: records %d, queue %d", recs, q)
		}
		// C.
		cancelled := h.Event("I9-cancel")
		cancel()
		err, ok := composedWithin(out, 5*time.Second)
		if !ok || !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Fatalf("I9 precondition (C): NewStream returns context.Canceled: returned %t, err %v", ok, err)
		}
		// R72-1, the owners' limited oracle timing revision of v9 §6.1's C
		// (I9 inherits I5-D's W/C/R/N): the outer return may precede record
		// removal; removal is asserted once the setup worker has returned.
		// Both worker facts under the one 1 s, then the D7 snapshot, still
		// before R. Not the original immediate guarantee.
		joined, event, onTime := composedWorkerReturned(h, cancelled, time.Second)
		recs, q, _ := composedKeyState(a)
		if recs != 0 || q != 0 || !joined || !event || !onTime {
			t.Fatalf("I9 precondition (C) (limited oracle timing revision R72-1: outer return may precede record removal; removal asserted once the setup worker has returned): the worker returned within the one 1 s (D3 joined %t, worker-before-publish %t, both observed before the 1 s deadline %t), and then the table and queue are empty: records %d, queue %d", joined, event, onTime, recs, q)
		}
		keysAtC := c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey)
		// R.
		gen1 := composedGeneration(a)
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I9 precondition (R): peer close: %v", err)
		}
		c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
		if c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, gen1+1, 15*time.Second) != gen1+1 {
			t.Fatal("I9 precondition (R): the reconnect did not complete")
		}
		// N: 3 s with no play, no answer and no harness action.
		time.Sleep(3 * time.Second)
		recs, q, u0 := composedKeyState(a)
		_, b := h.Bundle(p)
		d1, d2N, d3N, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if recs != 0 || q != 0 || b != a || a.ctx.Err() != nil || composedAPDoneOf(a) || len(d4) != 0 || d1 != 1 || c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != keysAtC || c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("I9 precondition (N): A healthy, no future play: records %d, queue %d, same %t, ctx %v, AP done %t, D4 %v, D1 %d, key packets since C c1 %d c2 %d", recs, q, b == a, a.ctx.Err(), composedAPDoneOf(a), d4, d1, c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey)-keysAtC, c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey))
		}
		usersJoined := waitGroupWithin(&a.users, composedJoin)
		_, d2U, d3U, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		if !usersJoined || d2U != d2N || d3U != d3N {
			t.Fatalf("I9 precondition (N): A's users joined with no new user admitted: joined %t, D2 +%d, D3 +%d", usersJoined, d2U-d2N, d3U-d3N)
		}
		// I9: the answer to the cancelled sequence, on c2.
		if err := c2.C.AnswerKey(pkt, tr.Key); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I9: answer: %v", err)
		}
		var u uint64
		for end := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second); time.Now().Before(end); time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond) {
			if recs, _, u = composedKeyState(a); u == u0+1 {
				break
			}
		}
		if u != u0+1 || recs != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I9: the late answer is unknown (+1) and the table unchanged: unknown %d -> %d, records %d", u0, u, recs)
		}
		// The next open: its own sequence and answer.
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		ctx2, _ := h.Context()
		st, sc, err := s.NewStream(ctx2, tr.ID, 320)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I9: the next open: %v", err)
		}
		next := newSpotifyStreamer(st, sc)
		h.KeepCloser(next)
		pkt2, ok2 := c2.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 5*time.Second)
		seq2, okSeq2 := composedKeySeq(pkt2)
		if !ok2 || !okSeq2 || seq2 == seq0 {
			t.Errorf("I9: the next open has its own sequence: received %t, cancelled %d, next %d", ok2, seq0, seq2)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, next, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("I9: the next open's samples are silent")
		}
		if _, _, d3, _, _, _ := h.Counts(); d3 != d3U+1 {
			t.Errorf("I9: the next open made 1 setup, got %d", d3-d3U)
		}
		t.Logf("I9-OBSERVED cancelled sequence %d, next sequence %d", seq0, seq2)
		t.Log("I9-OK")
	})
}

// composedNoResurrection is I10's "after release": the held write, released,
// reaches c1 and is answered; the answer is unknown (+1 over u0), the record
// table stays empty, and nothing is published after the release.
//
// The event log orders it (numbers are assigned under the harness mutex,
// and openHook records through the same h.Event): the marker "<row>-release"
// is recorded immediately before gate.Release. Every setup worker's
// deferred handoff records "open:worker-before-publish", then, only if it
// wins its pending->ready swap, "open:worker-published" before it sends
// its result. Counted in one snapshot, relative to started (the event the
// row records immediately before its open) and the marker. After the
// marker: no worker event of either kind (zero; a resurrection). At or
// before started: none (an earlier or unrelated worker). Between: exactly
// one worker-before-publish (this request's worker, the row's single setup,
// D3 = 1), and its publications, each numbered after that worker's
// worker-before-publish. Exactly one where mustPublish (I10-OW: nothing
// cancels the caller, the SDK's window ends the setup, and the worker's
// swap wins, which is how NewStream returned). Zero or one otherwise
// (I10-D, I10-OD: the caller's context ends, and either the caller's
// pending->abandoned swap wins (zero) or the worker's pending->ready swap
// wins and publishes its error (one), which the caller then drains or
// rejects; nothing in the row pins which, and neither is inferred).
//
// A publication is the error result only: the single setup produced no
// decoded stream (D3 records a counted decoder for every MP3/FLAC stream it
// returns; these rows' tracks are MP3), so nothing was accepted.
func composedNoResurrection(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, a *playback, c1 *ap.DDSonicComposedConn, gate *ap.DDSonicWriteGate, tr *composedTrack, u0 uint64, started int64, mustPublish bool, row string) {
	t.Helper()
	released := h.Event(row + "-release")
	gate.Release()
	pkt, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 5*time.Second)
	if ok {
		if err := c1.C.AnswerKey(pkt, tr.Key); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: answering the released request: %v", row, err)
		}
	}
	var recs int
	var u uint64
	for end := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second); time.Now().Before(end); time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond) {
		if recs, _, u = composedKeyState(a); u == u0+1 {
			break
		}
	}
	// One snapshot of the log; every event numbered below released was
	// recorded before the marker, so the counts before it are final.
	type workerEvents struct {
		earlier, own, after int
		seq                 int64 // the last one between started and the marker
	}
	var worker, published workerEvents
	for _, e := range h.Events() {
		num, name, _ := strings.Cut(e, ":")
		var c *workerEvents
		switch {
		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "open:worker-before-publish"):
			c = &worker
		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "open:worker-published"):
			c = &published
		default:
			continue
		}
		switch v, _ := strconv.ParseInt(num, 10, 64); {
		case v > released:
			c.after++
		case v > started:
			c.own++
			c.seq = v
		default:
			c.earlier++
		}
	}
	_, _, setups, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
	streams := len(h.Decoders())
	ownOK, want := published.own == 1, "1"
	if !mustPublish {
		ownOK, want = published.own <= 1, "0 or 1"
	}
	correlated := published.own == 0 || published.seq > worker.seq
	if !ok || u != u0+1 || recs != 0 || worker.own != 1 || worker.earlier != 0 || worker.after != 0 || published.earlier != 0 || published.after != 0 || !ownOK || !correlated || setups != 1 || streams != 0 {
		t.Errorf("%s after the release: no resurrection: the released request reached c1 %t, its answer unknown %d -> %d, records %d; after the release: worker events %d, publications %d (want 0 and 0); before it: this request's worker %d (want 1), its publications %d (want %s), each after its worker %t, earlier worker events %d and publications %d (want 0 and 0); setups %d (want 1), decoded streams %d (want 0: an error result only)", row, ok, u0, u, recs, worker.after, published.after, worker.own, published.own, want, correlated, worker.earlier, published.earlier, setups, streams)
	}
	t.Logf("%s-PUBLICATION-OBSERVED before the release %d (this request's worker %d), after it %d; setups %d, decoded streams %d", row, published.own, worker.own, published.after, setups, streams)
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI10Direct: E-direct; the key write is held at H/'s
// gate (a real PHYSICAL write: the key provider's writer, blocked in the
// gate); the caller cancels. The open returns the context's error; the
// setup worker has returned (D3 joined and worker-before-publish, one 1 s
// budget) while the writer is still blocked; the record table is empty while
// the gate is held. After the release, no resurrection. The
// caller-cancellation boundary.
func TestDDSonicComposedI10Direct(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 94)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: true})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, "I10-D")
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bs.B != a {
			t.Fatal("I10-D precondition: the bundle, its first connection and its gate")
		}
		entered := bs.Gate.Arm()
		h.Phase("P1")
		ctx, cancel := h.Context()
		out := make(chan error, 1)
		started := h.Event("I10D-start")
		h.Go("I10D-open", func() {
			st, sc, err := s.NewStream(ctx, tr.ID, 320)
			if err == nil {
				sc()
				releaseDecoder(st.Source)
			}
			out <- err
		})
		if _, ok := composedWithin(entered, 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I10-D precondition: the key write did not enter the gate")
		}
		if !heldWriter() || c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 0 {
			t.Fatal("I10-D precondition: the held write is the key provider's writer, blocked in the gate, and nothing reached c1")
		}
		if recs, _, _ := composedKeyState(a); recs != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("I10-D precondition: 1 record while the write is held, got %d", recs)
		}
		cancelled := h.Event("I10D-cancel")
		cancel()
		err, ok := composedWithin(out, 5*time.Second)
		joined, event, onTime := composedWorkerReturned(h, cancelled, time.Second)
		recs, q, u0 := composedKeyState(a)
		held := heldWriter()
		if !ok || !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || !joined || !event || !onTime || !held || recs != 0 || q != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I10-D: the context's error; the worker returned (D3 joined, worker-before-publish, within 1 s) while the writer is still blocked in the gate; the table empty while the gate is held: returned %t, err %v, joined %t, event %t, both observed before the 1 s deadline %t, writer held %t, records %d, queue %d", ok, err, joined, event, onTime, held, recs, q)
		}
		composedNoResurrection(t, h, a, c1, bs.Gate, tr, u0, started, false, "I10-D")
		if _, _, d3, _, _, _ := h.Counts(); d3 != 1 {
			t.Errorf("I10-D: 1 setup, got %d", d3)
		}
		t.Log("I10D-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI10ProviderDeadline: E-outer; the key write held at
// H/'s gate; D7's disclosed control replaces the SDK's 15 s window with one
// that never fires, so the provider's real 30 s setup deadline decides.
// Credited as provider-deadline cancellation only with all of (§3.4): (i)
// the control armed for this sequence, and it never fires; (ii) the setup
// context D3 recorded ended with DeadlineExceeded, its deadline 30 s (±1 s)
// from the play's start; (iii) NewStreamer returned after 30 s and before
// 40 s; (iv) at that return the write is still entered and unreleased, the
// writer blocked in the gate. The worker and the writer are counted apart;
// after the release, no resurrection.
func TestDDSonicComposedI10ProviderDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 95)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: true, hooks: true, neverExpire: true})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, "I10-OD")
		_, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bs.B != a {
			t.Fatal("I10-OD precondition: the bundle, its first connection, its gate and its D7 hooks")
		}
		entered := bs.Gate.Arm()
		h.Phase("P1")
		started := h.Event("I10OD-start")
		start := time.Now()
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I10OD-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(entered, 15*time.Second); !ok || !heldWriter() {
			t.Fatal("I10-OD precondition: the key write did not enter the gate, held by the key provider's writer")
		}
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I10-OD: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		held := heldWriter()
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		elapsed := res.at.Sub(start)
		atts, arms := bs.Hooks.Attempts(), bs.Hooks.Armings()
		armed := len(arms) == 1 && len(atts) == 1 && atts[0].Stamped && atts[0].Seq == arms[0] && !atts[0].Returned
		sctx := composedSetupCtx(h, 0)
		var deadlineOK bool
		if sctx != nil {
			dl, has := sctx.Deadline()
			skew := dl.Sub(start.Add(30 * time.Second))
			deadlineOK = errors.Is(sctx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded) && has && skew > -time.Second && skew < time.Second
		}
		joined, event, onTime := composedWorkerReturned(h, started, time.Second)
		if !armed || !deadlineOK || elapsed <= 30*time.Second || elapsed >= 40*time.Second || !held || !errors.Is(res.err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || !joined || !event || !onTime {
			t.Errorf("I10-OD: (i) the never-firing control armed for this sequence, its write held: %t (armings %v, attempts %+v); (ii) the setup context ended at the provider's 30 s deadline: %t; (iii) returned after 30 s and before 40 s: %s; (iv) the writer still held in the gate: %t; final with no recovery: err %v, recoveries %d; the worker returned apart from the writer: joined %t, event %t, both observed before the 1 s deadline %t", armed, arms, atts, deadlineOK, elapsed, held, res.err, h.Decisions("begin"), joined, event, onTime)
		}
		_, _, u0 := composedKeyState(a)
		composedNoResurrection(t, h, a, c1, bs.Gate, tr, u0, started, false, "I10-OD")
		t.Logf("I10OD-OBSERVED returned after %s; armings %v", elapsed, arms)
		t.Log("I10OD-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI10SDKWindow: E-outer; the key write held at H/'s gate;
// no expiry control: the SDK's own 15 s window ends the request, final
// before 30 s, with no recovery, the write still held. Credited ONLY as the
// SDK-window finality control, never as provider-deadline cancellation.
// After the release, no resurrection.
func TestDDSonicComposedI10SDKWindow(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 96)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: true})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, "I10-OW")
		_, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bs.B != a {
			t.Fatal("I10-OW precondition: the bundle, its first connection and its gate")
		}
		entered := bs.Gate.Arm()
		h.Phase("P1")
		started := h.Event("I10OW-start")
		start := time.Now()
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I10OW-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(entered, 15*time.Second); !ok || !heldWriter() {
			t.Fatal("I10-OW precondition: the key write did not enter the gate, held by the key provider's writer")
		}
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I10-OW: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		elapsed := res.at.Sub(start)
		// R65-1: the DD setup worker counted apart from the SDK writer (§3.4,
		// every I10 variant): both worker facts for this request (after its
		// start) under ONE 1 s deadline, then the writer still held in the
		// gate, all BEFORE the release.
		joined, event, onTime := composedWorkerReturned(h, started, time.Second)
		held := heldWriter()
		if elapsed >= 30*time.Second || !errors.Is(res.err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || !joined || !event || !onTime || !held {
			t.Errorf("I10-OW: final before 30 s by the SDK's window, no recovery; the worker returned (D3 joined, worker-before-publish, within 1 s) while the writer is still held: after %s, err %v, recoveries %d, joined %t, event %t, both observed before the 1 s deadline %t, writer held %t", elapsed, res.err, h.Decisions("begin"), joined, event, onTime, held)
		}
		_, _, u0 := composedKeyState(a)
		composedNoResurrection(t, h, a, c1, bs.Gate, tr, u0, started, true, "I10-OW")
		t.Logf("I10OW-SDK-WINDOW-CONTROL returned after %s (credited only as the SDK-window finality control)", elapsed)
		t.Log("I10OW-OK")
	})
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// S4b: I13/I14, I13'/I14', I15, I16, I17, I18, I19a, I19b.

// composedB is a P-H real silent build B of the session's current
// generation, held at beforeAccept after its constructor returned, with its
// SC interval checked (its own access point's D10 publication first, R60-1).
// Release publishes it for real; Built then has the build's result.
type composedB struct {
	Call    *composedD1Call
	AP      *ap.Accesspoint
	Conn    *ap.DDSonicComposedConn
	Built   <-chan error
	Release func()
}

func composedBuildB(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, s *Session, marker string) *composedB {
	t.Helper()
	held := newComposedBarrier(h)
	h.OnAccept(func(int) { held.arrive() })
	h.Phase("P-H")
	before := composedSCNow(h, "P-H")
	d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
	ctx, _ := h.Context()
	built := make(chan error, 1)
	gen := s.generation()
	h.Go(marker+"-build", func() { built <- s.reconnectPlayback(ctx, gen) })
	if _, ok := composedWithin(held.Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
		t.Fatalf("%s: B's build did not reach beforeAccept within 30 s", marker)
	}
	var call *composedD1Call
	if calls := h.D1Calls(); len(calls) == d1Before+1 {
		call = calls[d1Before]
	}
	b := &composedB{Call: call, Built: built, Release: held.Release}
	if call != nil && call.Returned() && call.Sess != nil {
		b.AP = call.Sess.Accesspoint()
		if b.Conn = composedConnOf(h, b.AP, 5*time.Second); b.Conn == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: no D10 connection correlated with B's access point within 5 s", marker)
		}
	}
	composedCheckSC(t, marker+"-SC", before, composedSCNow(h, "P-H"), call)
	return b
}

// composedI13 is one I13/I14 ordering. A's key write on c1 fails at H/'s
// gate (the SDK's KeySendError on generation 1) and the recovery waits for
// A. A real B (a P-H build of the session's generation, its counter moved
// by k real reconnects of B) is published for real, held in the
// detach-to-retire gap, at mode: "before" the wait (the recovery held at
// begin), "during" it (before-wait released first), or "between" the DR's
// registration and the wait's select (the recovery held at before-wait;
// I13'/I14'). In every ordering: A is not retired at the observation or at
// the decision; B's publication decides the recovery (through the owner
// channel when it was waiting); the open goes to B's real player and plays;
// B is not rebuilt. lower: A is first driven through a REAL reconnect whose
// generation-2 connection carries the bundle's RB-1 gate, failing, so A's
// play stamps and fails its write on generation 2 while a real B (k = 0) is
// at generation 1: B's counter is LOWER.
func composedI13(t *testing.T, n byte, k int, mode string, lower bool) {
	row := "I13/I14 " + mode
	if lower {
		row += " lower"
	}
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		opts := composedServiceOpts{gate: true, hooks: true, fail: map[int]bool{1: true}}
		if lower {
			opts = composedServiceOpts{hooks: true}
		}
		serviced := composedOnService(h, opts)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, row)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		if a == nil || bs.B != a {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the bundle and its gated access point", row)
		}
		aGen := uint64(1)
		if lower {
			c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
			if c1 == nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: A's first connection", row)
			}
			rg := composedArmRegate(t, h, a.sess.Accesspoint(), 2, row)
			// ONE declared 15 s reconnect allowance, from the peer close, for
			// the gate's application, A's generation 2 AND (R66-1) D10's
			// publication of A's generation-2 authenticated connection: F-AP
			// counts that login only after its welcome, so the client can
			// see generation 2 first; B's SC baseline below is read only
			// after that publication, correlated to A's own current
			// connection.
			reconnectBy := time.Now().Add(15 * time.Second)
			if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: A's peer close: %v", row, err)
			}
			if _, ok := composedWithin(rg.Applied(), time.Until(reconnectBy)); !ok || composedWaitGen(a, 2, time.Until(reconnectBy)) != 2 {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: A's real reconnect to generation 2, with the reconnect gate applied", row)
			}
			if c2 := composedConnOf(h, a.sess.Accesspoint(), time.Until(reconnectBy)); c2 == nil || c2 == c1 {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: D10 did not publish A's generation-2 authenticated connection within the reconnect allowance", row)
			}
			aGen = 2
		}
		b := composedBuildB(t, h, s, "I13-B")
		if b.AP == nil || b.Conn == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: B's access point and connection", row)
		}
		for i := 0; i < k; i++ {
			c := composedConnOf(h, b.AP, 5*time.Second)
			g := composedAPGen(b.AP)
			if c == nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: B's current connection", row)
			}
			if err := c.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: B's peer close: %v", row, err)
			}
			if composedWaitAPGen(b.AP, g+1, 15*time.Second) != g+1 {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: B's real reconnect %d did not complete", row, i+1)
			}
		}
		bGen := composedAPGen(b.AP)
		point := "before-wait"
		if mode == "before" {
			point = "begin"
		}
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, point, "decided")
		det := composedOnDetaches(h, "publish")
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		h.Phase("P1")
		_, _, d3Before, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		base := composedBudgetStart(h, bs.Hooks)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I13-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar[point].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the recovery did not reach %s within 15 s", row, point)
		}
		atts := bs.Hooks.Attempts()
		if len(atts) != 1 || atts[0].Gen != aGen || !errors.Is(atts[0].Err, errComposedGateFail) || atts[0].APDone {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: A's one write, stamped for generation %d, failed at the gate with Done open: %+v", row, aGen, atts)
		}
		if _, cur := h.Bundle(p); cur != a || a.ctx.Err() != nil || composedAPDoneOf(a) {
			t.Errorf("%s: A is not retired at the observation: current %t, ctx %v, AP done %t", row, cur == a, a.ctx.Err(), composedAPDoneOf(a))
		}
		if mode == "during" {
			bar[point].Release() // the recovery enters its wait
		}
		published := h.Event("I13-publish")
		b.Release()
		if _, ok := composedWithin(det["publish"].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: B's publication did not reach the detach-to-retire gap within 15 s", row)
		}
		if mode != "during" {
			bar[point].Release()
		}
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["decided"].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the recovery did not decide within 15 s of B's publication", row)
		}
		// At the decision: B is the Session's; A detached, not yet retired.
		_, cur := h.Bundle(p)
		gap := cur != nil && cur != a && b.Call != nil && cur.sess == b.Call.Sess && a.ctx.Err() == nil && h.Detaches("publish") == 1
		bar["decided"].Release()
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		det["publish"].Release()
		h.OnAccept(nil)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s", row)
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		if err, ok := composedWithin(b.Built, 15*time.Second); !ok || err != nil {
			t.Errorf("%s: B's build published: returned %t, %v", row, ok, err)
		}
		composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the open on B did not play: %v", row, res.err)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Errorf("%s: the decoded samples are silent", row)
		}
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		cb := composedConnOf(h, b.AP, 5*time.Second)
		keyOnB := cb != nil && cb.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) == 1
		wantWaits := 1
		if mode == "before" {
			wantWaits = 0
		}
		woke := composedEventsSince(h, "decision:decided", published) == 1 && h.Decisions("decided") == 1
		if !gap || !woke || h.Decisions("before-wait") != wantWaits || len(d4) != 0 || len(h.D1Calls()) != d1Before || d3-d3Before != 2 || !keyOnB {
			t.Errorf("%s: decided after B's publication while A was detached and not retired, %d wait(s), the open on B's real player (its key on B's connection), 0 rebuilds, no new constructor, 2 setups: gap %t, decided after it %t, waits %d, rebuilds %v, D1 +%d, setups %d, key on B %t", row, wantWaits, gap, woke, h.Decisions("before-wait"), d4, len(h.D1Calls())-d1Before, d3-d3Before, keyOnB)
		}
		rel := "equal"
		switch {
		case bGen > aGen:
			rel = "higher"
		case bGen < aGen:
			rel = "lower"
		}
		t.Logf("I13-OBSERVED A's failed write on generation %d; B's generation %d (%s); published %s", aGen, bGen, rel, mode)
		t.Log("I13-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI13I14: KeySendError on A; a real B published before or
// during the wait, its counter LOWER than (A driven through a real
// reconnect, its failed write stamped 2; B at 1), equal to or higher than
// A's failed write's generation: the owner change, never a counter
// comparison, decides.
func TestDDSonicComposedI13I14(t *testing.T) {
	type ordering struct {
		name  string
		n     byte
		k     int
		mode  string
		lower bool
	}
	for _, c := range []ordering{
		{"lower-before", 105, 0, "before", true},
		{"lower-during", 106, 0, "during", true},
		{"equal-before", 101, 0, "before", false},
		{"equal-during", 102, 0, "during", false},
		{"higher-before", 103, 1, "before", false},
		{"higher-during", 104, 1, "during", false},
	} {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) { composedI13(t, c.n, c.k, c.mode, c.lower) })
	}
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI13pI14p: the publication lands between the DR's
// registration and the wait's select (the recovery held at
// decisionHook("before-wait")), and is held in the real detach-to-retire
// gap at the decision (I13'/I14'), with B's counter lower, equal and higher.
func TestDDSonicComposedI13pI14p(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("between-lower", func(t *testing.T) { composedI13(t, 98, 0, "between", true) })
	t.Run("between-equal", func(t *testing.T) { composedI13(t, 107, 0, "between", false) })
	t.Run("between-higher", func(t *testing.T) { composedI13(t, 108, 1, "between", false) })
}

// composedI15 is one I15/I15' ordering: A's key write fails at the gate and
// the recovery waits for A; a real Session.Close, held at
// detachHook("close") (detached, not yet retired), lands before the wait
// (the recovery held at begin) or during it. The play's result is final and
// closed BEFORE the physical retirement; after the release, A is torn down
// as in L6-Close.
func composedI15(t *testing.T, n byte, during bool) {
	row := "I15 close-before"
	point := "begin"
	if during {
		row, point = "I15 close-during", "before-wait"
	}
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: true, hooks: true, fail: map[int]bool{1: true}})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, row)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bs.B != a {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the bundle, its first connection and its gated access point", row)
		}
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, point)
		det := composedOnDetaches(h, "close")
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		h.Phase("P1")
		base := composedBudgetStart(h, bs.Hooks)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I15-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar[point].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the recovery did not reach %s within 15 s", row, point)
		}
		if during {
			bar[point].Release()
		}
		closed := make(chan struct{})
		h.Go("I15-close", func() {
			s.Close()
			close(closed)
		})
		if _, ok := composedWithin(det["close"].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the Close did not reach the detach-to-retire gap within 15 s", row)
		}
		if !during {
			bar[point].Release()
		}
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 30*time.Second)
		retiredAtResult := a.ctx.Err() != nil || h.ClosedLibrespot(a.sess) || composedAPDoneOf(a)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: NewStreamer did not return within 30 s", row)
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if !errors.Is(res.err, errSessionClosed) || retiredAtResult || h.Decisions("begin") != 1 || d3 != 1 || len(d4) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("%s: final and closed before A's physical retirement, no reopen, 0 rebuilds: err %v, A retired at the result %t, recoveries %d, setups %d, rebuilds %v", row, res.err, retiredAtResult, h.Decisions("begin"), d3, d4)
		}
		det["close"].Release()
		if _, ok := composedWithin(closed, 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Errorf("%s: Session.Close did not return within 15 s of the release", row)
		}
		gone := composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return h.ClosedLibrespot(a.sess) })
		ended, byClient := composedClientClosed(c1, 20*time.Second)
		tailsJoined := waitGroupWithin(&tails, 20*time.Second)
		if !gone || !ended || !byClient || !composedAPDoneOf(a) || !tailsJoined {
			t.Errorf("%s: after the release, A torn down as in L6-Close: closeLibrespot ran %t, c1 ended %t and closed by the client %t, AP Done %t, tail joined %t", row, gone, ended, byClient, composedAPDoneOf(a), tailsJoined)
		}
		t.Log("I15-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI15: a real Session.Close before and during the wait,
// with the detach held (I15, I15').
func TestDDSonicComposedI15(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("close-before", func(t *testing.T) { composedI15(t, 109, false) })
	t.Run("close-during", func(t *testing.T) { composedI15(t, 110, true) })
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI16: the step context's expiry and a ready origin signal
// together at the held registration. recoveryTimeout is 2 s; the recovery is
// held at decisionHook("before-wait") while A really advances to generation
// 2 and the step's deadline passes; then released. The decision is final
// with the step's error (the DR reads the context first). There is no
// caller-context variant (§3.1).
func TestDDSonicComposedI16(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 111)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		composedSetRecoveryTimeout(t, h, 2*time.Second)
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: true, hooks: true, fail: map[int]bool{1: true}})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, "I16")
		_, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bs.B != a {
			t.Fatal("I16 precondition: the bundle, its first connection and its gated access point")
		}
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "begin", "before-wait")
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		h.Phase("P1")
		base := composedBudgetStart(h, bs.Hooks)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I16-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["begin"].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I16 precondition: the recovery did not begin within 15 s")
		}
		begun := bar["begin"].At()
		bar["begin"].Release()
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["before-wait"].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I16 precondition: the recovery did not reach before-wait within 15 s")
		}
		// The origin signal: a real advance of A.
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I16: peer close: %v", err)
		}
		c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
		if c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, 2, 15*time.Second) != 2 {
			t.Fatal("I16 precondition: the origin's advance did not complete")
		}
		// The step's deadline: at most 2 s after the begin arrival.
		time.Sleep(time.Until(begun.Add(2*time.Second + 250*time.Millisecond)))
		bar["before-wait"].Release()
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 15*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I16: NewStreamer did not return within 15 s of the release")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if !errors.Is(res.err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || h.Decisions("decided") != 1 || h.Decisions("before-wait") != 1 || d3 != 1 || len(d4) != 0 || c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I16: final with the step's error, with the origin's signal ready too; no reopen; 0 rebuilds: err %v, decisions %d, waits %d, setups %d, rebuilds %v, key packets on c2 %d", res.err, h.Decisions("decided"), h.Decisions("before-wait"), d3, d4, c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey))
		}
		t.Log("I16-OK")
	})
}

// composedI17 is I17's same-access-point wake: A's key write fails at the
// gate and the recovery waits; then (advance) a real advance of A, the open
// on the same bundle with 0 rebuilds; or (done) A's real Done (it closes for
// good), 1 rebuild of the origin's generation (one SC) and the reopen on the
// new bundle.
func composedI17(t *testing.T, n byte, done bool) {
	row := "I17 advance"
	if done {
		row = "I17 done"
	}
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: true, hooks: true, fail: map[int]bool{1: true}})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, row)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bs.B != a {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the bundle, its first connection and its gated access point", row)
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "before-wait", "decided")
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		h.Phase("P2")
		_, _, d3Before, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		base := composedBudgetStart(h, bs.Hooks)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I17-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["before-wait"].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the recovery did not reach before-wait within 15 s", row)
		}
		bar["before-wait"].Release()
		var undo func()
		if done {
			undo = composedMakeTerminal(t, h, a.sess.Accesspoint(), c1)
		} else if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: peer close: %v", row, err)
		}
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["decided"].Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the recovery did not decide within 30 s", row)
		}
		var sc0 composedSC
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		if done {
			if !composedAPDoneOf(a) {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the origin's access point is Done at the decision", row)
			}
			undo()
			sc0 = composedSCNow(h, "P2")
		}
		bar["decided"].Release()
		if done {
			composedRebuildSC(t, h, "I17-SC", "P2", d1Before, sc0)
		}
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok || res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the reopen: returned %t, %v", row, ok, res.err)
		}
		h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Errorf("%s: the decoded samples are silent", row)
		}
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		_, b := h.Bundle(p)
		if done {
			if len(d4) != 1 || d4[0] != gen || b == nil || b == a || d3-d3Before != 2 {
				t.Errorf("%s: 1 rebuild with the origin's generation, the reopen on the new bundle, 2 setups: rebuilds %v (origin %d), new bundle %t, setups %d", row, d4, gen, b != nil && b != a, d3-d3Before)
			}
		} else if len(d4) != 0 || b != a || composedGeneration(a) != 2 || d3-d3Before != 2 {
			t.Errorf("%s: 0 rebuilds, the open on the same bundle at generation 2, 2 setups: rebuilds %v, same %t, generation %d, setups %d", row, d4, b == a, composedGeneration(a), d3-d3Before)
		}
		t.Log("I17-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI17: the same access point's (a) advance, (b) Done.
func TestDDSonicComposedI17(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("advance", func(t *testing.T) { composedI17(t, 112, false) })
	t.Run("done", func(t *testing.T) { composedI17(t, 113, true) })
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI18: error precedence on real packets and states.
// auth: an AesKeyError (the SDK's KeyProviderError) takes the existing auth
// path, a silent rebuild (one SC); a second refusal asks for sign-in for its
// own build (refuseSignIn) with ErrNeedsAuth, 0 browser and 0 token in P2. A
// malformed AesKey answer, the SDK's real 15 s window, and the provider's
// real sequence exhaustion are final with 0 recoveries. Through the
// bundle's RB-2 metadata controls: a restricted track (forbidden in "US",
// the player's country) is final with the SDK's ErrMediaRestricted; the
// relink positive control plays its real alternative (its own file, key,
// CDN object and decoder); an HTTP 500 for the extended-metadata POST is
// final through the SDK's unchanged retries, with its actual error
// reported. ErrKeyProviderNotOwner is unreachable here
// (T/session/session.go :209): the SDK contract S41 and its unit carry it;
// no composed claim is made.
func TestDDSonicComposedI18(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("auth", func(t *testing.T) { composedI18Auth(t, 114) })
	t.Run("malformed-key", func(t *testing.T) { composedI18Final(t, 115, "malformed") })
	t.Run("sdk-window", func(t *testing.T) { composedI18Final(t, 116, "window") })
	t.Run("sequence-exhausted", func(t *testing.T) { composedI18Final(t, 117, "exhausted") })
	t.Run("restricted", func(t *testing.T) { composedI18Metadata(t, 118, "restricted") })
	t.Run("relink", func(t *testing.T) { composedI18Metadata(t, 119, "relink") })
	t.Run("metadata-500", func(t *testing.T) { composedI18Metadata(t, 124, "metadata-500") })
}

// composedI18Metadata is one of I18's metadata subjects, through the
// bundle's RB-2 controls (set before the play): "restricted" (the track
// forbidden in "US", no alternative), "relink" (forbidden, with a real
// alternative track n+1 added to the fixture and answered with its own
// key), "metadata-500" (every extended-metadata POST answered HTTP 500).
func composedI18Metadata(t *testing.T, n byte, kind string) {
	row := "I18 " + kind
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	var alt *composedTrack
	if kind == "relink" {
		alt = composedMP3Track(t, n+1)
	}
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		if alt != nil {
			h.fx.Add(alt)
		}
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		_, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: no bundle or no first connection", row)
		}
		switch kind {
		case "restricted":
			h.fx.Restrict(tr, "US", nil)
		case "relink":
			h.fx.Restrict(tr, "US", alt)
			answerKeys(h, alt)
		case "metadata-500":
			h.fx.SetMetadataStatus(500)
		}
		h.Phase("P1")
		base := composedBudgetStart(h)
		start := time.Now()
		// ONE declared 45 s result-and-observation allowance, set before the
		// result wait; what follows the result spends only its remainder.
		resultBy := time.Now().Add(45 * time.Second)
		res, ok := composedWithin(composedOpenAsync(h, "I18-"+kind, p, tr.URI()), time.Until(resultBy))
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s", row)
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		elapsed := res.at.Sub(start)
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		// R66-2: a receipt is ledgered at its handler's entry (Running, no
		// status) and its status is published only when that handler
		// returns; the client's deadline can end a last request first. So
		// every received extended-metadata handler's completion is awaited,
		// within the allowance's remainder, before the exact snapshot. An
		// unfinished one fails loudly; nothing is dropped or relabelled.
		metaReceipts, meta500, metaRunning := 0, 0, 0
		snapshot := func() bool {
			metaReceipts, meta500, metaRunning = 0, 0, 0
			for _, rc := range h.fx.Ledger() {
				if rc.Path == "/extended-metadata/v0/extended-metadata" {
					metaReceipts++
					if rc.Running {
						metaRunning++
					} else if rc.Status == 500 {
						meta500++
					}
				}
			}
			return metaRunning == 0
		}
		if !composedWithinTrue(time.Until(resultBy), snapshot) {
			t.Errorf("%s: %d of %d received extended-metadata handlers had not completed within the 45 s allowance", row, metaRunning, metaReceipts)
		}
		switch kind {
		case "restricted":
			if !errors.Is(res.err, librespot.ErrMediaRestricted) || composedKeysReceived(h) != 0 || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || d3 != 1 || len(d4) != 0 {
				t.Errorf("%s: final with the SDK's ErrMediaRestricted, no key request, 0 recoveries, 1 setup, 0 rebuilds: err %v, keys %d, recoveries %d, setups %d, rebuilds %v", row, res.err, composedKeysReceived(h), h.Decisions("begin"), d3, d4)
			}
		case "relink":
			if res.err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: the relinked play: %v", row, res.err)
			}
			if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
				t.Errorf("%s: the alternative's decoded samples are silent", row)
			}
			pkt, got := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 5*time.Second)
			keyIsAlt := got && len(pkt.Payload) >= 36 && bytes.Equal(pkt.Payload[:20], alt.FileID) && bytes.Equal(pkt.Payload[20:36], alt.ID.Id())
			cdnAlt, cdnOrig := 0, 0
			for _, rec := range h.fx.CDN() {
				switch rec.File {
				case alt.FileHex():
					cdnAlt++
				case tr.FileHex():
					cdnOrig++
				}
			}
			if !keyIsAlt || cdnAlt == 0 || cdnOrig != 0 || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || d3 != 1 || len(d4) != 0 {
				t.Errorf("%s: the relink plays the real alternative: its own key request (file and gid), its own CDN object, none of the restricted track's, 0 recoveries, 1 setup: key for the alternative %t, CDN alternative %d, restricted %d, recoveries %d, setups %d, rebuilds %v", row, keyIsAlt, cdnAlt, cdnOrig, h.Decisions("begin"), d3, d4)
			}
		case "metadata-500":
			if res.err == nil || meta500 < 2 || meta500 != metaReceipts || composedKeysReceived(h) != 0 || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || d3 != 1 || len(d4) != 0 {
				t.Errorf("%s: final through the SDK's own retries of the real HTTP 500 (at least 2 receipts, every one 500), no key request, 0 recoveries, 1 setup, 0 rebuilds: err %v, receipts %d (500: %d), keys %d, recoveries %d, setups %d, rebuilds %v", row, res.err, metaReceipts, meta500, composedKeysReceived(h), h.Decisions("begin"), d3, d4)
			}
		}
		t.Logf("I18-%s-OBSERVED after %s: %v (extended-metadata receipts %d, HTTP 500 %d)", kind, elapsed, res.err, metaReceipts, meta500)
	})
}

func composedI18Auth(t *testing.T, n byte) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("I18 auth precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "decided")
		h.Phase("P2")
		_, _, d3Before, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		base := composedBudgetStart(h)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I18-auth-play", p, tr.URI())
		pkt, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I18 auth precondition: the key request on c1")
		}
		if err := composedAnswerKeyError(c1, pkt, 1); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I18 auth: the AesKeyError answer: %v", err)
		}
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["decided"].Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I18 auth: the recovery did not decide within 30 s")
		}
		sc0 := composedSCNow(h, "P2")
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		bar["decided"].Release()
		call := composedRebuildSC(t, h, "I18-auth-SC", "P2", d1Before, sc0)
		x := composedConnOf(h, call.Sess.Accesspoint(), 5*time.Second)
		if x == nil {
			t.Fatal("I18 auth: no connection for the rebuilt bundle")
		}
		pkt2, ok := x.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 30*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I18 auth precondition: the reopen's key request")
		}
		if err := composedAnswerKeyError(x, pkt2, 1); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I18 auth: the second AesKeyError answer: %v", err)
		}
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I18 auth: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		_, _, d3, d5, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		r := h.router
		if !errors.Is(res.err, playlist.ErrNeedsAuth) || !s.signInRefused() || len(d4) != 1 || d4[0] != gen || h.Decisions("begin") != 1 || d3-d3Before != 2 ||
			d5 != 0 || r.Count("P2", "A7") != 0 || r.Count("P2", "A8") != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I18 auth: one silent rebuild of the origin's generation, then sign-in asked for its own build with ErrNeedsAuth, 1 recovery, 2 setups, 0 browser, 0 token, 0 Web API in P2: err %v, refused %t, rebuilds %v (origin %d), recoveries %d, setups %d, D5 %d, A7 %d, A8 %d",
				res.err, s.signInRefused(), d4, gen, h.Decisions("begin"), d3-d3Before, d5, r.Count("P2", "A7"), r.Count("P2", "A8"))
		}
		t.Log("I18-AUTH-OK")
	})
}

// composedI18Final is one of I18's final classes: "malformed" (an AesKey
// answer whose key is 8 bytes), "window" (the request withheld: the SDK's
// real 15 s window), "exhausted" (the provider's sequence allocator set to
// its end at the pre-request boundary, D7): each final, 0 recoveries.
func composedI18Final(t *testing.T, n byte, kind string) {
	row := "I18 " + kind
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		_, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: no bundle or no first connection", row)
		}
		if kind == "exhausted" {
			if err := audio.DDSonicComposedExhaust(a.sess.AudioKey()); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: %v", row, err)
			}
		}
		h.Phase("P1")
		base := composedBudgetStart(h)
		start := time.Now()
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I18-"+kind, p, tr.URI())
		switch kind {
		case "malformed":
			pkt, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second)
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the key request on c1", row)
			}
			if err := composedAnswerMalformed(c1, pkt); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: the malformed answer: %v", row, err)
			}
		case "window":
			if _, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second); !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the key request on c1 (withheld)", row)
			}
		}
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s", row)
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		elapsed := res.at.Sub(start)
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		final := false
		switch kind {
		case "malformed":
			final = res.err != nil && strings.Contains(res.err.Error(), "malformed aes key response")
		case "window":
			final = errors.Is(res.err, context.DeadlineExceeded) && elapsed >= 15*time.Second && elapsed < 30*time.Second
		case "exhausted":
			final = errors.Is(res.err, audio.ErrKeySequenceExhausted) && c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) == 0
		}
		if !final || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || d3 != 1 || len(d4) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("%s: final as itself with 0 recoveries, 1 setup, 0 rebuilds: err %v after %s, final %t, recoveries %d, setups %d, rebuilds %v", row, res.err, elapsed, final, h.Decisions("begin"), d3, d4)
		}
		t.Logf("I18-FINAL-OK %s after %s: %v", kind, elapsed, res.err)
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI19a: a real detach before acceptance. The play's ready
// result is held at openHook("caller-before-accept") while a real B (one SC)
// is published; the open ends with errSessionChanged, final, with no
// recovery.
func TestDDSonicComposedI19a(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 121)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		if a == nil {
			t.Fatal("I19a precondition: no bundle")
		}
		reached, proceed := composedReadyHold(h)
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		h.Phase("P1")
		base := composedBudgetStart(h)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I19a-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(reached, 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I19a precondition: the ready result did not reach caller-before-accept within 30 s")
		}
		b := composedBuildB(t, h, s, "I19a-B")
		b.Release()
		if err, ok := composedWithin(b.Built, 30*time.Second); !ok || err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I19a precondition: B was not published: returned %t, %v", ok, err)
		}
		h.OnAccept(nil)
		if _, cur := h.Bundle(p); cur == nil || cur == a || b.Call == nil || cur.sess != b.Call.Sess {
			t.Fatal("I19a precondition: the Session is on B")
		}
		proceed()
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 30*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I19a: NewStreamer did not return within 30 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		_, _, _, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if !errors.Is(res.err, errSessionChanged) || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || len(d4) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I19a: errSessionChanged, final, no recovery: err %v, recoveries %d, rebuilds %v", res.err, h.Decisions("begin"), d4)
		}
		closes := int32(-1)
		if decs := h.Decoders(); len(decs) > 0 {
			closes = decs[len(decs)-1].Closes()
		}
		t.Logf("I19A-OBSERVED %v; the rejected ready stream's counted decoder Close %d (L4's disposal row asserts it)", res.err, closes)
		t.Log("I19A-OK")
	})
}

// composedI19b is I19b: a real detach AFTER the first error's acceptance and
// BEFORE the recovery's decision. A's key write fails at the gate; D2's
// attempt-1 returned record (the bundle's RB-3) is positively observed to
// carry that accepted origin error (the SDK's KeySendError on generation 1,
// the gate's error, on A's origin). With the recovery held at
// decisionHook("begin"), a real B (one SC, built and held before the play)
// is published (owner), or the Session is closed for real (closed). On the
// release: the open goes to the current owner B and plays; or the play is
// final, closed. Ready-stream rejection is L4's.
func composedI19b(t *testing.T, n byte, closed bool) {
	row := "I19b owner"
	if closed {
		row = "I19b closed"
	}
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: true, hooks: true, fail: map[int]bool{1: true}})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, row)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		if a == nil || bs.B != a {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the bundle and its gated access point", row)
		}
		var b *composedB
		if !closed {
			b = composedBuildB(t, h, s, "I19b-B")
			if b.AP == nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: B's access point", row)
			}
		}
		rec := composedRecordD2(h)
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "begin")
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		h.Phase("P1")
		_, d2Before, d3Before, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		base := composedBudgetStart(h, bs.Hooks)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I19b-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["begin"].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the recovery did not begin within 15 s", row)
		}
		first, recorded := rec.Returned(d2Before + 1)
		var oe *originError
		var sendFail *audio.KeySendError
		if !recorded || first.Stream || !errors.As(first.Err, &oe) || oe.origin != a || !errors.As(first.Err, &sendFail) || sendFail.Gen != 1 || !errors.Is(first.Err, errComposedGateFail) {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: D2 attempt 1 returned the accepted KeySendError (generation 1, the gate's error) on A's origin: recorded %t, err %v", row, recorded, first.Err)
		}
		if closed {
			done := make(chan struct{})
			h.Go("I19b-close", func() {
				s.Close()
				close(done)
			})
			if _, ok := composedWithin(done, 15*time.Second); !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s: Session.Close did not return within 15 s", row)
			}
		} else {
			b.Release()
			if err, ok := composedWithin(b.Built, 30*time.Second); !ok || err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: B was not published: returned %t, %v", row, ok, err)
			}
			h.OnAccept(nil)
			if _, cur := h.Bundle(p); cur == nil || b.Call == nil || cur.sess != b.Call.Sess {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the Session is on B", row)
			}
		}
		bar["begin"].Release()
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s", row)
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		_, d2, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if closed {
			if !errors.Is(res.err, errSessionClosed) || d2-d2Before != 1 || d3-d3Before != 1 || len(d4) != 0 || h.Decisions("before-wait") != 0 {
				t.Errorf("%s: final, closed, with no reopen and no rebuild: err %v, opens %d, setups %d, rebuilds %v, waits %d", row, res.err, d2-d2Before, d3-d3Before, d4, h.Decisions("before-wait"))
			}
			t.Log("I19B-CLOSED-OK")
			return
		}
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the open on the current owner B did not play: %v", row, res.err)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Errorf("%s: the decoded samples are silent", row)
		}
		cb := composedConnOf(h, b.AP, 5*time.Second)
		keyOnB := cb != nil && cb.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) == 1
		if !keyOnB || d2-d2Before != 2 || d3-d3Before != 2 || len(d4) != 0 || len(h.D1Calls()) != d1Before || h.Decisions("before-wait") != 0 {
			t.Errorf("%s: the reopen on the current owner B (its key on B's connection), 2 opens, 2 setups, no rebuild, no new constructor, no wait: key on B %t, opens %d, setups %d, rebuilds %v, D1 +%d, waits %d", row, keyOnB, d2-d2Before, d3-d3Before, d4, len(h.D1Calls())-d1Before, h.Decisions("before-wait"))
		}
		t.Log("I19B-OWNER-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI19b: a real detach after acceptance, before recovery:
// the reopen on the current owner, or final when the Session is closed.
func TestDDSonicComposedI19b(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("owner", func(t *testing.T) { composedI19b(t, 122, false) })
	t.Run("closed", func(t *testing.T) { composedI19b(t, 123, true) })
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
