// M3B2-S5 (plan v9 §12 step 5): I20-I30, I27/I27′ and F1a-F1c. S5a: the
// helpers they share (G3-G5).

// composedD2Hold holds one D2 call at one point of one attempt (RB-3's
// call-through points, H' :2088-2103: one real Session.NewStream call with
// its original result, the test's function outside h.mu, on the calling
// goroutine). It records every D2 event too, in order, as composedRecordD2
// does; the held event gets its own numbered harness event. T1 releases it.
type composedD2Hold struct {
	*composedBarrier
	rec *composedD2Rec
	mu  sync.Mutex
	ev  composedD2Event
	seq int64
}

func composedHoldD2(h *composedHarness, point string, attempt int) *composedD2Hold {
	x := &composedD2Hold{composedBarrier: newComposedBarrier(h), rec: &composedD2Rec{}}
	h.OnNewStream(func(ev composedD2Event) {
		x.rec.mu.Lock()
		x.rec.evs = append(x.rec.evs, ev)
		x.rec.mu.Unlock()
		if ev.Point != point || ev.Attempt != attempt {
			return
		}
		seq := h.Event(fmt.Sprintf("d2-held:%s:%d", point, attempt))
		x.mu.Lock()
		x.ev, x.seq = ev, seq
		x.mu.Unlock()
		x.arrive()
	})
	return x
}

// Held is the held event and its harness event's number; call it after
// Reached.
func (x *composedD2Hold) Held() (composedD2Event, int64) {
	x.mu.Lock()
	defer x.mu.Unlock()
	return x.ev, x.seq
}

// composedEventAt is the number of the first harness event after the event
// numbered since whose name starts with prefix, or 0.
func composedEventAt(h *composedHarness, prefix string, since int64) int64 {
	for _, e := range h.Events() {
		num, name, _ := strings.Cut(e, ":")
		if v, _ := strconv.ParseInt(num, 10, 64); v > since && strings.HasPrefix(name, prefix) {
			return v
		}
	}
	return 0
}

// composedEventsIn counts the harness events whose name starts with prefix,
// numbered after from and before to.
func composedEventsIn(h *composedHarness, prefix string, from, to int64) int {
	n := 0
	for _, e := range h.Events() {
		num, name, _ := strings.Cut(e, ":")
		if v, _ := strconv.ParseInt(num, 10, 64); v > from && v < to && strings.HasPrefix(name, prefix) {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

// composedKeyFor reports whether req is a key request for tr's file: its
// first 20 bytes are the file id (commit, audio/provider.go :344-360).
func composedKeyFor(req ap.Packet, tr *composedTrack) bool {
	return req.Type == ap.PacketTypeRequestKey && len(req.Payload) >= 20 && bytes.Equal(req.Payload[:20], tr.FileID)
}

// composedAnswerKeysFor answers each key request with the key of the track
// whose file it names, and leaves any other unanswered (I26's two tracks).
func composedAnswerKeysFor(h *composedHarness, trs ...*composedTrack) {
	h.ap.SetAutoKey(func(req ap.Packet) []byte {
		for _, tr := range trs {
			if composedKeyFor(req, tr) {
				return tr.Key
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
}

// composedChanClosed reports whether ch, which is never sent on, is closed.
func composedChanClosed(ch <-chan struct{}) bool {
	select {
	case <-ch:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// composedBuildStored is I22's newer build (G4): a real P-H build from the
// stored credential and the fixture's token (NewSessionSilent, P0's stored
// startup), published NON-silently through the product's own reconnect:
// silent false, with the provider's sign-in count moved by its published
// callback, as signIn's browser path publishes (build_ddsonic.go :344),
// with no browser exercised (plan v9 §8 I22). It is held at beforeAccept
// after its constructor returned, with its interval checked against §3.2's
// stored-startup profile once its own access point's D10 publication is
// seen. Release publishes it; Built then has its result.
func composedBuildStored(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, s *Session, p *SpotifyProvider, marker string) *composedB {
	t.Helper()
	held := newComposedBarrier(h)
	h.OnAccept(func(int) { held.arrive() })
	h.Phase("P-H")
	before := composedSCNow(h, "P-H")
	d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
	ctx, _ := h.Context()
	built := make(chan error, 1)
	from := s.generation()
	h.Go(marker+"-build", func() {
		built <- s.reconnect(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, clientID string) (*Session, error) {
			return NewSessionSilent(ctx, clientID)
		}, from, false, func() { p.authEpoch.Add(1) })
	})
	if _, ok := composedWithin(held.Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
		t.Fatalf("%s: the newer build did not reach beforeAccept within 30 s", marker)
	}
	var call *composedD1Call
	if calls := h.D1Calls(); len(calls) == d1Before+1 {
		call = calls[d1Before]
	}
	b := &composedB{Call: call, Built: built, Release: held.Release}
	if call != nil && call.Returned() && call.Sess != nil {
		b.AP = call.Sess.Accesspoint()
		if b.Conn = composedConnOf(h, b.AP, 5*time.Second); b.Conn == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: no D10 connection correlated with the newer build's access point within 5 s", marker)
		}
	}
	composedCheckSCWant(t, marker+"-SC", composedSCStoredWant, before, composedSCNow(h, "P-H"), call)
	return b
}

// composedReplacedFirst is the I2-shaped first failure of I23-I25 and of
// I27′'s B9 orders: the play's key request on c1 is withheld, the peer
// closes c1 and the real reconnect publishes generation 2 on c2, so the
// request's connection was replaced. It returns c2.
func composedReplacedFirst(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, a *playback, c1 *ap.DDSonicComposedConn, tr *composedTrack, row string) *ap.DDSonicComposedConn {
	t.Helper()
	pkt, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second)
	if !ok || !composedKeyFor(pkt, tr) {
		t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the play's key request on c1 (withheld)", row)
	}
	if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: peer close: %v", row, err)
	}
	c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
	if c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, 2, 15*time.Second) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the reconnect (c2, generation 2) did not complete", row)
	}
	return c2
}

// composedReplacedOn reports whether D2 attempt n returned the accepted
// ConnectionReplacedError{1,2} on origin's build gen: an originError that
// is not beforeWork, so made only after the acceptance section passed
// (playback_ddsonic.go :376-392; the beforeWork one is holdPlayback's,
// :282-284).
func composedReplacedOn(rec *composedD2Rec, n int, origin *playback, gen uint64) bool {
	ev, ok := rec.Returned(n)
	var oe *originError
	var replaced *audio.ConnectionReplacedError
	return ok && !ev.Stream && errors.As(ev.Err, &oe) && oe.origin == origin && oe.gen == gen && !oe.beforeWork &&
		errors.As(ev.Err, &replaced) && replaced.Sent == 1 && replaced.Now == 2
}

// composedBudgetBase is what one play's I27 budget counts from (plan v9 §8
// I8, I27), read just before the play starts: recoveries, setups,
// rebuilds, key requests received by F-AP, and the writes stamped by the
// D7 hooks of the bundles serviced so far.
type composedBudgetBase struct {
	begin, d3, d4, keys, stamped int
	hooks                        []*audio.DDSonicComposedKeyHooks
}

// composedStamped is how many writes hooks have stamped.
func composedStamped(hooks []*audio.DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) int {
	n := 0
	for _, k := range hooks {
		if k == nil {
			continue
		}
		for _, at := range k.Attempts() {
			if at.Stamped {
				n++
			}
		}
	}
	return n
}

func composedBudgetStart(h *composedHarness, hooks ...*audio.DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) composedBudgetBase {
	_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
	return composedBudgetBase{begin: h.Decisions("begin"), d3: d3, d4: len(d4), keys: composedKeysReceived(h), stamped: composedStamped(hooks), hooks: hooks}
}

// composedBudgetEntry is one play's own counts in the I27 ledger, copied
// numbers only. Its key-write domains stay separate and are never added:
// Keys is F-AP's received RequestKey packets on every connection (always
// observed); Stamped is D7's stamped writes on the Hooked providers that
// had hooks (0 hooked: not observed, which is not evidence of zero writes).
type composedBudgetEntry struct {
	Recoveries, Setups, Keys, Stamped, Hooked, Rebuilds int
}

// within is I8's request-wide cap on each observed domain: at most 1
// recovery, 2 setups (D3; a beforeWork attempt is not one), 2 key requests
// received, 2 writes stamped, and 1 rebuild (D4).
func (e composedBudgetEntry) within() bool {
	return e.Recoveries <= 1 && e.Setups <= 2 && e.Keys <= 2 && e.Stamped <= 2 && e.Rebuilds <= 1
}

func (e composedBudgetEntry) String() string {
	stamped := "not-observed"
	if e.Hooked > 0 {
		stamped = fmt.Sprintf("%d(hooked=%d)", e.Stamped, e.Hooked)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("recoveries=%d setups=%d keys=%d stamped=%s rebuilds=%d", e.Recoveries, e.Setups, e.Keys, stamped, e.Rebuilds)
}

// composedHooked is how many of hooks are installed.
func composedHooked(hooks []*audio.DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) int {
	n := 0
	for _, k := range hooks {
		if k != nil {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

// composedBudgetMu guards composedBudgetLedger and composedBudgetRecords.
var composedBudgetMu sync.Mutex

// composedBudgetLedger is every budgeted play of the process, by name, and
// composedBudgetRecords how often each name was recorded. I27Audit's
// ledger subtest reads them after the rows, which run first in source
// order.
var composedBudgetLedger = map[string]composedBudgetEntry{}

var composedBudgetRecords = map[string]int{}

// composedBudget is one play's I27 budget, counted from base; later are the
// D7 hooks of bundles serviced after base (their counts start at 0). It
// records and checks the play under name.
func composedBudget(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, name string, base composedBudgetBase, later ...*audio.DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) composedBudgetEntry {
	t.Helper()
	_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
	e := composedBudgetEntry{
		Recoveries: h.Decisions("begin") - base.begin,
		Setups:     d3 - base.d3,
		Keys:       composedKeysReceived(h) - base.keys,
		Stamped:    composedStamped(base.hooks) - base.stamped + composedStamped(later),
		Hooked:     composedHooked(base.hooks) + composedHooked(later),
		Rebuilds:   len(d4) - base.d4,
	}
	composedBudgetRecord(t, name, e)
	return e
}

// composedBudgetRecord records one play's counts under name, logs them,
// and checks them against the cap; a second record of a name fails here
// and in the ledger audit.
func composedBudgetRecord(t *testing.T, name string, e composedBudgetEntry) {
	t.Helper()
	composedBudgetMu.Lock()
	composedBudgetRecords[name]++
	dup := composedBudgetRecords[name] > 1
	composedBudgetLedger[name] = e
	composedBudgetMu.Unlock()
	t.Logf("I27-BUDGET %s %s", name, e)
	if dup || !e.within() {
		t.Errorf("I27 %s: one play's request-wide cap (at most 1 recovery, 2 setups, 2 key writes received and 2 stamped, 1 rebuild), recorded once: %s, recorded before %t", name, e, dup)
	}
}

// composedFLACSHA256 binds the long FLAC fixture (testdata/FIXTURES.md).
const composedFLACSHA256 = "21224254b44d90a6502f3431929481e93a8df9bd043ce04c5bce154b149fe385"

// composedFLACTrack is the long real FLAC fixture (plan v9 §7, F1),
// authenticated before use by its recorded size, SHA-256 and magic, as a
// FLAC_FLAC track (its AUDIO_FILES answer is FLAC only); and its
// STREAMINFO's total samples per channel, read from those bytes.
func composedFLACTrack(t *testing.T, n byte) (*composedTrack, int) {
	t.Helper()
	plain, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("testdata", "composed-long.flac.bin"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("F1 precondition: the long FLAC fixture: %v", err)
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(plain)
	if len(plain) != 3222311 || fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum) != composedFLACSHA256 || string(plain[:4]) != "fLaC" || plain[4]&0x7f != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("F1 precondition: the long FLAC fixture is not the recorded one: %d bytes, sha256 %x", len(plain), sum)
	}
	// STREAMINFO, the first block, from byte 8: after 10 bytes of block and
	// frame sizes, 64 bits of a 20-bit sample rate, 3-bit channels - 1,
	// 5-bit bits per sample - 1 and 36-bit total samples.
	v := binary.BigEndian.Uint64(plain[18:26])
	if rate, channels, bits := v>>44, (v>>41)&7+1, (v>>36)&31+1; rate != 44100 || channels != 2 || bits != 16 {
		t.Fatalf("F1 precondition: STREAMINFO says %d Hz, %d channels, %d bits; the fixture is 44100 Hz stereo 16-bit", rate, channels, bits)
	}
	return composedTrackFrom(n, metadatapb.AudioFile_FLAC_FLAC, plain), int(v & (1<<36 - 1))
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// S5b: I20-I25.

// composedI20 is I20 (auth false) and I21 (auth true). The play's first D2
// call is held before the real Session.NewStream (D2 before-hold, attempt
// 1), so before holdPlayback takes any bundle; while it is held a real B
// (P-H, one SC, its own access point's D10 publication) is published; then
// the play takes B. On B: (I20) its access point closes for good, or (I21)
// its key is refused (AesKeyError). The recovery rebuilds B's build, not
// the build the play started on: one SC in P2. Then (I20) the reopen plays,
// or (I21) its key is refused too and sign-in is asked for its own build,
// with no browser.
func composedI20(t *testing.T, n byte, auth bool) {
	row, want := "I20", "the reopen plays"
	if auth {
		row, want = "I21", "sign-in asked for the reopen's own build, ErrNeedsAuth"
	}
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		if a == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: no bundle", row)
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "decided")
		h.Phase("P2")
		_, d2Before, d3Before, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		hold := composedHoldD2(h, "before-hold", d2Before+1)
		start := h.Event(row + "-start")
		base := composedBudgetStart(h)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, row+"-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(hold.Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: D2's before-hold (attempt %d) was not reached within 15 s", row, d2Before+1)
		}
		_, d2H, d3H, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		if _, cur := h.Bundle(p); cur != a || d2H != d2Before+1 || d3H != d3Before || composedEventsSince(h, "open:", start) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: held before holdPlayback, with the Session on A: on A %t, D2 +%d, D3 +%d, open points %d", row, cur == a, d2H-d2Before, d3H-d3Before, composedEventsSince(h, "open:", start))
		}
		b := composedBuildB(t, h, s, row+"-B")
		if b.AP == nil || b.Conn == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: B's access point and connection", row)
		}
		b.Release()
		if err, ok := composedWithin(b.Built, 30*time.Second); !ok || err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: B was not published: returned %t, %v", row, ok, err)
		}
		h.OnAccept(nil)
		_, bb := h.Bundle(p)
		if bb == nil || bb == a || b.Call == nil || bb.sess != b.Call.Sess || s.generation() != gen+1 {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the Session is on B, build %d: on B %t, build %d", row, gen+1, bb != nil && b.Call != nil && bb.sess == b.Call.Sess, s.generation())
		}
		h.Phase("P2")
		hold.Release()
		// The play takes B: its key request, on B's connection.
		pkt, ok := b.Conn.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second)
		if !ok || !composedKeyFor(pkt, tr) {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the play's key request on B's connection", row)
		}
		var undo func()
		if auth {
			if err := composedAnswerKeyError(b.Conn, pkt, 1); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: the AesKeyError answer: %v", row, err)
			}
		} else {
			undo = composedMakeTerminal(t, h, b.AP, b.Conn)
		}
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["decided"].Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the recovery did not decide within 30 s", row)
		}
		if undo != nil {
			if !composedAPDoneOf(bb) {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: B's access point is Done at the decision", row)
			}
			undo() // logins accepted again, before the rebuild dials
			answerKeys(h, tr)
		}
		sc0 := composedSCNow(h, "P2")
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		bar["decided"].Release()
		call := composedRebuildSC(t, h, row+"-SC", "P2", d1Before, sc0)
		if auth {
			x := composedConnOf(h, call.Sess.Accesspoint(), 5*time.Second)
			if x == nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: no connection for the rebuilt bundle", row)
			}
			pkt2, ok := x.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 30*time.Second)
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the reopen's key request", row)
			}
			if err := composedAnswerKeyError(x, pkt2, 1); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: the second AesKeyError answer: %v", row, err)
			}
		}
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s", row)
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		budget := composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		first, recorded := hold.rec.Returned(d2Before + 1)
		var oe *originError
		attributed := recorded && !first.Stream && errors.As(first.Err, &oe) && oe.origin == bb && oe.gen == gen+1 && !oe.beforeWork
		outcome := res.err == nil
		if auth {
			attributed = attributed && isAuthError(first.Err)
			outcome = errors.Is(res.err, playlist.ErrNeedsAuth) && s.signInRefused()
		} else {
			attributed = attributed && errors.Is(first.Err, ap.ErrAccesspointClosed)
		}
		_, cur := h.Bundle(p)
		onC := cur != nil && cur.sess == call.Sess
		_, _, _, d5, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		r := h.router
		if !attributed || !outcome || !onC || len(d4) != 1 || d4[0] != gen+1 || budget.Recoveries != 1 || budget.Setups != 2 || budget.Keys != 2 ||
			d5 != 0 || r.Count("P2", "A7") != 0 || r.Count("P2", "A8") != 0 {
			t.Errorf("%s: the first open's error accepted on B's build %d; one rebuild of B's build; %s, on the rebuilt bundle; 1 recovery, 2 setups, 2 key requests; 0 browser, 0 token, 0 Web API in P2: attributed %t (%v), err %v, on the rebuilt bundle %t, rebuilds %v, budget %s, D5 %d, A7 %d, A8 %d",
				row, gen+1, want, attributed, first.Err, res.err, onC, d4, budget, d5, r.Count("P2", "A7"), r.Count("P2", "A8"))
		}
		if !auth && res.err == nil {
			if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
				t.Errorf("%s: the decoded samples are silent", row)
			}
		}
		t.Logf("%s-OK", row)
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI20: B published at D2's before-hold; terminal on B;
// one rebuild of B's build; the open plays.
func TestDDSonicComposedI20(t *testing.T) { composedI20(t, 150, false) }

// TestDDSonicComposedI21: as I20, with an AesKeyError on B: a silent
// rebuild of B's build; sign-in surfacing; 0 browser.
func TestDDSonicComposedI21(t *testing.T) { composedI20(t, 151, true) }

// TestDDSonicComposedI22: the second auth error is accepted (D2 attempt 2
// returned an originError, not beforeWork, on the rebuilt bundle B1's
// build, after its caller-before-accept) and the play is held there, before
// recoverStream reads it (recovery_ddsonic.go :228-238). Then a real P-H
// build is published NON-silently (G4). Released, refuseSignIn(oe2.gen)
// names B1's build, so it does not refuse the newer one: the play asks for
// sign-in (ErrNeedsAuth), the newer state is preserved, and it plays.
func TestDDSonicComposedI22(t *testing.T) {
	tr, next := composedMP3Track(t, 152), composedMP3Track(t, 153)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		h.fx.Add(next)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("I22 precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "decided")
		h.Phase("P2")
		_, d2Before, _, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		hold := composedHoldD2(h, "returned", d2Before+2)
		start := h.Event("I22-start")
		epoch := p.authEpoch.Load()
		base := composedBudgetStart(h)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I22-play", p, tr.URI())
		pkt, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I22 precondition: the key request on c1")
		}
		if err := composedAnswerKeyError(c1, pkt, 1); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I22: the AesKeyError answer: %v", err)
		}
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["decided"].Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I22: the recovery did not decide within 30 s")
		}
		sc0 := composedSCNow(h, "P2")
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		bar["decided"].Release()
		call := composedRebuildSC(t, h, "I22-SC", "P2", d1Before, sc0)
		x := composedConnOf(h, call.Sess.Accesspoint(), 5*time.Second)
		if x == nil {
			t.Fatal("I22: no connection for the rebuilt bundle")
		}
		pkt2, ok := x.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 30*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I22 precondition: the reopen's key request")
		}
		if err := composedAnswerKeyError(x, pkt2, 1); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I22: the second AesKeyError answer: %v", err)
		}
		if _, ok := composedWithin(hold.Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I22 precondition: D2 attempt 2's returned point was not reached within 30 s")
		}
		// The second error's acceptance, positively: an originError that is
		// not beforeWork, on the bundle the Session is on, B1, made only after
		// the acceptance section passed; and that open's caller-before-accept
		// precedes the held point (both on the recovery's goroutine).
		ev, heldAt := hold.Held()
		_, b1 := h.Bundle(p)
		var oe *originError
		accepts := composedEventsIn(h, "open:caller-before-accept", start, heldAt)
		if ev.Stream || !errors.As(ev.Err, &oe) || oe.beforeWork || b1 == nil || b1 == a || oe.origin != b1 || b1.sess != call.Sess || oe.gen != gen+1 || !isAuthError(ev.Err) || accepts != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("I22 precondition: D2 attempt 2 returned the accepted second auth error on B1's build %d: err %v, accept points before it %d", gen+1, ev.Err, accepts)
		}
		// The newer build, published non-silently while the play is held.
		b2 := composedBuildStored(t, h, s, p, "I22-B2")
		if b2.AP == nil {
			t.Fatal("I22 precondition: the newer build's access point")
		}
		b2.Release()
		if err, ok := composedWithin(b2.Built, 30*time.Second); !ok || err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I22 precondition: the newer build was not published: returned %t, %v", ok, err)
		}
		h.OnAccept(nil)
		_, cur := h.Bundle(p)
		published := composedEventAt(h, "detach:publish", heldAt)
		if cur == nil || cur == b1 || b2.Call == nil || cur.sess != b2.Call.Sess || s.generation() != gen+2 || p.authEpoch.Load() != epoch+1 || published == 0 || s.signInRefused() {
			t.Fatalf("I22 precondition: the newer build published non-silently while the play was held: on it %t, build %d (want %d), sign-ins +%d, publication event %d, refused %t",
				cur != nil && b2.Call != nil && cur.sess == b2.Call.Sess, s.generation(), gen+2, p.authEpoch.Load()-epoch, published, s.signInRefused())
		}
		h.Phase("P2")
		released := h.Event("I22-release")
		hold.Release()
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I22: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		budget := composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		_, after := h.Bundle(p)
		_, _, _, d5, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		r := h.router
		if !errors.Is(res.err, playlist.ErrNeedsAuth) || s.signInRefused() || after != cur || s.generation() != gen+2 || !(heldAt < published && published < released) ||
			len(d4) != 1 || d4[0] != gen || budget.Recoveries != 1 || budget.Setups != 2 || budget.Keys != 2 || d5 != 0 || r.Count("P2", "A7") != 0 || r.Count("P2", "A8") != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I22: sign-in asked for B1's build only (ErrNeedsAuth), the newer build not refused and still the Session's, events accepted < published < released; one rebuild of A's build %d; 1 recovery, 2 setups, 2 key requests; 0 browser, 0 token, 0 Web API in P2: err %v, refused %t, still on the newer build %t, build %d, events %d < %d < %d, rebuilds %v, budget %s, D5 %d, A7 %d, A8 %d",
				gen, res.err, s.signInRefused(), after == cur, s.generation(), heldAt, published, released, d4, budget, d5, r.Count("P2", "A7"), r.Count("P2", "A8"))
		}
		// The newer state plays: a next open, on a distinct track, on it.
		answerKeys(h, next)
		h.Phase("P1")
		nr, ok := composedWithin(composedOpenAsync(h, "I22-next", p, next.URI()), 45*time.Second)
		if !ok || nr.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I22: the newer build's open: returned %t, %v", ok, nr.err)
		}
		h.KeepCloser(nr.s)
		if last := readSamples(t, nr.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("I22: the newer build's decoded samples are silent")
		}
		cb := composedConnOf(h, b2.AP, 5*time.Second)
		if cb == nil || cb.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 1 {
			t.Errorf("I22: the next open's key request on the newer build's connection: %t", cb != nil)
		}
		t.Log("I22-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI23: after an accepted ConnectionReplacedError (D2
// attempt 1 returned it on A's build), the recovery is held at
// decisionHook("begin") while A's access point closes for good. The DR
// reads Done first and takes the terminal form: one rebuild of A's build
// (one SC) and the reopen on the new bundle, which plays.
func TestDDSonicComposedI23(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 154)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("I23 precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		rec := composedRecordD2(h)
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "begin")
		h.Phase("P2")
		_, d2Before, _, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		base := composedBudgetStart(h)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I23-play", p, tr.URI())
		c2 := composedReplacedFirst(t, h, a, c1, tr, "I23")
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["begin"].Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I23: the recovery did not begin within 30 s")
		}
		if !composedReplacedOn(rec, d2Before+1, a, gen) {
			ev, _ := rec.Returned(d2Before + 1)
			t.Fatalf("I23 precondition: D2 attempt 1 returned the accepted ConnectionReplacedError{1,2} on A's build: %v", ev.Err)
		}
		undo := composedMakeTerminal(t, h, a.sess.Accesspoint(), c2)
		if !composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return composedAPDoneOf(a) }) {
			t.Fatal("I23 precondition: A's access point did not become Done (STOP 9)")
		}
		undo()
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		sc0 := composedSCNow(h, "P2")
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		bar["begin"].Release()
		call := composedRebuildSC(t, h, "I23-SC", "P2", d1Before, sc0)
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I23: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		budget := composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I23: the terminal form's reopen did not play: %v", res.err)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("I23: the decoded samples are silent")
		}
		_, cur := h.Bundle(p)
		_, _, _, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if len(d4) != 1 || d4[0] != gen || cur == nil || cur.sess != call.Sess || c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 0 || budget.Recoveries != 1 || budget.Setups != 2 || budget.Keys != 2 {
			t.Errorf("I23: one rebuild of A's build %d, the reopen on the rebuilt bundle, no key request on c2, 1 recovery, 2 setups, 2 key requests: rebuilds %v, on the rebuilt bundle %t, c2 %d, budget %s", gen, d4, cur != nil && cur.sess == call.Sess, c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey), budget)
		}
		t.Log("I23-OK")
	})
}

// composedI24 is I24 (second "") and I27′'s B9 orders. B9: after the
// I2-shaped first failure the decision is actOpen (held at decided); the
// reopen's D2 call is held before the real Session.NewStream (before-hold,
// attempt 2) while A's access point closes for good, so holdPlayback
// refuses before any librespot work (beforeWork: no setup) and the same
// recovery takes the terminal form at acquisition: one rebuild of A's
// build (one SC) and a third open, the only other one to start
// Player.NewStream. With second "", that open plays (I24). Otherwise it
// meets a second failure on the rebuilt bundle C, which must be final with
// no further recovery or rebuild (I27′): "replaced" (C's connection is
// peer-closed under its request), "auth" (AesKeyError: sign-in for C's
// build), "done" (C's access point closes for good), "send" (C's
// generation-1 gate fails the write).
func composedI24(t *testing.T, n byte, second string) {
	row := "I24"
	if second != "" {
		row = "I27p-b9-then-" + second // one token: its SC marker is row+"-SC"
	}
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, n)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		fail := map[int]bool{}
		if second == "send" {
			fail[2] = true // C, the rebuilt bundle, serviced second
		}
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: true, hooks: true, fail: fail})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		bsA := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, row)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bsA.B != a {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the bundle, its first connection and its setup", row)
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "decided")
		h.Phase("P2")
		_, d2Before, d3Before, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		hold := composedHoldD2(h, "before-hold", d2Before+2)
		base := composedBudgetStart(h, bsA.Hooks)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, row+"-play", p, tr.URI())
		c2 := composedReplacedFirst(t, h, a, c1, tr, row)
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["decided"].Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the recovery did not decide within 30 s", row)
		}
		if !composedReplacedOn(hold.rec, d2Before+1, a, gen) || composedAPDoneOf(a) {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the accepted ConnectionReplacedError{1,2} on A's build, A open at the decision", row)
		}
		bar["decided"].Release()
		if _, ok := composedWithin(hold.Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the reopen's D2 call (attempt 2) was not reached within 15 s", row)
		}
		// actOpen: the reopen's call with no rebuild before it (an actRebuild
		// rebuilds before it opens; an actFinal opens nothing).
		_, _, d3H, _, _, d4H := h.Counts()
		if len(d4H) != 0 || d3H != d3Before+1 {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the decision was actOpen: rebuilds %v, setups +%d", row, d4H, d3H-d3Before)
		}
		undo := composedMakeTerminal(t, h, a.sess.Accesspoint(), c2)
		if !composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return composedAPDoneOf(a) }) {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: A's access point did not become Done (STOP 9)", row)
		}
		undo()
		if second == "" {
			answerKeys(h, tr)
		}
		sc0 := composedSCNow(h, "P2")
		d1Before := len(h.D1Calls())
		hold.Release()
		call := composedRebuildSC(t, h, row+"-SC", "P2", d1Before, sc0)
		bsC := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, row+" rebuilt bundle")
		cAP := call.Sess.Accesspoint()
		x := composedConnOf(h, cAP, 5*time.Second)
		if x == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: no connection for the rebuilt bundle", row)
		}
		switch second {
		case "replaced", "auth", "done":
			pkt, ok := x.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 30*time.Second)
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the third open's key request on C", row)
			}
			var err error
			switch second {
			case "replaced":
				err = x.C.PeerClose()
			case "auth":
				err = composedAnswerKeyError(x, pkt, 1)
			case "done":
				composedMakeTerminal(t, h, cAP, x)
			}
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: the second failure: %v", row, err)
			}
		}
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 60*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s: NewStreamer did not return within 60 s", row)
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		budget := composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base, bsC.Hooks)
		ev2, _ := hold.rec.Returned(d2Before + 2)
		var oe2 *originError
		beforeWork := !ev2.Stream && errors.As(ev2.Err, &oe2) && oe2.beforeWork && oe2.origin == a && errors.Is(ev2.Err, ap.ErrAccesspointClosed)
		var replaced *audio.ConnectionReplacedError
		var sendFail *audio.KeySendError
		outcome := false
		switch second {
		case "":
			outcome = res.err == nil && budget.Keys == 2
		case "replaced":
			outcome = errors.As(res.err, &replaced)
		case "auth":
			outcome = errors.Is(res.err, playlist.ErrNeedsAuth) && s.signInRefused()
		case "done":
			outcome = errors.Is(res.err, ap.ErrAccesspointClosed)
		case "send":
			outcome = errors.As(res.err, &sendFail) && sendFail.Gen == 1 && errors.Is(res.err, errComposedGateFail) && x.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) == 0
		}
		_, d2, d3, d5, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		r := h.router
		if !beforeWork || !outcome || d2-d2Before != 3 || d3-d3Before != 2 || len(d4) != 1 || d4[0] != gen || h.Decisions("terminal-at-acquisition") != 1 ||
			budget.Recoveries != 1 || budget.Setups != 2 || d5 != 0 || r.Count("P2", "A7") != 0 || r.Count("P2", "A8") != 0 {
			t.Errorf("%s: attempt 2 refused before work (beforeWork, no setup); terminal-at-acquisition once; one rebuild of A's build %d; three opens, two setups; the third open's outcome as itself; 1 recovery; 0 browser, 0 token, 0 Web API in P2: beforeWork %t (%v), outcome %t (err %v), opens %d, setups %d, rebuilds %v, terminal-at-acquisition %d, budget %s, D5 %d, A7 %d, A8 %d",
				row, gen, beforeWork, ev2.Err, outcome, res.err, d2-d2Before, d3-d3Before, d4, h.Decisions("terminal-at-acquisition"), budget, d5, r.Count("P2", "A7"), r.Count("P2", "A8"))
		}
		if second != "" {
			t.Logf("I27-B9-ORDER-OK %s: %v", second, res.err)
			return
		}
		if res.err == nil {
			if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
				t.Error("I24: the decoded samples are silent")
			}
		}
		t.Log("I24-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI24: B9, the origin's access point closes after
// actOpen and before acquisition.
func TestDDSonicComposedI24(t *testing.T) { composedI24(t, 155, "") }

// TestDDSonicComposedI25: the origin closes for good during the reopen's
// real setup. After the I2-shaped first failure the decision is actOpen;
// the reopen's extended-metadata request is held at the A4 barrier while
// A's access point closes for good; released, the reopen meets the closed
// access point. That second failure is final: exactly one recovery, no
// further begin, no terminal-at-acquisition (the open was not refused
// before work), no rebuild.
func TestDDSonicComposedI25(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 156)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("I25 precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		rec := composedRecordD2(h)
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "decided")
		h.Phase("P2")
		_, d2Before, _, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		base := composedBudgetStart(h)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I25-play", p, tr.URI())
		c2 := composedReplacedFirst(t, h, a, c1, tr, "I25")
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["decided"].Reached(), 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I25: the recovery did not decide within 30 s")
		}
		if !composedReplacedOn(rec, d2Before+1, a, gen) || composedAPDoneOf(a) {
			t.Fatal("I25 precondition: the accepted ConnectionReplacedError{1,2} on A's build, A open at the decision")
		}
		arrived, release := h.fx.Hold("metadata")
		h.OnRelease(release)
		bar["decided"].Release()
		if _, ok := composedWithin(arrived, 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I25 precondition: the reopen's extended-metadata request was not held within 15 s")
		}
		undo := composedMakeTerminal(t, h, a.sess.Accesspoint(), c2)
		if !composedWithinTrue(20*time.Second, func() bool { return composedAPDoneOf(a) }) {
			t.Fatal("I25 precondition: A's access point did not become Done (STOP 9)")
		}
		undo()
		release()
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I25: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		budget := composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		ev2, _ := rec.Returned(d2Before + 2)
		var oe2 *originError
		accepted := !ev2.Stream && errors.As(ev2.Err, &oe2) && oe2.origin == a && !oe2.beforeWork
		final := res.err != nil && errors.Is(res.err, ap.ErrAccesspointClosed) && strings.Contains(res.err.Error(), "new stream after silent reconnect")
		_, _, _, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if !final || !accepted || h.Decisions("begin") != 1 || budget.Recoveries != 1 || h.Decisions("terminal-at-acquisition") != 0 || len(d4) != 0 ||
			budget.Setups != 2 || budget.Keys != 1 || c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("I25: the reopen's own error accepted and final (the closed access point, after the silent reconnect), exactly 1 recovery, no terminal-at-acquisition, no rebuild, 2 setups, 1 key request: err %v, accepted %t (%v), recoveries %d, terminal-at-acquisition %d, rebuilds %v, budget %s, c2 %d",
				res.err, accepted, ev2.Err, h.Decisions("begin"), h.Decisions("terminal-at-acquisition"), d4, budget, c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey))
		}
		t.Log("I25-OK")
	})
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// S5c: I26, I28, I29, I30.

// composedI26 is one of I26's two variants (plan v9 §8 I26). R1 (t1) writes
// its key request on c1, Sent(1), never answered. R2 (t2) runs concurrently
// and its write is held on the provider's one writer: (pre-send) at D7's
// afterStamp point, stamped for generation 1 and not yet written (G1, G9);
// or (physical-send) inside H/'s armed write gate on c1, the connection's
// send path. With the write held, no Ping is sent; the peer closes c1 (EOF)
// and the real reconnect publishes generation 2 on c2 (T/ap/ap.go :302,
// :654). Each play is classified on its own record (R1 sent on 1, R2
// writing on 1): both ConnectionReplacedError{1,2}, observed while the
// write is still held. Released, each play reopens once and plays its own
// track. The one writer serves both, so R1's reopen waits for the release
// too (G10).
func composedI26(t *testing.T, n byte, physical bool) {
	row := "I26 pre-send"
	if physical {
		row = "I26 physical-send"
	}
	t1, t2 := composedMP3Track(t, n), composedMP3Track(t, n+1)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(t1)
		h.fx.Add(t2)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: physical, hooks: true, holds: !physical})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, row)
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bs.B != a || bs.Hooks == nil || (physical && bs.Gate == nil) {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the bundle, its first connection, its hooks and its gate", row)
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		rec := composedRecordD2(h)
		h.Phase("P1")
		_, d2Before, _, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		base := composedBudgetStart(h, bs.Hooks)
		out1 := composedOpenAsync(h, "I26-R1", p, t1.URI())
		pkt1, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second)
		if !ok || !composedKeyFor(pkt1, t1) {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: R1's key request on c1", row)
		}
		sent := composedWithinTrue(5*time.Second, func() bool {
			at := bs.Hooks.Attempts()
			return len(at) == 1 && at[0].Seq == 0 && at[0].Stamped && at[0].Gen == 1 && at[0].Returned && at[0].Err == nil
		})
		if !sent {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: R1's write, sequence 0, stamped for generation 1 and sent: %+v", row, bs.Hooks.Attempts())
		}
		var held <-chan struct{}
		var release func()
		if physical {
			held, release = bs.Gate.Arm(), bs.Gate.Release // its Release is registered for T1 at servicing
		} else {
			var err error
			if held, release, err = bs.Hooks.ArmAfterStamp(1); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s precondition: arming afterStamp: %v", row, err)
			}
			h.OnRelease(release)
		}
		out2 := composedOpenAsync(h, "I26-R2", p, t2.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(held, 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: R2's write was not held within 15 s", row)
		}
		at, r2 := bs.Hooks.Attempts(), bs.Hooks.Record(1)
		if len(at) != 2 || at[1].Seq != 1 || !at[1].Stamped || at[1].Gen != 1 || at[1].Returned || r2.State != "writing" || r2.Stamp != 1 || (physical && !heldWriter()) || c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: R2's write, sequence 1, stamped for generation 1 and held before it returned (physical: the writer in the gate %t), R2's record writing on 1 (%+v), only R1's request received on c1 (%d): %+v",
				row, physical && heldWriter(), r2, c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey), at)
		}
		// EOF on c1: the peer closes it. No Ping is sent and nothing released.
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: peer close: %v", row, err)
		}
		c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
		if c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, 2, 15*time.Second) != 2 || h.ap.Logins() != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the reconnect (c2, generation 2, login 2) with R2's write held (STOP 9)", row)
		}
		classified := composedWithinTrue(15*time.Second, func() bool {
			_, ok1 := rec.Returned(d2Before + 1)
			_, ok2 := rec.Returned(d2Before + 2)
			return ok1 && ok2
		})
		stillHeld := !physical || heldWriter()
		if att := bs.Hooks.Attempts(); len(att) != 2 || att[1].Returned {
			stillHeld = false
		}
		if !classified || !stillHeld {
			t.Fatalf("%s: both first attempts classified while R2's write was still held: classified %t, held %t", row, classified, stillHeld)
		}
		r1Replaced, r2Replaced := composedReplacedOn(rec, d2Before+1, a, gen), composedReplacedOn(rec, d2Before+2, a, gen)
		composedAnswerKeysFor(h, t1, t2)
		release()
		resultBy := time.Now().Add(60 * time.Second)
		res1, ok1 := composedWithin(out1, time.Until(resultBy))
		res2, ok2 := composedWithin(out2, time.Until(resultBy))
		for _, res := range []composedOpen{res1, res2} {
			if res.s != nil {
				h.KeepCloser(res.s)
			}
		}
		if !ok1 || !ok2 || res1.err != nil || res2.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: each play reopens once and plays: R1 returned %t, %v; R2 returned %t, %v", row, ok1, res1.err, ok2, res2.err)
		}
		for _, res := range []composedOpen{res1, res2} {
			if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
				t.Errorf("%s: a play's decoded samples are silent", row)
			}
		}
		// The reopens' key requests on c2, each attributed by its file and
		// sequence.
		reopens := map[*composedTrack][]uint32{}
		for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
			pkt, ok := c2.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 5*time.Second)
			seq, okSeq := composedKeySeq(pkt)
			for _, tr := range []*composedTrack{t1, t2} {
				if ok && okSeq && composedKeyFor(pkt, tr) {
					reopens[tr] = append(reopens[tr], seq)
				}
			}
		}
		stampedFor := func(seqs ...uint32) int {
			k := 0
			for _, at := range bs.Hooks.Attempts() {
				for _, q := range seqs {
					if at.Stamped && at.Seq == q {
						k++
					}
				}
			}
			return k
		}
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		recoveries, setups, rebuilds := h.Decisions("begin")-base.begin, d3-base.d3, len(d4)-base.d4
		stamped := composedStamped(base.hooks) - base.stamped
		// Per play. Writes and key requests are attributed by file and
		// sequence. Recoveries and setups have no per-play counter, so each
		// play's are taken from its own positive lower bounds: a play whose
		// first open (its own D2 attempt, R1's started first) returned its
		// own accepted ConnectionReplacedError, and which then returned a
		// stream, ran one recovery and two setups (that first open's
		// Player.NewStream, and the reopen whose key request for its own
		// file reached c2). Only when the totals EQUAL the sum of the two
		// lower bounds is each play exactly at its bound; otherwise every
		// play is charged the whole total, which fails the cap. No total is
		// split by convention.
		type bound struct{ recoveries, setups int }
		lower := func(replaced bool, keyOnC2 int) bound {
			var b bound
			if replaced {
				b.recoveries, b.setups = 1, 1
			}
			if replaced && keyOnC2 >= 1 {
				b.setups++
			}
			return b
		}
		lb1, lb2 := lower(r1Replaced, len(reopens[t1])), lower(r2Replaced, len(reopens[t2]))
		r1rec, r1set, r2rec, r2set := recoveries, setups, recoveries, setups
		if recoveries == lb1.recoveries+lb2.recoveries && setups == lb1.setups+lb2.setups {
			r1rec, r1set, r2rec, r2set = lb1.recoveries, lb1.setups, lb2.recoveries, lb2.setups
		}
		e1 := composedBudgetEntry{Recoveries: r1rec, Setups: r1set, Keys: 1 + len(reopens[t1]), Stamped: stampedFor(append([]uint32{0}, reopens[t1]...)...), Hooked: 1, Rebuilds: rebuilds}
		e2 := composedBudgetEntry{Recoveries: r2rec, Setups: r2set, Keys: len(reopens[t2]), Stamped: stampedFor(append([]uint32{1}, reopens[t2]...)...), Hooked: 1, Rebuilds: rebuilds}
		composedBudgetRecord(t, t.Name()+"#R1", e1)
		composedBudgetRecord(t, t.Name()+"#R2", e2)
		if !r1Replaced || !r2Replaced || recoveries != 2 || setups != 4 || rebuilds != 0 || stamped != 4 || len(reopens[t1]) != 1 || len(reopens[t2]) != 1 ||
			c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 1 || c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 2 {
			t.Errorf("%s: each play classified on its own record (ConnectionReplacedError{1,2}) and reopened once on c2; in all 2 recoveries, 4 setups, 0 rebuilds, 4 writes stamped, key requests c1=1 (R1's) c2=2 (one per play): R1 %t, R2 %t, recoveries %d, setups %d, rebuilds %d, stamped %d, reopens R1 %v R2 %v, c1 %d, c2 %d",
				row, r1Replaced, r2Replaced, recoveries, setups, rebuilds, stamped, reopens[t1], reopens[t2], c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey), c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey))
		}
		variant := "pre-send"
		if physical {
			variant = "physical-send"
		}
		t.Logf("I26-OK %s", variant)
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI26: R1 Sent(1) and unanswered; R2 concurrent, held
// (a) before its stamped write is attempted, (b) in the connection's send
// path.
func TestDDSonicComposedI26(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("pre-send", func(t *testing.T) { composedI26(t, 157, false) })
	t.Run("physical-send", func(t *testing.T) { composedI26(t, 159, true) })
}

// composedSentExpiring is I28's and I30's opening (S32, S37): the play's
// request is Sent(1) on c1 and never answered; the receiver's next pass is
// held between L6 and L7, with p.mu released (D7, G1), and the request's
// window expires (D7's on-demand window, G8). It returns that hold's
// release.
func composedSentExpiring(t *testing.T, h *composedHarness, k *audio.DDSonicComposedKeyHooks, c1 *ap.DDSonicComposedConn, a *playback, tr *composedTrack, row string) func() {
	t.Helper()
	pkt, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second)
	if !ok || !composedKeyFor(pkt, tr) {
		t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the play's key request on c1 (never answered)", row)
	}
	if !composedWithinTrue(5*time.Second, func() bool { r := k.Record(0); return r.Live && r.State == "sent" && r.Stamp == 1 }) {
		t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the request is Sent(1): %+v", row, k.Record(0))
	}
	// The receiver's pass is held FIRST, with snapshot 1 and nothing yet
	// expiring or announced beyond 1; only then is the expiry induced.
	held, release, err := k.ArmBetweenL6L7()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s precondition: arming betweenL6L7: %v", row, err)
	}
	h.OnRelease(release)
	k.KickReceiver()
	if _, ok := composedWithin(held, 15*time.Second); !ok {
		t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the receiver's pass was not held between L6 and L7 within 15 s", row)
	}
	if r := k.Record(0); !r.Live || r.State != "sent" || r.Stamp != 1 || r.Expiring || k.Pending() > 1 || composedGeneration(a) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%s precondition: the pass held with snapshot 1 before the expiry: %+v, announced %d, generation %d", row, r, k.Pending(), composedGeneration(a))
	}
	if err := k.Expire(0); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s precondition: %v", row, err)
	}
	expiring := composedWithinTrue(5*time.Second, func() bool {
		r := k.Record(0)
		return r.Live && r.State == "sent" && r.Stamp == 1 && r.Expiring
	})
	if !expiring || k.Pending() > 1 || composedGeneration(a) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%s precondition: held with snapshot 1, the request live, sent on 1 and expiring, nothing announced beyond 1: %+v, announced %d, generation %d", row, k.Record(0), k.Pending(), composedGeneration(a))
	}
	return release
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI28 composes the SDK contract's S32 on the real stage:
// the play's request is Sent(1) and never answered; the receiver's next
// pass is held between its L6 and L7 sections while the request's window
// expires and the real reconnect announces and publishes generation 2.
// Released, L7 defers to the announced publication (the request is still
// live and sent when that pass is done), and the next pass replaces it:
// ConnectionReplacedError{1,2}, one reopen on c2, and the outer play
// completes.
func TestDDSonicComposedI28(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 161)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{hooks: true, holds: true, expireOnDemand: true})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, "I28")
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bs.B != a || bs.Hooks == nil {
			t.Fatal("I28 precondition: the bundle, its first connection and its hooks")
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		rec := composedRecordD2(h)
		h.Phase("P1")
		_, d2Before, _, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		base := composedBudgetStart(h, bs.Hooks)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I28-play", p, tr.URI())
		releaseL6L7 := composedSentExpiring(t, h, bs.Hooks, c1, a, tr, "I28")
		// The real reconnect announces and publishes generation 2.
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I28: peer close: %v", err)
		}
		c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
		if c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, 2, 15*time.Second) != 2 || bs.Hooks.Pending() != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("I28 precondition: the reconnect announced and published generation 2: c2 %t, generation %d, announced %d", c2 != nil, composedGeneration(a), bs.Hooks.Pending())
		}
		passed, releasePass, err := bs.Hooks.ArmPassDone()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I28 precondition: arming passDone: %v", err)
		}
		h.OnRelease(releasePass)
		releaseL6L7()
		if _, ok := composedWithin(passed, 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I28: the held pass did not complete within 15 s")
		}
		deferred := bs.Hooks.Record(0)
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		releasePass()
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I28: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		budget := composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I28: the outer play did not complete: %v", res.err)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("I28: the decoded samples are silent")
		}
		_, cur := h.Bundle(p)
		_, _, _, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if !deferred.Live || deferred.State != "sent" || !composedReplacedOn(rec, d2Before+1, a, gen) || cur != a || len(d4) != 0 ||
			budget.Recoveries != 1 || budget.Setups != 2 || budget.Keys != 2 || budget.Stamped != 2 || c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 1 {
			t.Errorf("I28: L7 deferred (the request live and sent after the held pass), then ConnectionReplacedError{1,2}; one reopen on c2 on the same bundle; 1 recovery, 2 setups, 2 key requests and 2 writes, 0 rebuilds: after the pass %+v, replaced %t, same bundle %t, rebuilds %v, budget %s, c2 %d",
				deferred, composedReplacedOn(rec, d2Before+1, a, gen), cur == a, d4, budget, c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey))
		}
		t.Log("I28-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI29: the origin pair captured at before-wait. A's key
// write fails at H/'s gate (KeySendError{1}) and the recovery is held at
// decisionHook("before-wait"): the DR has captured A's generation pair
// under the Session's lock and the generation has not moved since, so the
// pair it waits on is Generation()'s now, (1, ch). The real reconnect
// publishes generation 2 while it is held, which closes ch. Released, the
// wait wakes through ch, the only ready case (no owner change or close, A
// open, its context live, the step live), within 15 s, half the 30 s
// step; one reopen on the same bundle plays.
func TestDDSonicComposedI29(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 162)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{gate: true, hooks: true, fail: map[int]bool{1: true}})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, "I29")
		_, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bs.B != a {
			t.Fatal("I29 precondition: the bundle, its first connection and its gated access point")
		}
		bar := composedOnDecisions(h, "before-wait", "decided")
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		h.Phase("P1")
		base := composedBudgetStart(h, bs.Hooks)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I29-play", p, tr.URI())
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["before-wait"].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I29 precondition: the recovery did not reach before-wait within 15 s")
		}
		g, ch := a.sess.Accesspoint().Generation()
		atts := bs.Hooks.Attempts()
		failed := len(atts) == 1 && atts[0].Gen == 1 && atts[0].Returned && errors.Is(atts[0].Err, errComposedGateFail)
		if g != 1 || composedChanClosed(ch) || composedAPDoneOf(a) || a.ctx.Err() != nil || h.Detaches("publish") != 0 || h.Detaches("close") != 0 || !failed || h.Decisions("decided") != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("I29 precondition: at before-wait, the captured pair is generation 1 with its channel open; A open and live; no publication or close; one write failed at the gate on generation 1; no decision yet: generation %d, closed %t, Done %t, ctx %v, publications %d, closes %d, attempts %+v, decisions %d",
				g, composedChanClosed(ch), composedAPDoneOf(a), a.ctx.Err(), h.Detaches("publish"), h.Detaches("close"), atts, h.Decisions("decided"))
		}
		// The real reconnect, between the DR's registration and the wait.
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I29: peer close: %v", err)
		}
		c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
		if c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, 2, 15*time.Second) != 2 || !composedChanClosed(ch) {
			t.Fatalf("I29 precondition: the reconnect published generation 2 and closed the captured channel: c2 %t, generation %d, closed %t", c2 != nil, composedGeneration(a), composedChanClosed(ch))
		}
		released := h.Event("I29-release")
		bar["before-wait"].Release()
		if _, ok := composedWithin(bar["decided"].Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I29: the recovery did not decide within 15 s of the release: the wake did not come through the captured channel")
		}
		woke := composedEventsSince(h, "decision:decided", released) == 1 && h.Decisions("decided") == 1 && h.Decisions("before-wait") == 1
		bar["decided"].Release()
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I29: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		budget := composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I29: the reopen did not play: %v", res.err)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("I29: the decoded samples are silent")
		}
		_, b := h.Bundle(p)
		_, _, _, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if !woke || b != a || composedGeneration(a) != 2 || len(d4) != 0 || budget.Recoveries != 1 || budget.Setups != 2 || budget.Stamped != 2 ||
			c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 0 || c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 1 {
			t.Errorf("I29: one wait, woken after the release through the captured channel, one reopen on the same bundle at generation 2, 0 rebuilds, 1 recovery, 2 setups, 2 writes, key requests c1=0 c2=1: woke %t, same bundle %t, generation %d, rebuilds %v, budget %s, c1 %d, c2 %d",
				woke, b == a, composedGeneration(a), d4, budget, c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey), c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey))
		}
		t.Log("I29-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI30 composes the SDK contract's S37 on the real stage:
// the play's request is Sent(1) and never answered; the receiver is held
// with snapshot 1 while publication 2 completes and publication 3 is
// announced and held before its store (G2). With only the announcement of
// 3 beyond its snapshot, the held pass defers and nothing ends the request;
// the next pass replaces it with {1, 2}; one reopen, which waits for
// publication 3 and finishes on c3.
func TestDDSonicComposedI30(t *testing.T) {
	tr := composedMP3Track(t, 163)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		serviced := composedOnService(h, composedServiceOpts{hooks: true, holds: true, expireOnDemand: true})
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.OnService(nil)
		bs := composedSetupOf(t, serviced, 5*time.Second, "I30")
		s, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil || bs.B != a || bs.Hooks == nil {
			t.Fatal("I30 precondition: the bundle, its first connection and its hooks")
		}
		gen := s.generation()
		rec := composedRecordD2(h)
		h.Phase("P1")
		_, d2Before, _, _, _, _ := h.Counts()
		base := composedBudgetStart(h, bs.Hooks)
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "I30-play", p, tr.URI())
		releaseL6L7 := composedSentExpiring(t, h, bs.Hooks, c1, a, tr, "I30")
		// Publication 2 completes.
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I30: peer close of c1: %v", err)
		}
		c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
		if c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, 2, 15*time.Second) != 2 || bs.Hooks.Pending() != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("I30 precondition: publication 2 completed: c2 %t, generation %d, announced %d", c2 != nil, composedGeneration(a), bs.Hooks.Pending())
		}
		// Publication 3 announced and held before its store.
		ann, err := ap.DDSonicComposedHoldAnnouncement(a.sess.Accesspoint(), 3)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I30 precondition: arming the announcement hold: %v", err)
		}
		h.OnRelease(ann.Disarm)
		h.OnRelease(ann.Release)
		if err := c2.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I30: peer close of c2: %v", err)
		}
		if _, ok := composedWithin(ann.Reached(), 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I30 precondition: publication 3 was not announced and held within 15 s")
		}
		if bs.Hooks.Pending() != 3 || composedGeneration(a) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("I30 precondition: 3 announced, generation still 2: announced %d, generation %d", bs.Hooks.Pending(), composedGeneration(a))
		}
		passed, releasePass, err := bs.Hooks.ArmPassDone()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I30 precondition: arming passDone: %v", err)
		}
		h.OnRelease(releasePass)
		releaseL6L7()
		if _, ok := composedWithin(passed, 15*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("I30: the held pass did not complete within 15 s")
		}
		alone := bs.Hooks.Record(0)
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		releasePass()
		replaced := composedWithinTrue(15*time.Second, func() bool {
			_, ok := rec.Returned(d2Before + 1)
			return ok
		}) && composedReplacedOn(rec, d2Before+1, a, gen)
		ann.Release()
		c3 := h.ap.Conn(2, 15*time.Second)
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("I30: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		budget := composedBudget(t, h, t.Name(), base)
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("I30: the outer reopen did not finish: %v", res.err)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("I30: the decoded samples are silent")
		}
		_, _, _, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if !alone.Live || alone.State != "sent" || !replaced || c3 == nil || composedGeneration(a) != 3 || len(d4) != 0 || budget.Recoveries != 1 || budget.Setups != 2 ||
			c1.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 1 || c2.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 0 || c3.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey) != 1 {
			t.Errorf("I30: no terminal on announcement 3 alone (the request live and sent after the held pass), then ConnectionReplacedError{1,2} before publication 3; one reopen, on c3 at generation 3; 0 rebuilds, 1 recovery, 2 setups; key requests c1=1 c2=0 c3=1: after the pass %+v, replaced %t, c3 %t, generation %d, rebuilds %v, budget %s",
				alone, replaced, c3 != nil, composedGeneration(a), d4, budget)
		}
		t.Log("I30-OK")
	})
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// S5e: I27/I27′.

// composedI27Expected is every play I27 audits, by test name: the 24 plays
// of I13-I19b, the six of I20-I25, I26's four (two concurrent plays in each
// variant), the three of I28-I30 and I27′'s six mixed orders: 43, a finite
// list, no pattern. I8's own twelve orders keep their own assertions and
// are not entries; auth then auth is I18/auth's and done then done is
// I7/terminal-twice's, by their own assertions.
var composedI27Expected = []string{
	"TestDDSonicComposedI13I14/lower-before",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI13I14/lower-during",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI13I14/equal-before",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI13I14/equal-during",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI13I14/higher-before",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI13I14/higher-during",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI13pI14p/between-lower",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI13pI14p/between-equal",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI13pI14p/between-higher",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI15/close-before",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI15/close-during",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI16",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI17/advance",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI17/done",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI18/auth",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI18/malformed-key",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI18/sdk-window",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI18/sequence-exhausted",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI18/restricted",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI18/relink",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI18/metadata-500",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI19a",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI19b/owner",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI19b/closed",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI20",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI21",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI22",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI23",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI24",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI25",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI26/pre-send#R1",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI26/pre-send#R2",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI26/physical-send#R1",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI26/physical-send#R2",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI28",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI29",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI30",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI27Audit/mixed-auth-then-send",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI27Audit/mixed-done-then-send",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI27Audit/mixed-b9-then-replaced",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI27Audit/mixed-b9-then-auth",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI27Audit/mixed-b9-then-done",
	"TestDDSonicComposedI27Audit/mixed-b9-then-send",
}

// composedI27Ledger audits the ledger: exactly the listed plays, each
// within the request-wide cap, with the summary table.
func composedI27Ledger(t *testing.T) {
	composedBudgetMu.Lock()
	got := make(map[string]composedBudgetEntry, len(composedBudgetLedger))
	for k, v := range composedBudgetLedger {
		got[k] = v
	}
	records := make(map[string]int, len(composedBudgetRecords))
	for k, v := range composedBudgetRecords {
		records[k] = v
	}
	composedBudgetMu.Unlock()
	want := map[string]bool{}
	var missing, extra, over, dup []string
	for _, name := range composedI27Expected {
		want[name] = true
		e, ok := got[name]
		if !ok {
			missing = append(missing, name)
			continue
		}
		t.Logf("I27-TABLE %s %s", name, e)
		if !e.within() {
			over = append(over, name)
		}
		if records[name] != 1 {
			dup = append(dup, name)
		}
	}
	for name := range got {
		if !want[name] {
			extra = append(extra, name)
		}
	}
	if len(composedI27Expected) != 43 || len(want) != 43 || len(missing) != 0 || len(extra) != 0 || len(over) != 0 || len(dup) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("I27: the ledger is exactly the 43 listed plays (list %d, distinct %d), each recorded once and within the request-wide cap (1 recovery, 2 setups, 2 key requests received, 2 writes stamped where observed, 1 rebuild): missing %v, extra %v, over the cap %v, recorded more than once %v",
			len(composedI27Expected), len(want), missing, extra, over, dup)
		return
	}
	t.Logf("I27-AUDIT-OK %d plays", len(composedI27Expected))
}

// TestDDSonicComposedI27Audit: I27/I27′ (plan v9 §8). First the mixed
// orders no other row executes: I8's two missing pairs (auth then send,
// done then send; auth then auth is I18/auth and done then done is
// I7/terminal-twice) through composedI8 unchanged, and B9's terminal form
// followed by each final second failure (composedI24). Then the ledger
// subtest audits every budgeted play of the process: I8's orders, I13-I26
// and these, each by name, against the request-wide cap. It follows those
// rows in source order (the step-14 parent run and B1 run them all); run
// alone, its ledger is incomplete and it fails, never passes.
func TestDDSonicComposedI27Audit(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("mixed-auth-then-send", func(t *testing.T) { composedI8With(t, 167, composedI8Order{"auth", "send"}, true) })
	t.Run("mixed-done-then-send", func(t *testing.T) { composedI8With(t, 168, composedI8Order{"done", "send"}, true) })
	t.Run("mixed-b9-then-replaced", func(t *testing.T) { composedI24(t, 169, "replaced") })
	t.Run("mixed-b9-then-auth", func(t *testing.T) { composedI24(t, 170, "auth") })
	t.Run("mixed-b9-then-done", func(t *testing.T) { composedI24(t, 171, "done") })
	t.Run("mixed-b9-then-send", func(t *testing.T) { composedI24(t, 172, "send") })
	t.Run("ledger", composedI27Ledger)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// S5d: F1a-F1c, on the long real FLAC fixture (plan v9 §7).

// TestDDSonicComposedF1a: one full E-outer play of the FLAC-only track:
// FLAC selected (the counted decoder is FLAC; the key request names the
// file), the stream read to its end, exactly STREAMINFO's samples, every
// second of them non-silent; every chunk served; no recovery.
func TestDDSonicComposedF1a(t *testing.T) {
	tr, total := composedFLACTrack(t, 164)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		start := time.Now()
		res, ok := composedWithin(composedOpenAsync(h, "F1a-play", p, tr.URI()), 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("F1a: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("F1a: NewStreamer: %v", res.err)
		}
		h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		decs := h.Decoders()
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		got := false
		if c1 != nil {
			if kp, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 5*time.Second); ok && composedKeyFor(kp, tr) {
				got = true
			}
		}
		if len(decs) != 1 || decs[0].Format != "flac" || !got {
			t.Fatalf("F1a precondition: FLAC selected: decoders %d (want one FLAC), the key request names the FLAC file %t", len(decs), got)
		}
		// The whole stream, to its end, in 1 s windows of stereo frames: ONE
		// declared 120 s allowance, set here, never reset, for the decode AND
		// (R76-2) the CDN completions observed after it. Every read's return,
		// the final one (EOF) included, is checked against it before it is
		// accepted (R76-1). A read that never returns is bounded only by the
		// test's own timeout: no interruptible decoder is claimed.
		decodeBy := time.Now().Add(120 * time.Second)
		read, silent := 0, 0
		buf := make([][2]float64, 4096)
		var window [][2]float64
		for {
			k, ok := res.s.Stream(buf)
			if time.Now().After(decodeBy) {
				t.Fatalf("F1a: the full decode did not end within its 120 s allowance: %d of %d frames, the last read ok %t", read+k, total, ok)
			}
			window = append(window, buf[:k]...)
			read += k
			for len(window) >= 44100 {
				if !nonSilent(window[:44100]) {
					silent++
				}
				window = window[44100:]
			}
			if !ok {
				break
			}
		}
		if len(window) > 0 && !nonSilent(window) {
			silent++
		}
		// The fixture publishes a chunk's status and completion only after its
		// handler's body write returned (H' serveCDN :1272-1278), which the
		// client's EOF does not order: every chunk's completion-published
		// record (206, Completed set) is awaited within what remains of the
		// same allowance, then the exact snapshot is taken. An arrival or
		// status-0 record never counts as complete.
		served := map[int]bool{}
		snapshot := func() bool {
			served = map[int]bool{}
			for _, rc := range h.fx.CDN() {
				if rc.File == tr.FileHex() && rc.Status == 206 && !rc.Completed.IsZero() {
					served[rc.Chunk] = true
				}
			}
			for c := 0; c < tr.Chunks(); c++ {
				if !served[c] {
					return false
				}
			}
			return len(served) == tr.Chunks()
		}
		all := composedWithinTrue(time.Until(decodeBy), snapshot)
		// composedWithinTrue tests its condition before its timeout, so a
		// success observed after decodeBy is refused here, against the same
		// absolute deadline (R77-1): a late observation is never accepted.
		if all && time.Now().After(decodeBy) {
			t.Errorf("F1a: every chunk's completion was published, but it was observed only after the 120 s allowance had ended (a late observation, not accepted)")
			all = false
		} else if !all {
			var missing []string
			for c := 0; c < tr.Chunks(); c++ {
				if !served[c] {
					var recs []string
					for _, rc := range h.fx.CDN() {
						if rc.File == tr.FileHex() && rc.Chunk == c {
							recs = append(recs, fmt.Sprintf("status %d completed %t", rc.Status, !rc.Completed.IsZero()))
						}
					}
					missing = append(missing, fmt.Sprintf("chunk %d: %v", c, recs))
				}
			}
			t.Errorf("F1a: not every chunk's completion was published (206, completed) within the remaining 120 s allowance: %v", missing)
		}
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		if read != total || res.s.Err() != nil || silent != 0 || !all || d3 != 1 || len(d4) != 0 || h.Decisions("begin") != 0 || composedKeysReceived(h) != 1 {
			t.Errorf("F1a: the whole FLAC stream decoded: STREAMINFO's %d samples, no error, every second non-silent, all %d chunks served 206, 1 setup, 0 rebuilds, 0 recoveries, 1 key request: samples %d, error %v, silent seconds %d, chunks served %v, setups %d, rebuilds %v, recoveries %d, key requests %d",
				total, tr.Chunks(), read, res.s.Err(), silent, served, d3, d4, h.Decisions("begin"), composedKeysReceived(h))
		}
		t.Logf("F1A-OBSERVED samples %d of %d in %s; chunks %d", read, total, time.Since(start).Round(time.Millisecond), len(served))
		t.Log("F1A-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedF1b: I2 on FLAC. The key request on c1 is withheld;
// the peer closes c1; the real reconnect completes; the SDK's
// ConnectionReplacedError{1,2} gives one same-session reopen through a full
// Player.NewStream, which decodes the FLAC file.
func TestDDSonicComposedF1b(t *testing.T) {
	tr, _ := composedFLACTrack(t, 165)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		_, a := h.Bundle(p)
		c1 := h.ap.Conn(0, 5*time.Second)
		if a == nil || c1 == nil {
			t.Fatal("F1b precondition: no bundle or no first connection")
		}
		out := composedOpenAsync(h, "F1b-play", p, tr.URI())
		pkt, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 15*time.Second)
		if !ok || !composedKeyFor(pkt, tr) {
			t.Fatal("F1b precondition: the FLAC file's key request was not observed on c1")
		}
		gen1 := composedGeneration(a)
		if err := c1.C.PeerClose(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("F1b precondition: peer close: %v", err)
		}
		c2 := h.ap.Conn(1, 15*time.Second)
		if c2 == nil || composedWaitGen(a, gen1+1, 15*time.Second) != gen1+1 {
			t.Fatal("F1b precondition: the reconnect did not complete")
		}
		pkt2, ok := c2.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 30*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("F1b: no reopen key request on c2")
		}
		if err := c2.C.AnswerKey(pkt2, tr.Key); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("F1b: answer: %v", err)
		}
		res, ok := composedWithin(out, 45*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("F1b: NewStreamer did not return within 45 s")
		}
		if res.s != nil {
			h.KeepCloser(res.s)
		}
		if res.err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("F1b: the stream was not returned: %v", res.err)
		}
		if last := readSamples(t, res.s, 5*44100); !nonSilent(last) {
			t.Error("F1b: the decoded samples are silent")
		}
		_, _, d3, _, _, d4 := h.Counts()
		_, b := h.Bundle(p)
		decs := h.Decoders()
		flac := len(decs) == 1 && decs[0].Format == "flac"
		if b != a || a.ctx.Err() != nil || d3 != 2 || composedKeyWrites(h, 0) != 1 || composedKeyWrites(h, 1) != 1 || h.Decisions("begin") != 1 || len(d4) != 0 || !flac {
			t.Errorf("F1b: the original bundle retained (same pointer, live ctx), 2 setups, key writes c1=1 c2=1, 1 recovery, 0 rebuilds, the reopen's decoder FLAC: same %t, ctx %v, setups %d, key writes c1=%d c2=%d, recoveries %d, rebuilds %v, FLAC %t",
				b == a, a.ctx.Err(), d3, composedKeyWrites(h, 0), composedKeyWrites(h, 1), h.Decisions("begin"), d4, flac)
		}
		t.Log("F1B-OK")
	})
}

// TestDDSonicComposedF1c: L3's disposal on FLAC (plan v9 §7). E-direct; the
// open is held at openHook("caller-before-accept") with a ready result: a
// counted real FLAC decoder, made while FLAC's metadata pass read chunk 0
// and its prefetch of chunk 1 was held at the CDN. The checked cut names
// that held receipt; the caller cancels; release; the watch. NewStream =
// Canceled; the counted FLAC Close exactly once; no stream; the held
// request's server-side context ends within 5 s, before the row returns;
// W1, W2 (zero receipts for the file after the cut, through T5r) and W4 at
// T9. Preconditions that cannot be established are STOP 9, never relabelled.
func TestDDSonicComposedF1c(t *testing.T) {
	tr, _ := composedFLACTrack(t, 166)
	withComposed(t, composedOptions{}, func(h *composedHarness) {
		h.fx.Add(tr)
		answerKeys(h, tr)
		p := h.Provider()
		p0(t, h, p)
		h.Phase("P1")
		s, _ := h.Bundle(p)
		key1 := fmt.Sprintf("cdn/%s/1", tr.FileHex())
		_, release1 := h.fx.Hold(key1)
		h.OnRelease(release1)
		reached, proceed := composedReadyHold(h)
		ctx, cancel := h.Context()
		out := make(chan error, 1)
		h.Go("F1c-open", func() {
			st, sc, err := s.NewStream(ctx, tr.ID, 320)
			if err == nil { // not expected; never leaked
				sc()
				releaseDecoder(st.Source)
				err = errors.New("a stream was returned")
			}
			out <- err
		})
		if _, ok := composedWithin(reached, 30*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Fatal("F1c precondition: the open did not reach caller-before-accept with a ready result (STOP 9)")
		}
		pos1, ok := composedWaitReceipt(h, key1, 5*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("F1c precondition: the stream's chunk-1 prefetch is not held at the CDN (STOP 9)")
		}
		decs := h.Decoders()
		if len(decs) != 1 || decs[0].Format != "flac" || decs[0].Closes() != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("F1c precondition: D3 holds one counted real FLAC decoder, not closed: %d decoders (STOP 9)", len(decs))
		}
		select {
		case err := <-out:
			t.Fatalf("F1c precondition: a result before the release: %v", err)
		default:
		}
		t.Log("F1C-PRE-OK")
		cut, err := h.Cut(tr.FileHex(), pos1, 5*time.Second)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("F1c precondition: the checked cut (STOP 9): %v", err)
		}
		t.Log("F1C-CUT-OK")
		cancel()
		proceed()
		err, ok = composedWithin(out, 10*time.Second)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("F1c: NewStream did not return within 10 s of the release")
		}
		h.Watch(cut)
		if !h.fx.AwaitCtxEnded(pos1, 5*time.Second) {
			t.Error("F1c: the held chunk-1 request's server-side context did not end within 5 s")
		} else {
			t.Log("F1C-HELD-ENDED")
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || decs[0].Closes() != 1 {
			t.Errorf("F1c: NewStream = context.Canceled and D3's counted FLAC decoder Close = exactly 1, no stream returned: err %v, closes %d", err, decs[0].Closes())
		}
		t.Log("F1C-OK")
	})
}
